descriptionHtml:

About Salesforce

The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

As a 1st line Sales Leader you will be leading a team of Business Development Representatives or Account Executives selling the entire Salesforce Customer Success Platform across multiple verticals. We are looking for a sales leader with great energy, leadership, and initiative to drive team performance and sales for our enterprise team. You will formulate and implement a strategy to increase business growth. This role works in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Pre-sales, Partner Alliances, Services & HR, therefore cross-company engagement and orchestration is crucial. The candidate will be a high impact individual capable of driving outstanding business results & first-class employee development. The Sales Leader is fully responsible for developing and leading the team to generate revenue and achieve individual team and organizational quotas. Aligning to the sales strategy, the Sales Leader defines and implements plans for the assigned Accounts to achieve sales objectives.

You may be aligned to the following verticals and/or clouds:


 
  • Enterprise Corporate Services
  • Financial Services
  • Healthcare & Life Sciences
  • Retail & Consumer Goods
  • Comms, Media and Tech
  • Public Sector
  • Marketing Cloud
  • Slack
  • Mulesoft
  • Tableau
  • Marketing Cloud
  • Specialization Cloud


What You'll Actually Be Doing

The teams you lead here at Salesforce will directly impact the growth of our overall organization. You will be masterful in client engagement and impact how your customers do business in a constantly evolving environment. You will coach your team to develop in their careers, and inspire your team to do the best work of their life.


 
  • Hire, Train, and Develop a team
  • Develop teams into sales-ready candidates for future Account Executive positions
  • Create Industry Specific Pipeline Programs to drive Pipeline and Revenue
  • Motivate Individuals and Team to exceed objectives through coaching, regular broadcast of results, and creative incentives
  • Regularly report on Team/Individual Results - Pipeline Generation, Quality of Pipeline, Revenue Forecasting
  • Work closely with Marketing on defining Campaign follow-up and reporting
  • Work closely with Executive Leadership Team and Sales Leaders to ensure Pipeline Quality/Quantity and proper follow-up
  • Work closely with Operations to make recommendations on process improvements
  • Identify and make recommendations for improvement in the areas of Process, Efficiency, Productivity


You're Our Person If...

Depending on the segment, the years of experience and skills needed to be successful will vary from 3+ yrs of sales leadership experience developing a team of seven or more quota carrying sales people. In addition, a bachelor's degree is strongly preferred.


 
  • Strong background in leading sales teams
  • Shown ability to create hard-working teams and lead them to success
  • Excellent presentation and executive engagement skills
  • Excellent negotiation skills
  • A self-starter that can thrive in a fast paced environment

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Role Summary

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer’s workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems.

Key Responsibilities


Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

  • Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
  • Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle
  • Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
  • Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
  • Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
  • Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.
  • Drive adoption of Sales Cloud features with sales reps, managers, and sales ops teams
  • Conduct enablement sessions on opportunity management, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Track usage metrics (opportunity updates, activity logging, forecast submissions, report usage)
  • Share best practices for sales process optimization and data quality
    Escalate complex automation or data model questions to technical resources

Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer’s business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
  • Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
  • Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
  • Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.

Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management

  • AI  Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
  • Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.    
  • AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.    
  • Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
  • Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask ** effective diagnosis questions**, and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
  • Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
  • Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
  • Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.


Minimum Requirements

  • Experience supporting customers using Sales Cloud
  • Working knowledge of core Sales Cloud features: Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Forecasting, Reports & Dashboards
  • Understanding of sales processes (lead-to-cash, opportunity management, pipeline management)
  • Familiarity with Sales Cloud automation (workflows, process builder, flows for sales processes)
  • Ability to demonstrate Lightning Sales Console and mobile app
  • Knowledge of common sales use cases (territory management, lead assignment, opportunity stages)
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator (or within 90 days)

  • English proficiency is required for all candidates to ensure global alignment.


Preferred/mandatory Qualifications and Skills

  • Experience: Experienced business professional, preferably with 3-4 years of relevant industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platform use, or related fields. 
  • Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
  • Domain Expertise: Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer’s business.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
  • Learning & Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development
  • Experience with Sales Cloud features like Einstein Lead Scoring, Opportunity Insights, Activity Capture
    Understanding of how Sales Cloud integrates with marketing automation and service tools

Cloud Specific Experience

Salesforce product certifications are a plus (external hire recommended: AI Associate, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Data Cloud Specialist)


Note: This role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to be in office 3 days per week.

Salesforce AI Research Labs is at the forefront of Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Deep Learning. Our team launched Einstein GPT - the world’s first Generative AI for CRM - delivering AI-created content across every sales, service, marketing, commerce, and IT interaction at hyper-scale.

Our research has helped shape multiple generations of modern AI: we helped pioneer prompt engineering through DecaNLP; introduced BLIP, a foundational breakthrough in multimodal AI; trained state-of-the-art large language models including CodeGen; and pioneered foundation models for time series with Moirai. Today, we continue to advance the frontier of enterprise AI through innovations in reasoning engines, agent architectures, and autonomous AI systems, including the Atlas Reasoning Engine, that are redefining how enterprises reason, plan, and act.

What makes our team unique is our ability to take ideas from research to real-world impact at scale. We publish at the world’s top AI conferences, open source influential research, collaborate with leading academic institutions, and work closely with product teams and enterprise customers to translate cutting-edge research into production AI capabilities used by millions of users. Our innovations continue to shape the future of Salesforce products and the broader enterprise AI ecosystem. Learn more at Salesforce AI Research.

We are looking for entrepreneurial Research Scientists who want to build, ship, and scale the next generation of Enterprise AI.

This is not a traditional research role. You will work like a founder within Salesforce — identifying high-impact research directions, prototyping cutting-edge AI capabilities, validating ideas directly with customers, and turning the strongest concepts into production-ready solutions.

You will have the freedom to propose and incubate new research ideas, access Salesforce’s global customer and product ecosystem, and quickly validate new innovations with external and internal customers and stakeholders.

We are looking for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, move with urgency, and care as much about customer adoption as technical innovation. If you want the pace and ownership of a startup, combined with the reach and resources of Salesforce, this role offers a unique opportunity to build Enterprise AI with global impact

  • Develop solutions for real-world, large-scale problems

  • Publication record in top AI venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV)
  • Experience with one or more general-purpose programming languages (C/C++, Python, etc.)

  • Proven ability to implement, operate, and deliver results via innovation at large scale
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and translate ideas into impactful systems.



Even Better If...

descriptionHtml:

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. 職務の目的

「戦略を、実行し、成果に変える。AIと共に」 

顧客のDXパートナーとして、システム構想の策定から実際の導入・運用までを一気通貫でリードします。単なるツールの導入に留まらず、Salesforceを活用してお客様のビジネスを成功へ導くことが本ポジションの重要な役割となります。

本ポジションの特徴

「戦略」と「実行」の両立

  • アドバイザーとして、またはプライムベンダーとして、プロジェクトをサービスインまで責任を持って完遂させる役割を担います。

AIネイティブな働き方

  • Agentforceなどの最新AIをお客様に提案するだけでなく、自らもAIを駆使し、高い生産性と品質を兼ね備えたコンサルティングを提供します。

End-to-Endの関与

  • 構想策定から構築、定着化まで支援するため、幅広い専門スキルを習得する機会が豊富にあります。

具体的な担当領域

Salesforce Architectとして、専門性を活かしたコンサルティング業務を遂行していただきます。当初は以下いずれかのロールを担当していただく想定であり、入社時の役割については選考プロセスを通じて決定します。また、入社後には個々の能力を広げられる機会があり、習得したスキルに応じて多様な役割を担うことが可能です。

主なロール

PM (Project Manager)

  • プロジェクトのリーダーとして牽引し、案件を成功に導く責任者

BA (Business Architect)

  • ビジネス戦略、業務プロセス設計、および定着化の主導

SA (Solution Architect)

  • アプリケーション全体設計、データモデル、標準機能活用、マルチクラウド設計の主導

TA (Technical Architect)

  • インテグレーション、セキュリティ、システム・アーキテクチャ設計・構築、高度な技術実装の主導

主な案件

A.戦略・変革デザイン策定（Strategy & Change Design）

組織およびシステム全体の変革構想とロードマップを策定します。

組織・業務領域変革構想デザイン

  • 業務プロセス改革や組織変革のグランドデザイン策定

システム領域変革構想デザイン

  • ITランドスケープにおけるアーキテクチャ構想

Salesforce Org 戦略

  • Salesforce組織（インスタンス）の活用戦略・ガバナンス戦略策定、ロードマップ策定

Salesforce CTO

  • CTOの視点からAgentic Enterpriseへの変革を支援

変革推進 / 定着化

  • Salesforce活用の定着化計画立案と実行支援

概念実証（PoC)

  • 具体的な解決策の設計や仮説ソリューションの実現可能性を検証

B.プロジェクト実行・支援（Project Execution & Support）

要件定義からリリースまで、各フェーズにおいて支援または実務を遂行します。プロジェクトの特性に応じウォーターフォール型かアジャイル型を選択します。

プロジェクト管理

  • プロジェクト計画の策定、推進、および管理支援

要件定義

  • ビジネス要件およびシステム化要件の抽出・定義、プロセスのファシリテーション

設計

  • アーキテクチャ・詳細設計の作成、または成果物のレビュー

開発・テスト

  • 実装・テストのリード、または開発標準策定・品質管理

移行・展開

  • データ移行・リリースの実行、または移行戦略立案・実行支援

CI/CD

  • DevOpsパイプラインの環境設計・構築・運用の支援

C.ガバナンス・最適化（Governance & Optimization）

Salesforce Governance

  • CoE（Center of Excellence）の設立、運営モデルの組成および運営支援

Design Authority

  • 設計品質の診断、レビュー、承認プロセスの確立による設計品質の統制

設計品質BestPracticeの提言・遂行支援（Design Authority）

  • 設計品質の診断、レビュー、承認プロセスの確立

Architecture Optimization

  • 既存環境の診断（Org診断 & ヘルスチェック）および最適化提案

応募要件

必須要件（Must）

実務経験

以下の領域のいずれかにおいて、5年以上の主体的な実務経験を有すること

A. 変革デザインと戦略

B. ガバナンスと最適化

C. プロジェクト推進・実行

リーダーシップ 

  • 3年以上のチームリーダー経験（立場は問わない）

コミュニケーション能力

  • 経営層を含む顧客と適切な意思疎通を図り、合意形成を推進できること 
  • 関連組織のメンバーに対し、敬意を払いつつ率直かつ建設的な対話ができること

基礎理解力と学習意欲 

  • 業務要件やSalesforceの技術用語、各種メソッドを短期間で理解できること
  • AIを効率的に活用し、継続的に学習する意欲と実行力があること

マインドセット 

  • 批判的思考（Critical Thinking）とアンラーニング（Unlearning）を実践できること 
  • 過去の成功体験に固執しすぎず、AIなどの新技術に合わせて自らの考えや方法論を柔軟に適合できること

言語能力

  • 日本語：流暢レベル
  • 英語：英文ドキュメントの読解に支障がないレベル以上

  • Data 活用やAI Agentの開発など、先端技術を用いたプロジェクト経験

グローバル案件の遂行能力

  • 英語を用いたビジネスレベルのコミュニケーションおよびプロジェクト遂行能力

AI活用による業務効率化の実績

  • コンサルティング業務やシステム構築において、AIを活用した生産性向上の実務経験

​

本ポジションで得られるキャリア価値

総合的なアーキテクトへの成長

  • 専門的かつ幅広いスキルを習得し、市場価値の高いアーキテクトへ成長できます。

  • 最新のAI活用型コンサルティング手法を実践し、最先端の知見を体得できます。

The Experience

カスタマーサクセスマネージャー（CSM）は、深いビジネス、業界、および製品の知識を活用して顧客とパートナーシップを結び、ビジネス価値を加速させ、Salesforceへの投資対効果を最大化できるよう導きます。この役割において、CSMは特定のクラウドの専門性や業界知見をもとに、社内リソースをオーケストレーションし、お客様と同じ目線で語り合い、顧客価値の実現を中長期的に図ります。

理想的なカスタマーサクセスマネージャーは、お客様の言葉で対話できるクラウドの専門知識と業界スキルの両方を備えた人物です。



What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • 目標の理解と提案: 当社のカスタマーサクセス・メソドロジーを活用し、お客様のステークホルダーと連携して目標を理解し、彼らの能力を評価した上で、ビジネスおよびテクノロジーの目標達成を加速させるための提案を行う
  • Salesforceの啓蒙: お客様のSalesforce導入状況に対する理解と知識を深め、当社のすべてのクラウドにおけるSalesforceの機能をエバンジェライズ（啓蒙）する。
  • ベストプラクティスの提示: お客様のニーズに基づき、組織戦略、ガバナンス、およびチェンジマネジメント（変革管理）のベストプラクティスについて顧客を導く。
  • リスクの特定と軽減: お客様が掲げるビジネス目標の達成を阻害するリスクをプロアクティブに特定し、アカウントチームと連携してリスク軽減計画を策定する。
  • エグゼクティブレベルの関係構築: お客様のITおよびビジネスのエグゼクティブリーダーシップ、スポンサー、意思決定者との経営層レベルの関係を構築・育成し、パートナーシップを強固にし、お客様のビジネスやITスポンサー・チームメンバーへのコミットメントを確実なものにする。
  • 実践的な製品知識の提供: プラットフォームの機能や特長をお客様のビジネスの優先事項やロードマップに適用することで、Salesforce製品に関する実践的な知識を示す。
  • テクニカルインサイトの提供によるCustomer Enablementの推進: 製品アップデートや障害、サポート終了（EOL）等の技術情報を「顧客の価値」へと翻訳し、IT/業務部門がテクノロジーを最大限に活用できるよう伴走、支援する。
  • 定着化計画の策定・実行: 現状、タイムラインを伴う目標とする将来像、およびその基盤となるイネーブルメント（定着・活用化）計画を示す、包括的なアダプション（定着化）パスを作成し、実行する。
  • 価値とイノベーションの提供: お客様の主要なビジネス課題と成長の可能性を理解し、お客様のビジネスに価値とイノベーションを提供する。



You’re Our Person If...

  • カスタマーサクセス、テクノロジーコンサルティング、エンタープライズアーキテクチャ、またはテクノロジーソリューション開発における6年以上の経験
  • 情熱 (PASSION): カスタマーサクセスに対して情熱を持っていること。
  • 信頼 (TRUST): 信頼を第一に行動していること。
  • 適応力 (ADAPTABLE): 不確実性が高く、変化の激しい環境において優れた成果を上げられること。



Even Better If...

  • 特定のクラウドにおける深い知識。
  • 顧客のビジネス価値を推進する「Trusted Advisor」として働いた実績と強力なコンサルティングスキル。
  • Cレベル（経営層）との効果的で影響力のある対話を主導する能力。困難な議論を円滑に進め、反論・異論に巧みに対処できること。
  • Salesforce製品およびプラットフォームの機能、性能、ベストプラクティスに関する理解があることが望まれる。
  • 技術的およびビジネス上の概念を迅速に理解し、明確に説明できる能力。
  • 以下の経験・知識のうち、少なくとも2つを有すること：
  • ビジネスプロセス（営業、サービス、マーケティング、サポート）、ビジネスアプリケーション、および自動化に関する深い知識。
  • AIおよび機械学習の概念の理解、エージェントプラットフォームの理解、エージェントの構成および展開方法に関する知識。
  • エンタープライズレベルのソフトウェア開発ライフサイクルやプロジェクトマネジメント経験。（コーディングの経験は有用ですが、必須ではありません）
  • インテグレーション、フローや自動化、API接続などへの統合方法についての知識。
  • クラウドコンピューティングで使用される、ミドルウェア、インフラ知識（例：データベース、ネットワークの基礎知識など）に関する深い理解。
  • 流暢な日本語および基礎的な読み書きができる英語力。
  • 高度な英語力、韓国語力、中国語力（関連部門と業務遂行できるレベル）があると尚良い。


【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】


株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。
弊社では「Equality（平等）」をコアバリューの一つとして掲げ、性別やライフステージに関わらず、すべての社員が能力を最大限に発揮できるインクルーシブな環境づくりを推進しています。社内コミュニティ「Salesforce Women’s Network（SWN）」をはじめとするネットワーキングやキャリア形成支援、メンターシップ制度も活発に稼働しています。

【働き方・ワークライフバランスの推進】


ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。
フレックスタイム制度: コアタイムにとらわれない柔軟なスケジュール調整が可能で、育児や介護、個人のプライベートな事情に応じた働き方を尊重しています。
充実した両立支援制度: 産前産後休暇・育児休業（女性の復職率は非常に高く、男性社員の育休取得実績も多数）、復職後の短時間勤務や看護・介護休暇など、ライフステージの変化に寄り添う各種サポートプログラムが整っています。
ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。


The Experience


A Customer Success Manager (CSM) partners with customers, drawing on deep business, industry, and product knowledge to accelerate business value and guide them to maximize their return on investment in Salesforce. In this role, CSMs use their cloud expertise and industry insight to orchestrate internal resources, speak with customers as true partners, and deliver customer value over the medium to long term.

The ideal Customer Success Manager brings both cloud expertise and industry skills, and can engage with customers in their own language.



What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • Understand goals and make recommendations: Use our Customer Success methodology to work with customer stakeholders, understand their goals, assess their capabilities, and make recommendations that accelerate their business and technology goals
  • Evangelize Salesforce: Build understanding of the customer’s Salesforce adoption, and evangelize Salesforce capabilities across all of our clouds.
  • Present best practices: Guide customers on best practices in organizational strategy, governance, and change management based on their needs.
  • Identify and mitigate risks: Proactively identify risks that could prevent customers from achieving their business goals, and work with the account team to develop risk mitigation plans.
  • Build executive-level relationships: Build and nurture executive-level relationships with customers’ IT and business executive leaders, sponsors, and decision makers to strengthen the partnership and ensure commitment to the customer’s business and to IT sponsors and team members.
  • Provide hands-on product knowledge: Demonstrate practical knowledge of Salesforce products by applying platform capabilities and features to the customer’s business priorities and roadmap.
  • Drive Customer Enablement through technical insights: Translate technical information such as product updates, incidents, and end-of-life (EOL) into customer value, and work alongside IT and business teams to help them get the most out of the technology.
  • Create and execute adoption plans: Create and execute a comprehensive adoption path that sets out the current state, a target future state with timelines, and the underlying enablement plan.
  • Deliver value and innovation: Understand the customer’s key business challenges and growth potential, and deliver value and innovation to their business.



You’re Our Person If...

  • 6+ years of experience in customer success, technology consulting, enterprise architecture, or technology solution development
  • PASSION: Passionate about customer success.
  • TRUST: Acts with trust as the first priority.
  • ADAPTABLE: Delivers excellent results in highly uncertain, fast-changing environments.



Even Better If...

  • Deep knowledge of a specific cloud.
  • Track record as a “Trusted Advisor” driving customer business value, with strong consulting skills.
  • Ability to lead effective, influential conversations with C-level executives, facilitating difficult discussions and skillfully handling pushback and objections.
  • Understanding of Salesforce products and platform capabilities, performance, and best practices is desirable.
  • Ability to quickly grasp and clearly explain technical and business concepts.
  • Experience or knowledge in at least two of the following:
  • Deep knowledge of business processes (sales, service, marketing, support), business applications, and automation.
  • Understanding of AI and machine learning concepts and agent platforms, and knowledge of how to configure and deploy agents.
  • Enterprise-level software development lifecycle or project management experience. (Coding experience is useful but not required)
  • Knowledge of integration, flows and automation, and API connectivity.
  • Deep understanding of middleware and infrastructure used in cloud computing (e.g., databases, networking fundamentals).
  • Fluent Japanese and basic reading and writing skills in English.
  • Advanced English, Korean, or Chinese (at a level to work with related teams) is a plus.

Partnering with customer success managers, they ensure customers receive strategic guidance on standard methodologies and long-term technology health. What roles are we looking to fill in Solutions Engineering?
The SE team is organized into several smaller teams based on the products they are selling, or the industry/vertical they are selling into aligning with the sales teams. This includes the delivery of executive level software demonstrations, construction of future state customer journey strategies, and developing long term IT roadmaps.
    • "Solutioning" is fundamental to the SE role. It is important to realize that a component of the responsibilities will include assisting the customer, Account Executive and Professional Services team with the discovery, analysis and ultimately the recommendation of strategic solutions for the customer by delivering transformational pitches based in live product demonstrations to validate.     • Discover the customer's business needs, and position the best Salesforce solution to achieve those business objectives
    • Build and present customized solutions and demonstrations focused on Salesforce products to multiple customer personas showing how Salesforce will accelerate their business strategies and a path to value.

    • Orchestrate and lead cross-functional solutions guides, and align them to the opportunity strategy
    • Develop and deliver the story of the customer experience aided by Salesforce technologies
    • Participate in all appropriate product, sales, and procedural training and certifications to acquire and maintain the knowledge vital to be effective in the position
    • Ability to travel based on territory alignment and region.

  • Knowledge of related applications, relational database and web technology
  • Solid oral, written, presentation, collaboration and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to work as part of a team to solve technical problems in varied political environments

  • Manufacturing Cloud

  • Automotive Cloud

  • Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision-making, and advocate for best practices.

  • Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.

  • Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.

  • Ability to synthesize AI-generated insights into executive-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen

The Experience

Are you ready to be at the forefront of Agentforce and Data 360 activation? If you thrive in ambiguity, move quickly, go deep technically, and can engage at the executive level — and you want to write the playbook, not just execute it — this team is for you. AFD360 operates with the energy of a startup within Salesforce.

About AFD360
AFD360 is a small, high-impact agentic activation team. We engage when customers have purchased Agentforce and Data 360 but haven't yet realized value. We work in the most critical phase of the customer lifecycle — the space between purchase and production — where data readiness, architecture, security and compliance, integration complexity, evaluation, and production hardening consistently prevent customers from seeing results.

Our mission is to prove the path to production, build the customer's capability to sustain and expand it, and hand off cleanly. We remove the blockers that most often stall AI deployments.

What AFD360 is not
We are not an implementation team or a long-term execution owner. We guide, enable, and build the customer's ability to execute agentic use cases so they can sustain and scale independently. We measure success by activation outcomes — agents in production with active usage — not by activity.

We're hiring across two profiles — and the best candidates often blend both:
 
  • Guiders: Expertise in feasibility, activation strategy, orchestration, executive-ready communication, and customer capability development.
  • Doers: Skilled at removing hard blockers, hands-on agent building, grounding and evaluation, production hardening, and navigating integration realities.


What You'll Actually Be Doing
 
  • Prove the path to production — Partner with customers to shape use cases that deliver measurable business value, then define a credible, executable path to a production-grade agent with active usage.
  • Optimize underperforming agents — When live agents aren't driving value, diagnose what's broken — instructions, grounding, topics, evaluation — and fine-tune to improve accuracy, adoption, and business impact.
  • Drive production readiness — Lead grounding and evaluation, guardrails, observability, and runbooks ("trust-by-design") so agents earn approval and sustain usage.
  • Build customer capability — Provide hands-on guidance and capability development so customers can run, harden, and expand independently.
  • Serve as the expert overlay — Unblock decisions, align stakeholders, and drive coordinated C360 orchestration with clean handoffs to FDE, Professional Services, partners, and Success.
  • Close the ATR → NCR gap — Accelerate adoption and consumption ramp on agents that are live but not yet scaling.
  • Chart the expansion roadmap — Define the "what's next" plan: next-best agent, sequencing, dependencies, and the adoption and consumption path that makes expansion inevitable.
  • Scale what works — Document winning patterns, equip Regulated Industries teams, and feed learnings back to Product and AI SMEs.

We are a Data & AI Architects team focused on helping customers understand what this new AI era makes possible, and what it actually takes to make the possible a reality: the right architecture, a trusted data foundation, a clear operating model, and an adoption path that scales. We work in the field, close to customers, close to our Agentforce and Data 360 sellers, and close to Product, Engineering, Support, and delivery teams. We are expected to know the domain, understand the wider ecosystem, bring a strong point of view, and help guide the architectural decisions that turn AI ambition into trusted business outcomes.

We are looking for architects who love hard problems, think in systems, and are energized by the transformation AI is driving across organizations. We value people who understand how the whole landscape fits together and where Salesforce creates the most leverage within it.
 

About the Role

As a Data & AI Technical Architect, you are the expert thought leader and senior field specialist for customers evaluating, implementing, and expanding their use of Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud), Agentforce, and the broader enterprise data and AI ecosystem.

Your work sits at the intersection of technical architectural, solution engineering, applied data and AI, and delivery-aware judgment on what it takes to make a solution succeed. You help customers translate their data and AI ambitions into practical, actionable architectures. This role asks you to go both deep and wide: deep on the trusted data and agent foundation that everything else depends on, and wide across the ecosystem on which your customers actually run their business — because real architecture lives at the seams between systems, not inside any single product.
 

What You’ll Do

  • Share a clear point of view on enterprise data and AI — how agents, data platforms, CRM, trust, identity, workflow, governance, and adoption come together into something that delivers value through Salesforce.
  • Deeply understand our data & AI products and articulate the value of the Salesforce platform.
  • Partner with sellers and solution teams to uncover customers' real problems, shape technical strategy, and pressure-test feasibility and cost-to-serve early.
  • Lead customer architectural discussions around Data 360, Agentforce, data structures and patterns, AI readiness, identity management, governance, integration, automation, and business value.
  • Build customer confidence through demos, prototypes, proofs of concept, reference patterns, and architectural walkthroughs that demonstrate what's real as well as what it will take to operationalize and scale.
  • Continuously scan the horizon and tinker to refine your judgement on what's worth building and how to build within the data and AI space.
  • Turn what you learn in the field into reusable assets, enablement, best practices, and product feedback that extend your impact beyond your immediate teams and stakeholders.

You are a builder as much as an advisor. You are comfortable picking up new tools and technology, and are not afraid to get hands-on. You can craft and deliver an engaging story and also pressure-test the architecture behind it. You go deep without getting lost and wide without getting shallow. You bring field presence and credibility across a range of levels with your ability to effectively engage customer executives, enterprise architects, data platform owners, security and governance leaders, technical practitioners, sellers, partners, and delivery stakeholders.

  • 7+ years experience in technical architecture, enterprise architecture, solution engineering, consulting, implementation, software engineering, product development, or related work in complex enterprise environments.
  • A track record of shaping technical strategy with input from customers and /or stakeholders, validating solution approaches, and connecting business needs to technology decisions.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data, AI, integration, governance, security, privacy, and platform architecture concepts and patterns.
  • Experience working across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and delivery or customer teams to move solutions from idea to execution.

  • Demonstrated curiosity and learning velocity in emerging technologies — especially within the AI, data, automation, and agentic systems space.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, other STEM degrees or equivalent work experience. Graduate study a plus.

Helpful Experience

We care most about architectural judgment, learning velocity, and stakeholder impact. Experience with any of the following technologies and functions is a plus:
 

  • Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud), Agentforce, MuleSoft, Tableau, Informatica, or the broader Salesforce Platform.
  • Conversational AI, voice-enabled AI agents, real-time voice orchestration, telephony integrations, or multi-channel service experiences.
  • Modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or RedShift, and the hyperscaler ecosystems around them.
  • AI agents, generative AI, AI governance and observability, external agent ecosystems, hyperscaler AI services, or enterprise automation.
  • Programming languages such as Python, common data structures and tooling, and AI-assisted development pipelines.
  • Building demos, prototypes, proofs of concept, workshops, reference architectures, or field enablement assets.

The Architect Who Thrives Here

You will thrive as part of our team if you seek to understand customers' real problems, not just the stated requirements. You are curious about how organizations work, where data and processes break down, where AI can create leverage, and how businesses need to evolve to succeed. You are a leader who confidently defines the what, how, and why, and challenges the status quo when you see a better path. You are excited about AI while remaining grounded in what makes it work well: trusted data, clear use cases, strong architectures, governance, adoption, and demonstrable value.

We serve as the trusted point of contact for Slack’s strategic key customers across the customer lifecycle. Part coach, project manager, consultant, and product specialist, our Slack CSMs work closely with customers to discover their business needs and challenges and then mentor them on the best ways to use Slack to tackle them.

  • Conduct maturity assessments and build Slack adoption roadmaps.

  • Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer’s business.

  • Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.

  • Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.

Cloud/Platform Requirements - INCLUDED with the above:: 

  • 3-4 years of direct experience working on Slack; familiarity with Slack best practices and an understanding of how Slack enables modern workplace collaboration.

  • Slack Certified Admin Certification 

    Additional Salesforce product certifications are a plus (AI Associate, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Data 360 Specialist, Agentblazer).

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our elite Public Sector team at Salesforce. This is a unique and high-impact position, blending the roles of a technologist and strategic partner. In this role, you will be at the forefront of bringing cutting-edge AI and other transformative solutions to life for mission-critical work across the U.S. Department of Defense, Intelligence Community (IC), and Aerospace & Allied Nations.

This isn't a typical engineering job. It's for those who want to roll up their sleeves and make a tangible difference. You will work directly with mission owners and internal teams to design, develop, and implement bespoke solutions—from AI and enterprise business systems to analytics, field operations, and logistics. You'll use our Agentforce platform and other technologies to tackle our customers' most complex problems, driving tangible value from initial concept to successful deployment and ongoing optimization. This role is a fusion of mission, product, and innovation, where your technical mastery and problem-solving skills will help shape and deliver Salesforce's most strategic national security and allied defense programs while influencing our platform's roadmap.

Mission Impact:
 
  • Deploy Cutting-Edge Commercial Innovation—from Slack-based AI agents to Data Cloud analytics to field service automation—into defense, intelligence, and aerospace environments, accelerating transformation and outcomes.
  • Become a Trusted Partner and Collaborate Directly with End-Users in classified and unclassified environments to deeply understand mission needs, operational challenges, and strategic goals and translate them into technical implementations using Salesforce's multi-cloud portfolio.
  • Drive Innovation by serving as a connective bridge between customer missions and Salesforce engineering. You'll gather frontline feedback and help co-design features and capabilities that strengthen national security outcomes.
  • Improve Efficiency, Mission-Readiness, and Trust by helping the U.S. and allied governments deploy technology that delivers faster response times, better personnel utilization, and more effective logistics and asset management.
  • Drive Tangible Outcomes through Hands-On Implementation and end-to-end technical delivery of AI solutions, personally writing code, configuring systems, and troubleshooting issues to ensure successful deployment and measurable business impact.
  • Build Transformative AI Solutions by designing, developing, and personally implementing high-quality, scalable production systems. A significant part of this will involve leveraging AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to create intelligent agents and automate workflows, all built on top of the Salesforce platform.
  • Direct Ownership of Data Configuration & Integration from end-to-end. You'll design robust data models, build efficient processing pipelines, and establish seamless integration strategies to ingest, transform, and analyze complex datasets. Your work will ensure data is protected and always ready and optimized for our AI applications.
  • Drive Agentforce Innovation by becoming an expert in our innovative agentic platform. You'll directly push its capabilities to the limit, developing bespoke intelligent agents, automating intricate business processes, and crafting intuitive user experiences that deliver tangible value.
  • Conduct Deep-Dive Technical Debugging and detailed analysis of complex system interactions, data flows, and AI model behaviors to optimize performance and ensure reliability.
  • Prototype and Iterate Rapidly to develop proofs-of-concept and minimum viable products, coding alongside client teams to demonstrate capabilities and gather feedback for iterative refinement.
  • Implement Best Practices for code quality, scalability, security, and maintainability across all deployed solutions.


We're looking for a builder, a problem solver, and a mission-first engineer with a passion for public service.

What You'll Actually Be Doing
 
  • Serve as the technical advisor on high-profile customer engagements—designing, building, and deploying tailored Salesforce solutions for defense, intelligence, and aerospace missions.
  • Partner with internal product and engineering teams to co-develop new platform features that address real-world public sector and IL5/IL6 operational requirements.
  • Facilitate integration of AI/ML models, custom data pipelines, and automation flows that enable predictive maintenance, personnel planning, and mission-critical logistics decisions.
  • Enable customers to adopt Salesforce for field operations, asset visibility, command center operations, and secure collaboration through Slack and Government Cloud Plus.
  • Work with customer IT/security teams to accelerate Authority to Operate (ATO) and production go-lives per DoD IL5/IL6 and other regulatory frameworks.
  • Share lessons learned with the broader Salesforce community to shape playbooks, prototypes, and reusable assets for government innovation.
  • Partner with mission stakeholders to translate operational priorities into actionable technical roadmaps and Salesforce solutions aligned with agency strategy.


You're Our Person If...
 
  • 3-7 years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or systems integration.
  • Strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline.
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., JavaScript, Java, Python, Apex).
  • Proven track record of hands-on, end-to-end delivery of high-quality, scalable production solutions in a professional environment.
  • Hands-on experience building solutions with AI/LLM technologies, including integrating LLMs, applying AI orchestration frameworks, and prompt engineering techniques.
  • Experience with data integration, API design, ETL, and AI/ML model deployment.
  • Familiarity with analytics, data warehouses, and operational dashboards (e.g. Tableau, CRM Analytics, Snowflake).
  • Experience working in or adjacent to secure environments.
  • Ability to work in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with high levels of independence.
  • Strong communication skills, capable of engaging directly with users, executives, and engineers, with a collaborative mindset, bias for action, and customer obsession.
  • Ability to travel 25-50% of the time, as needed to customer sites.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) living on U.S. soil who does not hold dual citizenship with the ability to meet customer and government screening standards applicable to this role.
  • Active TS/SCI with Polygraph required


Even Better If...
 
  • Experience supporting U.S. Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), or Federal Civilian agencies.
  • Background in defense/aerospace industries or operational military/logistics experience.
  • Familiarity with IL5/IL6/CNSS #1253 requirements or deployment to classified environments.
  • Direct experience with the Salesforce platform, including configuration, customization, and development.
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Agentforce platform.
  • Experience developing conversational AI solutions within regulated industries.
  • Salesforce platform certifications (e.g., Administrator, Platform Developer I, Architect, Agentforce Specialist).

title: Pre-Sales Data and AI Architect - Solution Engineering (United States)
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Team

We are a Data & AI Architects team focused on helping customers understand what this new AI era makes possible, and what it actually takes to make the possible a reality: the right architecture, a trusted data foundation, a clear operating model, and an adoption path that scales. We work in the field, close to customers, close to our Agentforce and Data 360 sellers, and close to Product, Engineering, Support, and delivery teams. We are expected to know the domain, understand the wider ecosystem, bring a strong point of view, and help guide the architectural decisions that turn AI ambition into trusted business outcomes.

We are looking for architects who love hard problems, think in systems, and are energized by the transformation AI is driving across organizations. We value people who understand how the whole landscape fits together and where Salesforce creates the most leverage within it.
 

About the Role

As a Data & AI Technical Architect, you are the expert thought leader and senior field specialist for customers evaluating, implementing, and expanding their use of Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud), Agentforce, and the broader enterprise data and AI ecosystem.

Your work sits at the intersection of technical architectural, solution engineering, applied data and AI, and delivery-aware judgment on what it takes to make a solution succeed. You help customers translate their data and AI ambitions into practical, actionable architectures. This role asks you to go both deep and wide: deep on the trusted data and agent foundation that everything else depends on, and wide across the ecosystem on which your customers actually run their business — because real architecture lives at the seams between systems, not inside any single product.
 

What You’ll Do

  • Share a clear point of view on enterprise data and AI — how agents, data platforms, CRM, trust, identity, workflow, governance, and adoption come together into something that delivers value through Salesforce.
  • Deeply understand our data & AI products and articulate the value of the Salesforce platform.
  • Partner with sellers and solution teams to uncover customers' real problems, shape technical strategy, and pressure-test feasibility and cost-to-serve early.
  • Lead customer architectural discussions around Data 360, Agentforce, data structures and patterns, AI readiness, identity management, governance, integration, automation, and business value.
  • Build customer confidence through demos, prototypes, proofs of concept, reference patterns, and architectural walkthroughs that demonstrate what's real as well as what it will take to operationalize and scale.
  • Continuously scan the horizon and tinker to refine your judgement on what's worth building and how to build within the data and AI space.
  • Turn what you learn in the field into reusable assets, enablement, best practices, and product feedback that extend your impact beyond your immediate teams and stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

You are a builder as much as an advisor. You are comfortable picking up new tools and technology, and are not afraid to get hands-on. You can craft and deliver an engaging story and also pressure-test the architecture behind it. You go deep without getting lost and wide without getting shallow. You bring field presence and credibility across a range of levels with your ability to effectively engage customer executives, enterprise architects, data platform owners, security and governance leaders, technical practitioners, sellers, partners, and delivery stakeholders.
 

Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in technical architecture, enterprise architecture, solution engineering, consulting, implementation, software engineering, product development, or related work in complex enterprise environments.
  • A track record of shaping technical strategy with input from customers and /or stakeholders, validating solution approaches, and connecting business needs to technology decisions.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data, AI, integration, governance, security, privacy, and platform architecture concepts and patterns.
  • Experience working across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and delivery or customer teams to move solutions from idea to execution.
  • The ability to distill and communicate complex technical ideas to executive and technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and learning velocity in emerging technologies — especially within the AI, data, automation, and agentic systems space.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, other STEM degrees or equivalent work experience. Graduate study a plus.

Helpful Experience

We care most about architectural judgment, learning velocity, and stakeholder impact. Experience with any of the following technologies and functions is a plus:

In this high-impact role as a senior technical individual contributor, you will bridge the gap between raw data systems and the agentic layer driving true business impact. You will architect, build, and scale the foundational data pipelines and data graphs that ground our AI agents in accurate, real-time, high-context data. By ensuring absolute data quality, reliability, and freshness, and partnering across engineering, data science, and product teams, you will create the unified data backbone that powers Agentforce's personalized, intelligent customer interactions.

What You'll Do
Data Architecture & Development: Build the data architecture and catalog for AI consumption and human augmentation, leading with precision, rigor, and scale.
Customer Graphs & Identity: Build on top of identity graphs, overlaying structured, unstructured, and real-time insights to power agentic systems and human-facing applications.
Operational Excellence: Establish and enforce rigorous technical standards for data quality, latency, and index freshness, ensuring AI agents provide reliable, real-time insights.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering leaders, product managers, decision scientists, and data scientists to translate complex business needs into scalable, production-ready solutions.
AI Integration & Automation: Lead high-impact initiatives to automate data delivery pipelines, ensuring seamless integration across internal databases, third-party APIs, and the AI orchestration layer.
Software Engineering: Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, embedding AI tools into your daily workflow to deliver secure, optimized code.
Code Quality Assurance: Critically evaluate both human and AI-generated code for correctness, quality, security, and performance.
On-Call Support: Participate in the team's on-call rotation to triage production data issues in real time, keeping critical services highly available.

Required Qualifications
Experience: 6+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a closely related technical role.
Data Architecture & Orchestration: Proficiency in data modeling, data graphs, and building robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest and transform heterogeneous data sources using tools like Airflow and dbt.
Graph Databases: Practical experience designing, querying, and managing graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune) to support highly interconnected data structures and knowledge graphs.
Technical Stack: Strong command of core data engineering tools and languages, specifically Python, SQL, and Spark.
Cloud & Warehousing: Hands-on experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and modern cloud data warehousing solutions like Snowflake.
Problem-Solving: Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex, production-level data issues.
Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and a proven ability to collaborate in a cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications
Salesforce Ecosystem: Hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform, specifically Salesforce Data Cloud.
AI-First Engineering Mindset: A demonstrated approach to utilizing AI to accelerate development speed, build full-stack fluency, and contribute across broader engineering specialties.
AI Developer Tooling: Proficiency in embedding modern AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) directly into your daily development workflows.

The Experience

We are seeking a Product Marketing Sr Manager – Sales Enablement to lead cross-functional partnerships and the development and activation of field-facing content for the Customer Zero program.

Customer Zero is how Salesforce shares its own transformation into an Agentic Enterprise and creates repeatable blueprints for customers to follow. This role will ensure those stories are not only compelling, but usable and impactful in real sales conversations and other field programs.

You will partner closely with the Senior Director of Customer Zero, sales leaders, event teams and product marketing leads to understand what the field actually needs to engage customers, build credibility, and close deals. You will translate Customer Zero stories into high-quality, practical assets, from first-call decks to executive briefings, demos, and case studies, tailored for different audiences and buying stages.

Success in this role requires strong storytelling, deep empathy for both customers and sellers, and the ability to operate cross-functionally across marketing, product, sales, and customer teams to deliver content that is both strategic and actionable.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • Flexibility, Creativity and Curiosity: Be able to listen deeply and continuously, taking in signals from multiple channels, shifting thinking and pivoting strategy and tactics to fit the needs of the team, the customers and the field. Be passionately enthusiastic about what could be possible and constantly learning new things to find ways to make it happen.
  • Sales Enablement Strategy & Field Partnership: Build strong relationships with sales leaders, sellers, and field enablement teams to listen and understand what content is needed, what formats are most effective, and what actually gets used in customer conversations. Translate field insights into a clear sales enablement strategy for Customer Zero. Continuously gather feedback and iterate on assets to improve adoption and effectiveness.
  • Customer Zero Story Activation for Sales: Translate Customer Zero transformation stories into sales-ready materials, including first-call decks; executive briefing presentations (CIO, CEO, CMO, COO, heads of Sales/Service, etc.); case studies and narrative summaries; demo scripts and supporting materials; and video content. Ensure content is tailored to specific personas and buying stages, clearly communicates business value and outcomes, and connects Salesforce capabilities to real-world transformation.
  • Content Development & Customization: Develop, maintain and evolve a library of high-impact, reusable enablement assets. Adapt core narratives into role-based versions, different levels of technical depth, and various form factors to fit each channel. Ensure content is clear and easy for sellers to use, modular and adaptable, and consistent with Salesforce messaging and positioning.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Customer Zero program leadership, product marketing, sales enablement, customer success and internal practitioners, and events and campaign teams. Ensure alignment between messaging, story development, campaigns, sales activation and event execution.
  • Demos & Experiential Content: Collaborate to develop and build clickable and video demos. Ensure demos clearly show how Salesforce teams use its technology to enable transformation and the connection between product capabilities and business outcomes. Connect how Salesforce’s implementation applies to other industries and companies of different sizes.
  • AI-Enabled Scale & Efficiency: Leverage AI to accelerate content creation and iteration, tailor content for different personas and use cases, synthesize feedback and identify content gaps, and do things we could never do before. Build scalable tools (e.g., templates, prompt libraries, reusable frameworks) that enable sellers to self-serve content in the flow of work as well as through portals, and consistency across the organization.
  • Measurement & Adoption: Track usage and effectiveness of Customer Zero field assets and program impact. Partner with sales enablement to measure adoption and impact on pipeline and deal progression. Continuously refine content based on feedback and performance.

  • 6–10+ years of experience in product marketing, field enablement, or related roles
  • Strong understanding of enterprise sales processes and buyer journeys
  • Experience working at a large enterprise organization building relationships across teams and geographies

  • Experience working with executive-level audiences and tailoring messaging for different personas and presenting in front of company leaders
  • Strong storytelling and communication skills

title: Mulesoft Account Executive, Mission Programs – Department of War (DOW)
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Salesforce is looking for a Mulesoft Mission Programs Account Executive to serve as the primary domain expert within DOW and the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). Your mission is to bridge the gap between Mulesoft's industry-leading technology and the complex operational requirements of the Department of War (DOW).
You are not a traditional salesperson; you are a Mission Programs Partner. You will use your deep experience in the DOW and DIB operations—likely gained through military service, business development, or capture management—to help navigate the "mission-speak" of Defense Services, identify high-value operational gaps, and position Mulesoft as the engine to enable a unified layer that connects data at the edge within large mission programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Mission Mapping: Translate complex operational needs (e.g., Joint All-Domain Command & Control (JADC2), Theater Posture, Logistics, Readiness) into Mulesoft and Informatica technical solutions.
  • Capture & Influence: Support the capture process by shaping requirements before the RFP is released. You will help "pre-wire" the mission value proposition with key stakeholders within the DIB. Also support post-award of a program to position Mulesoft and Informatica as key components to improve the defense program.
  • Executive Presence: Serve as a peer-level advisor to DOW and DIB leadership, demonstrating a deep understanding of the Services and Industry.
  • Programmatic Thought Leadership: Develop "Mission Plays"—repeatable frameworks for how Mulesoft and Informatica can solve specific DOW problems, from personnel readiness to real-time asset tracking in contested environments.
  • Ecosystem Orchestration: Work with System Integrators (SIs) and mission partners to ensure Salesforce is integrated into the broader digital battlefield architecture.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Salesforce "Core" AEs to provide the integration layer that powers CRM, Tableau, and Slack mission sets.
  • Complex Stakeholder Management: Navigate the "Three-Legged Stool" of defense sales: the DOW end-user, the Service Component, and the Systems Integrator (SI) executing the program.

Required Qualifications

  • Deep DOW Domain Expertise: Minimum of 5+ years of experience working within or directly supporting DOW. You understand the hierarchy, the funding flows (FYDP), and the operational "pain points."
  • MuleSoft/Middleware Domain Expertise: 5+ years of experience selling Integration (iPaaS), API Management, or Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) solutions. You must understand how to sell "the plumbing" as a strategic mission asset.
  • The "Translator" Ability: Proven ability to translate military operational requirements into digital transformation strategies.
  • Capture or BD Background: Experience in Federal Business Development or Capture Management, specifically winning large-scale programs within the DOW.
  • SaaS & Hybrid Cloud Fluency: Proven success selling subscription-based software within the DOW. Knowledge of FedRAMP High, IL5, and IL6 security architectures is non-negotiable.
  • Clearance: Active Secret clearance required; TS/SCI preferred.

Preferred Experience

  • Technical Credibility: Ability to engage in high-level architectural discussions about Microservices, Service Mesh, and Zero Trust Architecture.
  • Former Military Leadership: Retired O-5+ or Senior NCO with experience in DOW preferred.
  • Industry Advisory: Prior experience as an Industry Advisor or "Mission Lead" at a major systems integrator or cloud service provider.
  • Outcome-Oriented: A track record of closing $1M+ ACV deals by focusing on mission outcomes (e.g., "reducing data latency") rather than just technical features.
  • Network: An established network of contacts within the DOW and DIB.
This candidate must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) who does not hold dual citizenship and agrees to complete a U.S. federal government Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for a Moderate Public Trust position.

title: Customer Success Manager , Associate/Senior Associate (Technical)
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

カスタマーサクセスマネージャー（CSM）は、深いビジネス、業界、および製品の知識を活用して顧客とパートナーシップを結び、ビジネス価値を加速させ、Salesforceへの投資対効果を最大化できるよう導きます。この役割において、CSMは特定のクラウドの専門性や業界知見をもとに、社内リソースをオーケストレーションし、お客様と同じ目線で語り合い、顧客価値の実現を中長期的に図ります。

理想的なカスタマーサクセスマネージャーは、お客様の言葉で対話できるクラウドの専門知識と業界スキルの両方を備えた人物です。

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • 目標の理解と提案: 当社のカスタマーサクセス・メソドロジーを活用し、お客様のステークホルダーと連携して目標を理解し、彼らの能力を評価した上で、ビジネスおよびテクノロジーの目標達成を加速させるための提案を行う
  • Salesforceの啓蒙: お客様のSalesforce導入状況に対する理解と知識を深め、当社のすべてのクラウドにおけるSalesforceの機能をエバンジェライズ（啓蒙）する。
  • ベストプラクティスの提示: お客様のニーズに基づき、組織戦略、ガバナンス、およびチェンジマネジメント（変革管理）のベストプラクティスについて顧客を導く。
  • リスクの特定と軽減: お客様が掲げるビジネス目標の達成を阻害するリスクをプロアクティブに特定し、アカウントチームと連携してリスク軽減計画を策定する。
  • 実践的な製品知識の提供: プラットフォームの機能や特長をお客様のビジネスの優先事項やロードマップに適用することで、Salesforce製品に関する実践的な知識を示す。
  • テクニカルインサイトの提供によるCustomer Enablementの推進: 製品アップデートや障害、サポート終了（EOL）等の技術情報を「顧客の価値」へと翻訳し、IT/業務部門がテクノロジーを最大限に活用できるよう伴走、支援する。
  • 定着化計画の策定・実行: 現状、タイムラインを伴う目標とする将来像、およびその基盤となるイネーブルメント（定着・活用化）計画を示す、包括的なアダプション（定着化）パスを作成し、実行する。
  • 価値とイノベーションの提供: お客様の主要なビジネス課題と成長の可能性を理解し、お客様のビジネスに価値とイノベーションを提供する。



You’re Our Person If...

  • カスタマーサクセス、テクノロジーコンサルティング、エンタープライズアーキテクチャ、またはテクノロジーソリューション開発、サポートエンジニアにおける3年以上の経験
  • 情熱 (PASSION): カスタマーサクセスに対して情熱を持っていること。
  • 信頼 (TRUST): 信頼を第一に行動していること。
  • 適応力 (ADAPTABLE): 不確実性が高く、変化の激しい環境において優れた成果を上げられること。



Even Better If...

  • 特定のクラウドにおける深い知識。
  • 顧客のビジネス価値を推進する「Trusted Advisor」として働いた実績と強力なコンサルティングスキル
  • Salesforce製品およびプラットフォームの機能、性能、ベストプラクティスに関する理解があることが望まれる。
  • 技術的およびビジネス上の概念を迅速に理解し、明確に説明できる能力。
  • 以下の経験・知識のうち、少なくとも1つを有すること：
  • ビジネスプロセス（営業、サービス、マーケティング、サポート）、ビジネスアプリケーション、および自動化に関する深い知識。
  • AIおよび機械学習の概念の理解、エージェントプラットフォームの理解、エージェントの構成および展開方法に関する深い知識。
  • エンタープライズレベルのソフトウェア開発ライフサイクルやプロジェクトマネジメント経験。（コーディングの経験は有用ですが、必須ではありません）
  • インテグレーション、フローや自動化、API接続などへの統合方法についての知識。
  • クラウドコンピューティングで使用される、ミドルウェア、インフラ知識（例：データベース、ネットワークの基礎知識など）に関する深い理解。
  • 流暢な日本語および基礎的な読み書きができる英語力。
  • 高度な英語力、韓国語力、中国語力（関連部門と業務遂行できるレベル）があると尚良い。


【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】


株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。
弊社では「Equality（平等）」をコアバリューの一つとして掲げ、性別やライフステージに関わらず、すべての社員が能力を最大限に発揮できるインクルーシブな環境づくりを推進しています。社内コミュニティ「Salesforce Women’s Network（SWN）」をはじめとするネットワーキングやキャリア形成支援、メンターシップ制度も活発に稼働しています。

【働き方・ワークライフバランスの推進】


ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。
フレックスタイム制度: コアタイムにとらわれない柔軟なスケジュール調整が可能で、育児や介護、個人のプライベートな事情に応じた働き方を尊重しています。
充実した両立支援制度: 産前産後休暇・育児休業（女性の復職率は非常に高く、男性社員の育休取得実績も多数）、復職後の短時間勤務や看護・介護休暇など、ライフステージの変化に寄り添う各種サポートプログラムが整っています。
ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。



The Experience

A Customer Success Manager (CSM) partners with customers, drawing on deep business, industry, and product knowledge to accelerate business value and guide them to maximize their return on investment in Salesforce. In this role, CSMs use their cloud expertise and industry insight to orchestrate internal resources, speak with customers as true partners, and deliver customer value over the medium to long term.

The ideal Customer Success Manager brings both cloud expertise and industry skills, and can engage with customers in their own language.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • Understand goals and make recommendations: Use our Customer Success methodology to work with customer stakeholders, understand their goals, assess their capabilities, and make recommendations that accelerate their business and technology goals
  • Evangelize Salesforce: Build understanding of the customer’s Salesforce adoption, and evangelize Salesforce capabilities across all of our clouds.
  • Present best practices: Guide customers on best practices in organizational strategy, governance, and change management based on their needs.
  • Identify and mitigate risks: Proactively identify risks that could prevent customers from achieving their business goals, and work with the account team to develop risk mitigation plans.
  • Provide hands-on product knowledge: Demonstrate practical knowledge of Salesforce products by applying platform capabilities and features to the customer’s business priorities and roadmap.
  • Drive Customer Enablement through technical insights: Translate technical information such as product updates, incidents, and end-of-life (EOL) into customer value, and work alongside IT and business teams to help them get the most out of the technology.
  • Create and execute adoption plans: Create and execute a comprehensive adoption path that sets out the current state, a target future state with timelines, and the underlying enablement plan.
  • Deliver value and innovation: Understand the customer’s key business challenges and growth potential, and deliver value and innovation to their business.



You’re Our Person If...

  • PASSION: Passionate about customer success.
  • TRUST: Acts with trust as the first priority.
  • ADAPTABLE: Delivers excellent results in highly uncertain, fast-changing environments.

  • Understanding of Salesforce products and platform capabilities, performance, and best practices is desirable.
  • Ability to quickly grasp and clearly explain technical and business concepts.
  • Experience or knowledge in at least one of the following:
  • Deep knowledge of business processes (sales, service, marketing, support), business applications, and automation.
  • Understanding of AI and machine learning concepts and agent platforms, and deep knowledge of how to configure and deploy agents.
  • Enterprise-level software development lifecycle or project management experience. (Coding experience is useful but not required)

Our mission: make any developer a performance engineer through a low-code, intuitive test automation experience.

The Role: We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to led the Scale Test product. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the intersection of platform engineering, enterprise customer success, and AI-driven testing innovation.

You won't just manage a backlog — you'll be a strategic owner who deeply understands how our largest customers architect and test their Salesforce implementations, translates that into a compelling product roadmap, and drives Scale Test toward its next phase of growth across Agentforce, Partners, and GovCloud.

  • Serve as the primary PM interface for enterprise customers running Scale Test, working closely with them through complex, time-sensitive testing windows to gather deep technical feedback
  • Partner with ISVs, SIs, and GovCloud customers to understand their unique testing requirements (e.g., data residency, compliance, FedRamp) and drive feature development accordingly
  • Translate complex enterprise customer scenarios — from Hyperforce migrations to Agentforce go-lives to peak load events — into clear, prioritized product specs and user stories



Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the prioritized roadmap for Scale Test — covering test plan creation, test scheduler, test execution, load generation, UI script recorder/builder, and AI-powered features (Scale Agent, AI Script Healing)
  • Own end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Scale Test across multiple engineering teams (managed load generation, analytics platform, DevOps integration)
  • Define and drive the Agentforce testing strategy — understanding how customers build and validate Agentforce implementations at scale and driving features to support their go-lives
  • Lead the Vibe Testing capabilities roadmap: enabling PMs, admins, and non-engineers to intuitively define, run, and interpret performance tests through natural language and AI-guided flows — reducing reliance on scripting expertise and democratizing scale testing across teams
  • Drive the Pilot-to-GA pipeline for cutting-edge capabilities including Scale Agent (AI assistant for test analysis), Load Generation, and AI Script Healing
  • Stay ahead of industry trends in performance testing, AI/Agentforce workload patterns, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise DevOps practices



Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work across Salesforce product teams (Agentforce, Data Cloud, Hyperforce, Platform) to ensure Scale Test integrates effectively and is positioned as a required step in every major go-live
  • Partner with Sales, AEs, CSMs, and Solution Architects on GTM strategies — including sales plays, competitive positioning, customer enablement, and new market expansion

Execution & Delivery

  • Drive sprint planning, feature scoping, and launch readiness across engineering and research teams

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or technical field; MBA or Master's degree in Business, Product Management, or related field a plus
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex, technically deep products end-to-end — from discovery through launch and iteration
  • Strong technical fluency — ability to engage meaningfully with engineering on infrastructure, load generation, APIs, and system design without needing to code
  • Track record of working directly with enterprise customers to surface insights and drive product improvements — ideally in performance-critical or platform contexts
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills — equally comfortable in an engineering sprint review, a customer-facing demo, and an executive business review
  • Ability to operate autonomously in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and make high-quality decisions with incomplete information
  • Prior experience with performance testing, load testing, or developer tooling products (e.g., LoadRunner, JMeter, or similar)
  • Agentic testing experience — you've built or managed products that test AI agents, agentic workflows, or autonomous systems; you understand how to validate quality, reliability, and performance for non-deterministic AI systems
  • Deep technical fluency across performance testing, load generation, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes), and SaaS architecture — able to engage deeply with engineering teams and communicate clearly to executive audiences
  • Experience with testing/observability/monitoring products — you've built or managed products in the DevOps toolchain (load testing, APM, observability, CI/CD, test automation)



Even Better If...

  • Experience with Salesforce developer tooling or platform products — DevOps Center, Code Analyzer, Optimizer, CLI, VS Code extensions, or similar DX products
