The Experience

We are looking for a Senior Offensive AI Security Researcher with a strong offensive security and research mindset to lead novel adversarial research across Salesforce’s AI ecosystem - uncovering critical and systemic vulnerabilities before they can be exploited.

This role goes beyond finding individual bugs - it focuses on scoping, designing, and executing advanced research into emerging AI threat vectors, combining academic research with practical offensive methodologies to establish new TTPs targeting complex AI paradigms, including indirect prompt injection, tool abuse/excessive agency, RAG system poisoning, data extraction, and model/data supply chain compromises.

You will work as a trusted partner to engineering and architecture teams - providing an offensive security perspective that shapes internal threat models, guides AI architecture decisions, supports corporate governance, and directly contributes to Salesforce’s Generative AI Security Standard.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • Lead Novel AI Security Research: Scope, design, and execute advanced adversarial research across Salesforce’s AI ecosystem, applying a risk-based approach to uncover novel threat vectors before exploitation.
  • Innovate & Operationalize AI Attack Techniques: Combine academic research with practical offensive methodologies to establish new TTPs targeting complex AI paradigms- specifically indirect prompt injection, tool abuse/excessive agency, RAG system poisoning, data extraction, and model/data supply chain compromises.
  • Guide Strategy & Security Standards: Provide an offensive security perspective to guide AI architecture, shape internal threat models, support corporate governance, and directly contribute to Salesforce’s Generative AI Security Standard.
  • Disseminate Research: Publish internal and external threat intelligence, vulnerability analyses, and security research to keep Salesforce defenses aligned with state-of-the-art AI threat landscapes.



You’re Our Person If...

  • 5+ years of experience in offensive security roles (vulnerability research, penetration testing, application security, or security engineering).
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience auditing, breaking, or researching ML/AI systems, with deep expertise in LLM attack surfaces and frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS).
  • Deep technical understanding of modern AI design patterns, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), autonomous agentic workflows, model context protocols, and AI pipelines.
  • High degree of proficiency in Python for exploit proof-of-concept development, data analysis, and technical evaluation.
  • Proven track record of leading complex security initiatives and communicating critical, high-stakes technical risks to both research engineers and executive leadership.



Even Better If...

  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • A public portfolio of offensive security research, including conference presentations (e.g., Black Hat, DEF CON, NeurIPS), published papers, CVEs, advisories, or open-source research contributions.
  • Experience auditing modern AI development ecosystems and tools (e.g., PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, vector databases, or open-weight models).

大きく2つの役割があります。

顧客へのプロジェクト提案 アカウントパートナー（サービスセールス担当者）と連携して、SalesforceのProfessional Servicesによる自律型AI（Agentic AI）ソリューションやコンサルティングプロジェクト、インプリメンテーションプロジェクト等の提案を行い、受注前および受注後の提案活動を主導します。 特にプロジェクト提案にあたって、顧客の課題、Agentic Enterprise化に向けた変革プロジェクトの目的からAIと人が共創する最適なプロジェクトアプローチを策定すること、必要なサービスリソースやAI領域の専門知識を特定するために、アカウントパートナーだけでなく組織全体の他の専門領域のメンバーと協力することが求められます。

プロジェクト成功に導くリーダーシップ プロジェクト受注後にインダストリーまたはデリバリーのエキスパートとしてプロジェクト全体を推進、または支援し、プロジェクトを成功させること、最終的に顧客の持続的な価値創出に導くことに責任を持ちます。 顧客のエグゼクティブとの関係を構築・維持すること、プロアクティブにプロジェクトの品質やAIによる変革効果を高めること、また組織全体のAIアーキテクトや専門領域のメンバーと協力することで必要な知見等をプロジェクトにもたらすよう働きかけることが求められます。

主に金融領域（銀行・証券・保険および関連事業等）を中心とした顧客に対するAI主導の業務変革を含むコンサルティングビジネスの拡大に貢献いただきます。 このロールでは、組織の関係者と協業しながら、顧客との関係性をどう構築するのか、SalesforceのProfessional ServicesをどうSellingするのかを裁量を持って働くことができます。 AIや最先端テクノロジーを取り入れた戦略的で自由な発想を活かし、Agentic Enterprise時代を牽引する次のSalesforce Servicesのビジネスを作り上げる意欲のある方を採用したいと考えています。

  • 複数の戦略的顧客を同時にマネジメントし、新しい潜在顧客のリファレンスになりそうなプロジェクトを意図的に構築・実行することで、ビジネス拡大に貢献します。
  • 重要なエスカレーションやリスクのあるアカウントに対して、AI導入に伴うリスクや変革課題を含め、将来を見越したリスクの軽減やマネジメントをします。
  • 社内外のリーダーや幹部と効果的、且つ適切にコミュニケーションします。



Even Better If...

  • 10年以上のコンサルティングサービスのデリバリー経験、または同等以上の事業会社での経験（グループITの内製化組織の立ち上げ、実行、マネジメント、事業会社内部での変革プロジェクト・DXおよびAI変革（AX）プロジェクト等の遂行等）

株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) focusing on Agentforce Operations, you are a hands-on Technical Builder who designs, constructs, and deploys enterprise-grade agentic AI solutions directly inside customer environments. AFO powers the multi-agent orchestration layer, transforming messy operational workflows, unstructured data (emails, PDFs, spec sheets), and legacy ERP logs into autonomous execution engines with humans in the loop.

Operating in an agile deployment pod alongside a Deployment Strategist and Specialized AI Engineers, you will serve as the crucial link connecting advanced AI agents to the broader enterprise technology landscape. You will write production code, architect real-time data grounding systems, perform prompt engineering, manage multi-agent communication protocols, and deploy automated supply chain and back-office workflows into production from day one.

What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Workflow & Multi-Agent Orchestration: Build, configure, and optimize complex operational workflows using AFO, defining agent reasoning, tool-calling logic, and conditional execution loops.

  • Agent Communication Protocols: Implement modern agent-to-agent communication standards and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to govern context sharing, task hand-offs, and tool execution across specialized AI agents.

  • Enterprise AI Grounding Systems: Architect, build, and maintain real-time data grounding infrastructure using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases to supply agents with accurate enterprise context.

  • Enterprise Integration & API Management: Develop and maintain custom APIs (REST, GraphQL, webhooks) and integration pipelines connecting AFO/Agentforce to Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360), cloud warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks), and core ERPs (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) via MuleSoft or custom middleware.

  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Leverage modern AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Vibes) embedded directly into your daily developer workflow to move from architecture sketch to deployable code in days, not months.

  • Telemetry & Observability: Model data, ship ETL/ELT pipelines, and build real-time agent performance dashboards to track execution health, fallback triggers, and business outcomes.

  • Field-to-Product Feedback: Serve as the direct connective bridge between frontline customer deployments and core Salesforce product/engineering teams to feed edge cases and gaps back into platform feature roadmaps.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production AI, data engineering, or enterprise integration system deployed to production.

  • High proficiency in at least one modern language: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex.

  • Hands-on AI & Grounding Expertise: Deep experience with LLM orchestration, prompt tuning, and building RAG pipelines, vector search indexes, and knowledge base retrievers for enterprise data.

  • Multi-Agent Systems & API Mastery: Practical experience with API design (REST/SOAP/webhooks) and modern agent protocols (e.g., MCP, tool calling, or event-driven messaging architectures).

  • Expertise in process orchestration and API-led connectivity using tools like MuleSoft or custom middleware to bridge AI agents with legacy ERP systems.

  • Solid understanding of data modeling, schema design, and asynchronous message integration patterns.

  • Strong executive presence - ability to whiteboard architecture with enterprise CTOs and VPs while writing production code alongside lead architects.

  • Familiarity with automation platforms (Pega, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, ServiceNow, Appian, Microsoft Power Platform) and competing enterprise AI and agent platforms (Microsoft Copilot Studio, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, IBM watsonx, Palantir AIP, ServiceNow AI Agents).

  • Experience with integrated enterprise applications (Workday, Coupa, Jira, Slack, major warehouse or transportation management systems) and deployment infrastructure (Kafka, AWS EventBridge, Azure Service Bus, GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform).

  • Knowledge of data governance and master data systems (Informatica, Collibra, SAP MDG, Reltio) and operational execution platforms (Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, Oracle transportation management).

  • Understanding of enterprise security and governance: Identity and access management, OAuth, data privacy, audit logging, permissioning, and secure tool execution.

  • Willingness to travel 25-30% for on-site deployment with key enterprise accounts.

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Salesforce Consultant with expertise in Commerce Cloud B2B and Order Management System (OMS) to provide our clients with strategic guidance, implementation, and support. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of B2B commerce and OMS processes and hands-on technical consulting experience in a major software domain, along with proficiency in both English and French languages.

Technical consultants demonstrate thought leadership in technical aspects of customer and partner engagements that lead to the successful delivery of solutions, including enterprise integrations using middleware tools and platforms. They will also identify and proactively handle risk areas, and commit to seeing issues through completion.

  • Design, configure, and customize Salesforce solutions to meet client needs, including but not limited to product catalog management, pricing, quoting, and order management processes.

  • Lead Salesforce implementation projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, and deployment. Provide ongoing support and maintenance for Salesforce Commerce Cloud (B2B and OMS) implementations, including troubleshooting issues and optimizing system performance.

  • Develop and deliver training sessions and documentation for clients to enable them to effectively utilize Salesforce solutions.

  • Stay current on Salesforce best practices and industry trends, particularly related to Commerce Cloud B2B and OMS, and proactively share knowledge with internal teams and clients.

title: Data360 FDE
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce's real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.
  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
  • You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
  • You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
  • You've built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
  • You've implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.
  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.
  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.
  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform.

*LI-Y

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Job Description: Product Management Director - Salesforce Success Plans


The Experience

The Customer Success (CS) Success Plan product management organization is responsible for managing Salesforce's Customer Success Plan offer portfolio (Standard, Premier, and Signature Success Plans) with which we enable our customers to realize value from their Salesforce technology investments. We work backward from the customer to address their needs across all customer segments (Small Business, Commercial, and Enterprise) and across all Salesforce products. The team is the "voice of the customer and market" to the rest of the CS organization and we work across all functions within CS and the Salesforce product organizations to continuously enhance the customer value and experience delivered by the Success Plans offer portfolio.

We're looking for a Product Management Director to build, justify, and operationalize changes to our Success Plans offers. This senior individual contributor (IC) role owns the path from evidence to execution: grounding decisions in customer and stakeholder research, developing and presenting the business cases — financial modeling included — that earn senior leadership alignment, and then owning the operating discipline that keeps those offers accountable once they're live, including feedback loops, performance reporting, and V2MOM updates. You'll also keep a close eye on industry trends, the market landscape, and Salesforce's AI roadmap, translating what you see into concrete implications, and drive growth and adoption of the Success Plan offers in market. This senior IC role reports to the Vice President, Product Management for Salesforce Success Plans.

Ideal candidates have deep Salesforce platform knowledge, proven Product Management experience (ideally in Customer Success), a strong record of turning strategy into actionable roadmaps, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Conduct customer and stakeholder research to understand needs, analyze feedback, and drive innovation.
  • Act as a thought leader and craft clear, concise and unbiased point of view documents on necessary changes to features, the portfolio, and the go-to-market (GTM) model.
  • Develop and present business cases for new offers or enhancements, including financial modeling, and secure senior leadership alignment.
  • Drive growth and adoption of the Success Plan offers
  • Own the operating rhythm behind the offer: feedback loops, offer performance reporting, and V2MOM updates, so the team stays accountable to its goals.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends, the market landscape, and Salesforce's own AI roadmap so you can proactively flag implications to Success Plans

  • Connect the Dots: You excel at systems thinking and can anticipate the second and third-order effects of a strategic decision. You naturally see how a change in one part of the business impacts another.
  • Proven Strategist: You have a background in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a product management role that was heavily focused on monetization and business strategy. You have a portfolio of work that demonstrates your ability to drive significant strategic change.
  • Exceptional Communicator: You are a clear, concise writer and presenter. You can create the definitive document that persuades executives and aligns disparate teams on a complex issue.
  • Problem-Solver at Heart: You are not content to simply identify problems; you are driven to design the solution and see it through.

  • 10+ years of product management experience, including packaging/pricing of B2B SaaS support, success, or services offerings

Salesforce's platforms — including Core CRM and Marketing Cloud — let companies build, deliver, monitor, and scale their engagement with customers globally. Not everyone uses that access responsibly. We're looking for a Platform Trust and Safety Engineer who is dedicated to identifying and stopping abusers who commit fraud, phishing, and account takeover, or who otherwise use our services to make the internet a hostile space.

The Platform Defense and Safety (PDS) team detects and responds to malicious user activity — misuse, abuse, fraud, and crime — that occurs even when our systems are working as designed. At any given time, bad actors attempt to bypass detection and response systems by posing as legitimate customers to take unfair advantage of our services. Unlike account compromise, abuse tends to be a slow, simmering problem rather than a single event.

The Experience
 

  • Extensive experience in information security roles involving platform abuse, threat intelligence, incident response, or threat detection
  • Experience managing security or abuse investigations end to end: triage, evidence collection, risk assessment, containment, escalation, and closure
  • Specialization in at least one of: log analysis, file-level forensics, or data mining
  • Experience authoring detection rules using languages such as YARA or Splunk SPL, and comfort working from a command line



What You'll Actually Be Doing
 

  • Review, triage, and respond to external and internal abuse reports across Core CRM and Marketing Cloud, with an eye toward expanding into new products
  • Build and tune detection and response rules in Splunk, and author and maintain automated response playbooks
  • Partner with our Office of Ethical Usage and Legal teams — including on regulatory reporting such as the EU Digital Services Act (DSA) — to keep our platforms free of malicious content
  • Identify and document anti-abuse tooling requirements for engineering teams, and evaluate third-party vendor tools to close detection gaps

As a Product Security Lead, you will be the technical security lead for the user-facing application and experience layers of the platform. This includes front-end frameworks, runtimes, and rendering surfaces, plus fast-growing AI agent experiences and web data-access surfaces that appear in our own products, third-party channels, and external agentic clients.

You will set the security bar for these areas by shaping how controls are designed and making secure patterns the default. With Agentforce woven into our platform, you will help define the trust model for the next generation of agent-driven experiences.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, or Seattle/Bellevue, WA, and is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Lead security assurance for the experience and user interface (UI) layer. Run threat modeling, security design reviews, and code review (JavaScript, TypeScript, and Java) across web frameworks, runtimes, rendering pipelines, and the data-access Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) beneath them. Design platform-level fixes for recurring weaknesses such as cross-site scripting (XSS), cross-site request forgery (CSRF), server-side request forgery (SSRF), injection, and broken access control.
  • Serve as the standing security lead for multi-release programs that span quarters and teams. Examples include expanding guest-user data access, rendering first-party experiences into third-party surfaces, and defining the trust model for agent-facing products.
  • Reduce AI and agentic risk. Address threats such as prompt injection, excessive agency, tool abuse, and memory poisoning. Design human approval steps for high-impact actions. Define least-privilege tool scoping, audit logging, and short-lived scoped credentials for Model Context Protocol (MCP) and connector integrations.
  • Set the standard and mentor others. Build secure patterns into frameworks, software development kits (SDKs), and rendering pipelines so unsafe code is hard to write. Author security guidelines that other teams adopt, and coach experienced developers on secure design.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 8+ years in product, application, or platform security, and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have deep expertise in web and application security, including the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP) injection classes, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, broken access control, and the browser security model.
  • You have hands-on experience securing modern UI frameworks, web runtimes, and rendering pipelines, including guest-user or unauthenticated surfaces.
  • You have experience securing GraphQL and REST APIs, including authentication, cross-tenant data exposure, and abuse of expensive queries.
  • You have led threat modeling across complex web, UI, or data-access environments and driven findings to resolution.

  • You can review JavaScript or TypeScript and at least one other language, such as Java, Python, or Go, for design and source-code issues.
  • You have written security standards and led cross-team programs to measurable results, and you can influence experienced developers with clear, actionable review feedback.

The Experience

Salesforce Data Security is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to architect, build, and scale our unified certificate Registration Authority (RA), the front door for cryptographic trust across our global multi-cloud platform. This foundational trust layer authenticates and authorizes millions of certificate issuance requests daily, securing machine-to-machine communication, workload identity, and data-in-transit for the world's most trusted enterprise cloud. You lead the technical design and delivery of a highly concurrent, multi-substrate Go codebase, stay deep in the code while mentoring senior engineers, and drive architectural consensus across a distributed system where availability and security are non-negotiable. This is an AI-first engineering team: you use advanced AI coding assistants, prompt engineering, and shared-system-context tools daily to accelerate your workflows, review code, and generate comprehensive tests, setting the standard for AI-augmented software development.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Architect, build, and maintain the unified Registration Authority (RA) that serves as the single certificate-issuance front door for a global, multi-cloud platform.

  • Design and optimize highly concurrent, multi-substrate build paths in Go, ensuring seamless deployment across diverse public-cloud environments.

  • Develop and scale both synchronous and asynchronous certificate issuance paths using robust distributed state-machine orchestration.

  • Implement strictly evaluated hierarchical policy engines and authorization controls to validate substrate-specific workload identity and attestation.

  • Drive robust certificate lifecycle management and automation by integrating with and abstracting multiple public and private Certificate Authorities (CAs).

  • Lead the team's engineering excellence by writing resilient, observable, and strictly tested code capable of surviving underlying infrastructure degradation.

  • Instrument comprehensive telemetry, distributed tracing, and alerting to maintain stringent availability and performance service level agreements (SLAs).

  • Act as a technical multiplier, mentoring engineers, conducting rigorous code reviews, and raising the bar for distributed systems design.

  • Partner with Security Architecture to translate complex compliance requirements into automated, scalable software controls.

  • Respond to and resolve complex distributed systems escalations, identifying root causes and deploying durable architectural fixes.

  • Elevate team productivity by establishing best practices for AI-augmented software development and prompt engineering.

  • Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow, pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code.

  • Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale.

  • Contribute to building and maintaining shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably, and critically evaluate code (human- or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance.

You're Our Person If...

  • You have 9+ years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of designing and operating large-scale distributed systems.

  • You have deep, production-grade expertise in Go (Golang), Java, or Rust, including advanced concurrency patterns, memory management, and multi-substrate build configurations.

  • You have extensive experience deploying and operating highly available, mission-critical services across public cloud providers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • You can design resilient Representational State Transfer (RESTful) and gRPC web services, backed by robust distributed state machines and asynchronous processing pipelines.

  • You have a strong background in observability (telemetry, distributed tracing, metrics) and modern continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) deployment pipelines.

  • You are proficient with AI coding assistants and shared-context workflows that enhance engineering velocity.

  • You have a demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering, using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.

  • You have experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.

  • You have advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Even Better If...

  • You have deep domain knowledge of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), X.509 certificate profiles, and mutual Transport Layer Security (mTLS) architectures.

  • You have a strong understanding of certificate lifecycle management and automated certificate provisioning.

  • You are aware of post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards, such as Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM), and crypto-agility design principles.

  • You have experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and Infrastructure-as-Code paradigms.

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineering - Data Science & Integration
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

*Must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) living on U.S. soil who does not hold dual citizenship with the ability to meet customer and government screening standards applicable to this role.**

**Candidates interested in the Hawaii location must be based in Oahu or DC, Northern VA, WMATA.**

**PLEASE NOTE: Qualification for this job is contingent upon acceptable results from a background investigation as well as your having and maintaining the specific level of U.S. government background investigation and clearance required for this role.**

---

About the Role

We believe technology should serve the greater good—powering mission outcomes, stewarding taxpayer resources, and enabling innovation at speed and scale. We are seeking a highly accomplished and senior-level Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our elite Public Sector team. This is a unique and high-impact position, blending the roles of a hands-on data scientist, integration architect, and strategic partner embedded directly with customers.

In this role, you will be the primary driver for bringing cutting-edge data science pipelines, intelligent automation, and enterprise integration solutions to life for mission-critical work across the U.S. Department of Defense, Intelligence Community (IC), and Aerospace & Allied Nations.

This role demands a seasoned technologist who thrives working forward-deployed at customer sites, building bespoke solutions leveraging enterprise workflow orchestration platforms such as Regrello and API-led connectivity platforms such as MuleSoft, while also designing and delivering advanced AI/ML systems. Candidates with equivalent experience in comparable platforms are strongly encouraged to apply; direct experience with these specific tools is a plus. You will work directly with mission owners and internal teams—from initial concept through deployment and ongoing optimization—to solve the most complex data and integration challenges in national security environments.

---

Mission Impact

- Deploy Cutting-Edge Data Science & Integration Innovation—from API-led integration ecosystems to orchestrated operational workflows to advanced ML pipelines—directly at customer sites in defense, intelligence, and aerospace environments, accelerating mission transformation. Experience with platforms such as MuleSoft and Regrello, or comparable tools, is leveraged to deliver these outcomes.

-Become a Trusted Partner Embedded with Mission Owners, working in classified and unclassified environments to deeply understand operational challenges and translate them into end-to-end data science and integration solutions using best-fit tooling.

- Drive Innovation at the Front Lines by serving as the connective bridge between customer missions and internal engineering teams, gathering frontline feedback to help co-design integration patterns, workflow templates, and data science capabilities that strengthen national security outcomes.

- Improve Efficiency, Mission-Readiness, and Trust by helping the U.S. and allied governments deploy integrated data technology stacks that deliver faster response times, better personnel utilization, and more effective logistics and asset management.

- Drive Tangible Outcomes through Hands-On Implementation, taking responsibility for end-to-end technical delivery of complex data pipelines, integration flows, and predictive models—personally writing critical code, configuring systems, and troubleshooting issues in the field while guiding junior team members.

- Build Transformative Data Science Solutions by taking primary ownership of designing, developing, and implementing high-quality, scalable production ML and analytics systems, including predictive models, intelligent automation pipelines, and LLM-augmented workflows.

-Engineer Bespoke Integration Architectures, designing and building custom API-led integrations using enterprise integration platforms—such as MuleSoft Anypoint Platform or equivalent middleware solutions—to ensure seamless connectivity across enterprise data sources, operational systems, and cloud environments in highly regulated settings. Demonstrated experience with comparable iPaaS or API management platforms (e.g., Dell Boomi, Azure API Management, Apigee, AWS API Gateway) is strongly considered; direct MuleSoft experience is a plus.

- Orchestrate Complex Workflows, leveraging modern workflow automation and process orchestration platforms—such as Regrello or equivalent solutions—to model, automate, and optimize multi-stakeholder operational processes in manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, and mission operations contexts. Candidates with hands-on experience in comparable platforms (e.g., Temporal, Prefect, Apache Airflow, ServiceNow) are strongly encouraged to apply; direct Regrello experience is a plus.

- Own the Entire Data Lifecycle- on-site with customers—from strategic data modeling to hands-on ETL/ELT pipeline construction, feature engineering, and integration strategy—ensuring data is always ready, optimized, and secure for advanced analytics and AI applications.

- Lead Rapid Prototyping and Iteration, developing proofs-of-concept and MVPs side-by-side with customer teams to demonstrate data science and integration capabilities and set the pace for rapid, mission-aligned delivery.

---

Mission Responsibilities

- Serve as the forward-deployed technical lead on high-profile customer engagements—designing, building, and deploying tailored data science and integration solutions for defense, intelligence, and aerospace missions on-site.

- Architect and implement enterprise integration solutions—using platforms such as MuleSoft Anypoint Platform or equivalent iPaaS tooling—including API design, development, and management across REST, SOAP, and event-driven integration patterns within secure customer environments.

- Design and deploy workflow automation solutions—leveraging platforms such as Regrello or equivalent orchestration tooling—to model complex operational processes, coordinate cross-functional teams, and surface data-driven insights at key mission decision points.

- Lead integration of AI/ML models, custom data pipelines, and automation flows that enable predictive maintenance, personnel planning, and mission-critical logistics decisions.

- Work with customer IT and security teams to accelerate Authority to Operate (ATO) and production go-lives per DoD IL5/IL6 and applicable regulatory frameworks.

- Partner with internal product and engineering teams to co-develop integration patterns and data science capabilities informed by frontline customer feedback.

- Enable customers to adopt modern data platforms and integration middleware for field operations, asset visibility, command center analytics, and secure operational workflows.

- Mentor junior FDEs and share lessons learned with the broader engineering community to shape playbooks, integration templates, and reusable data science assets for government innovation.

- Translate mission priorities into actionable data and integration roadmaps aligned with agency strategy, presenting findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

---

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a builder, a problem solver, and a mission-first leader who thrives in forward-deployed environments. The ideal candidate brings:

- 8+ years of experience in a hands-on, end-to-end delivery role for high-quality, scalable production solutions, ideally in customer-facing or field-deployed settings.

- Strong background in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related engineering discipline.

- Expert-level proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, SQL).

- Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions, including model development, MLOps pipelines, LLM integration, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).

- Demonstrated expertise in enterprise integration platforms and API-led connectivity design, with experience in tools such as MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, Dell Boomi, Apigee, Azure API Management, or equivalent; direct MuleSoft experience is a plus.

- Demonstrated expertise in workflow orchestration and process automation platforms, with experience in tools such as Regrello, Temporal, Prefect, Apache Airflow, or equivalent; direct Regrello experience is a plus.

- Deep expertise in data modeling, processing, and analytics with demonstrable proficiency in enterprise data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift).

- A "get-things-done" attitude with a proven ability to deliver fast and impactfully in ambiguous, customer-site environments.

- Exceptional communication and presentation skills—able to articulate complex data science and integration concepts to both technical and non-technical mission stakeholders.

- Proven ability to lead technical engagements, mentor junior FDEs, and own technical delivery end-to-end.

- **Ability to travel 50-75% of the time to customer sites, including classified facilities.**

- **Must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) living on U.S. soil who does not hold dual citizenship.**

- **Eligible for and willing to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance.**

---

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior experience in a forward-deployed, field engineer, or embedded technical advisor role with direct customer engagement.

- Experience supporting U.S. Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community (IC), or Federal Civilian agencies.

- Background in defense, aerospace, or military logistics operations.

- Familiarity with IL5/IL6/CNSS #1253 requirements or deployment to classified environments.

- Direct hands-on experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, including advanced DataWeave and Runtime Fabric deployments.

- Direct hands-on experience with Regrello for operational workflow orchestration in manufacturing, supply chain, or logistics domains.

- Expert-level Python and/or Java proficiency in a professional data science or integration engineering setting.

- Experience developing and deploying LLM-augmented solutions within highly regulated or classified industries.

- Relevant platform certifications such as:
- MuleSoft Certified Developer / Architect
- Databricks Certified Associate/Professional
- AWS/GCP/Azure Data or ML Engineer certifications
- Data Science and Analysis Certifications or relevant experience

- Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging systems (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ), and streaming data pipelines.

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevSecOps practices in regulated environments.

This candidate must be a U.S. citizen (U.S. born or naturalized) who does not hold dual citizenship and agrees to complete a U.S. federal government Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for a Moderate Public Trust position.

In this highly impactful position, you leverage deep technical expertise to provide strategic security guidance and leadership to engineering teams responsible for our foundational services, including technical controls, infrastructure databases, and monitoring tools across public cloud platforms.

As a trusted security engineer, you serve as the primary point of contact for engineering partners and leadership, cultivating strong relationships and delivering critical security recommendations. Your contributions directly shape and enhance the security posture of our core infrastructure platforms, ensuring the resilience and integrity of Salesforce's offerings.

Our team specializes in providing deep architectural and infrastructure security expertise across a diverse range of technologies, both on-premises and in public cloud environments, including web applications, distributed systems, and virtualized infrastructures. You champion secure software development lifecycle (SSDL) best practices, empowering engineering teams to build secure products from the ground up.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Provide expert security advisory for large-scale cloud initiatives, offering strategic guidance to engineering teams on complex enterprise architectures across the application and infrastructure stack.
  • Drive proactive security through architecture and threat modeling, partnering with engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities and develop risk mitigation plans throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Influence secure design and implementation by collaborating with product teams to recommend design solutions that balance functional goals with security requirements.
  • Align security priorities with business risk by working with Product Business Information Security Officers (BISOs) to curate and prioritize risk-based security initiatives, and by analyzing risk signals and emerging threats to shape security roadmaps.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 5-8 years of experience in a security engineering, security architecture, or security assurance role.
  • Cloud Security: You have experience securing products and infrastructure across one or more public cloud environments (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, Alibaba Cloud, or equivalent), with an understanding of cloud service models, shared responsibility boundaries, and identity primitives at scale.
  • Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment: You have experience conducting structured security design reviews and threat modeling across infrastructure and application security domains, with familiarity with common vulnerability classes (Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10, Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) Top 25), and can evaluate and communicate security risk to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Identity, Access, and Network Fundamentals: You understand authentication and authorization patterns including Open Authorization (OAuth) / OpenID Connect (OIDC), Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), service-to-service authentication, and API authorization models, as well as TCP/IP, Transport Layer Security (TLS), network segmentation, and key management, certificate lifecycles, secrets handling, and encryption standards.
  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering teams toward secure outcomes without relying on direct organizational authority.



Even Better If...

  • You can reason through abuse cases and attack paths, not just defensive recommendations, with some familiarity with penetration testing methodologies or offensive security techniques.
  • You have experience participating in or driving improvements to a secure development lifecycle, security review process, or security advisory program within an engineering organization.
  • You can work with structured data, identify patterns across a broad service portfolio, and propose mitigations that address root causes rather than individual findings.
  • You can read and reason about code in one or more languages common in cloud-native engineering environments — particularly Java, Go, or Python — and have hands-on familiarity with container orchestration and workload security (Kubernetes, Docker, service mesh such as Istio), secrets/key management and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) tooling, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and vulnerability scanning tools, or static analysis (SAST) and infrastructure-as-code security scanning.

descriptionHtml:

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Overview

As a Solution Engineer within Global Technology Partners, you will be instrumental in driving platform adoption and innovation by selling the value of our platform to both new and existing ISV partners. Your core responsibility is to translate complex technical capabilities into compelling business value, rapidly building bespoke demos and vision prototypes using AI-assisted tools, sales pitch videos, and strategic guidance that emphasize speed-to-market, cost efficiency, and enabling partners to focus on core innovation rather than infrastructure. You’ll be a strategic advisor to our ISV partners, empowering them to build next-generation agentic solutions and scale their innovation within our ecosystem. We are looking for naturally curious problem-solvers who thrive in ambiguity. Come join an amazing team and work alongside incredible peers and leaders pushing the boundary of innovation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Value Proposition & Storytelling: Articulate and evangelize the platform's unique value proposition to prospective and existing ISV partners, crafting compelling narratives that highlight benefits such as accelerated speed-to-market, predictable and lower operational costs, faster application development, and the ability to shift focus from infrastructure maintenance to core innovation.

  • Bespoke Solution Design & Demonstration: Develop and deliver highly customized, technically engaging demonstrations and proof-of-concept scenarios that showcase how the platform can specifically address an ISV partner's strategic goals and enhance their product offerings.

  • AI-Accelerated Build & Prototype: Use AI-assisted tools (Cursor, Claude, Gemini, Agentforce, or equivalent) to rapidly scaffold demos and vision prototypes turning a discovery conversation into a clickable, working 0 → 1 prototype that makes the partner's vision tangible for their executive team.

  • Technical Sales Content Creation: Produce impactful sales collateral, including technical pitch videos, solution briefs, and architectural diagrams, to effectively communicate platform capabilities and partner success stories.

  • Partner Innovation & Roadmap Guidance: Collaborate closely with ISV partners to understand their current product landscape, identify new innovation opportunities on the platform, and help define the scope, value proposition, and technical roadmap for potential new applications or enhanced offerings.

  • Strategic Opportunity Qualification & Scoping: Work with Partner Account Managers (PAMs) to deeply understand partner requirements, qualify sales opportunities, and technically scope potential projects, ensuring alignment between partner needs and platform capabilities.

  • Curiosity-Driven Problem Solving & Discovery: Proactively explore emerging technologies, new platform features, and evolving market trends with an inquisitive mindset. Leverage this curiosity to uncover unspoken partner needs, identify novel applications of the platform, and discover innovative solutions that drive mutual success.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 2–8+ years of experience in pre-sales, solution engineering, technical architecture, consulting, or a closely related customer-facing technical function

  • Platform & Technical Acumen: Possess a solid understanding of cloud-native architectures, SaaS/PaaS platforms, API-first development, and MCP. This includes proficiency in designing and building compelling technical demonstrations and proof-of-concepts, potentially involving light coding or scripting, and familiarity with modern application development methodologies and developer tools.

  • Value-Based Selling & Storytelling: Demonstrate the ability to translate complex technical features into clear, concise business benefits and compelling narratives for diverse audiences. This includes strong presentation skills, comfortably delivering engaging product demonstrations and technical pitches to both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Discovery & Solution Scoping: Exhibit excellent active listening and questioning skills to uncover partner needs, pain points, and strategic objectives. This enables helping partners define initial application scope and value propositions on the platform effectively.

  • AI-First Builder Mentality: You don't just consume AI, you build with it. Demonstrated history of shipping tools, automations, agents, or prototypes using AI or low-code platforms (e.g., Cursor, Lovable, Claude, Slackbot skills, custom demo orgs); comfortable embracing ambiguity and building the plane while flying it.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Show a demonstrated ability to work effectively with internal teams, such as Partner Account Managers, Product, and Engineering, to align on partner solutions and advocate for partner needs.

  • Problem-Solving & Adaptability: Maintain a curious and inquisitive mindset, eager to explore new technologies, identify innovative solutions, and adapt to evolving platform capabilities and partner requirements. This also includes the ability to troubleshoot common technical issues during demos or initial partner engagements.

  • Communication: Possess strong verbal and written communication skills for creating impactful technical content, delivering persuasive presentations, and engaging in effective discussions with partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certifications (Admin, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentblazer/Agentforce preferred)

  • Experience working within the Salesforce ISV / AppExchange partner ecosystem — either as a partner-side architect or a Salesforce partner-facing role

  • Familiarity with Agentforce, agentic workflow design, Flex Credits, and prompt engineering patterns

  • Experience designing Salesforce-native managed packages or integrated solutions

  • Understanding of APIs, Tableau, or Data Cloud integration patterns

Digital Enterprise Technology blazes the trail of enterprise IT. Built on the foundation of our core values - Trust, Ohana, Innovation - we own more than the traditional IT components with a heavy focus on working closely with our business partners for amazing outcomes. Our goal is to deliver technology that is centered around our business and our collective success. We oversee technology strategy, Salesforce on Salesforce, customer and partner enablement, applications engineering, infrastructure, collaboration, enterprise operations, architecture, and program enablement. We own the world's foremost Salesforce implementation and enable our global Ohana to do their best work by leveraging our platform.


We are hiring for the position of Systems Engineer, Procure To Pay. As a member of the Digital Enterprise Technology Systems Engineering team, the Systems Engineer will specialize in continuous process and systems improvement focused on Supplier Onboarding, Procurement, Contracting, Sourcing, Invoice, and Payment processes & systems, supporting our Procurement & Finance Operations organization.


The Systems Engineer is focused on the long and short term architecture and integration vision of the systems landscape, aligning internal business partners' interests with IT delivery, and representing the system design to the stakeholder and solution contributor community. The Systems Engineer closely works with our internal business partners, product owners and internal & external delivery partners to configure & develop systems, integrations, and solutions needed to support key business processes. The Systems Engineer then prioritizes the request backlog and translates high level requirements - increasingly using AI-assisted tools to accelerate and improve requirements analysis, specification, and documentation - into user stories and system specifications for a world-class team of software engineers and product owners.


Core Responsibilities & Scope


  • Owns the delivery of configurations, integrations, interfaces, features, and other key initiatives. Develops and maintains system functionality that synthesizes the needs of business customers over the long and short term. Manages delivery expectations with customers.
  • Identifies system and business functionalities and configurations and can influence customer and delivery of their requirements.
  • Effectively negotiates configuration options with business partners to align on objectives around time to functionality, effort and scope.
  • Owns the delivery of system specifications, requirements, and acceptance criteria that represent the needs provided by the business, leveraging AI tools to accelerate requirements elicitation, drafting, and validation.
  • Participates in system assessment, requirements gathering, and documentation, including identifying opportunities where AI can streamline analysis and documentation work.
  • Translates business requirements into functional and technical requirements. Also defines error handling and monitoring approaches to support system reliability.
  • Maps functional business processes across procure-to-pay platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Coupa, Workday, Mulesoft), and documents data flows and dependencies between systems.
  • Defines and ensures error handling and monitoring approaches meet business and non-functional requirements, security standards and common patterns.
  • Works with the engineering/scrum team in planning and execution of their work.
  • Responsible for delivery to plan, and problem resolution of system-level issues. Works with business and IT stakeholders to prioritize work to be delivered by the delivery teams at a sprint level. Works directly with software engineers, and product owners on solution delivery.
  • Communicates delivery scope, status and questions back to business. Communicates effectively and appropriately with business and technical peers (written and verbal).
  • Serves as the conduit to their business partner(s). Works with multiple business, IT, and technical stakeholders. Works very comfortably with stakeholders at the department or division level.
  • Effectively negotiates work scope with business partners to align on objectives around time to market, effort and scope.
  • Creates and grooms a backlog of well-formed system requirements and stories for implementation by the area's delivery teams, including using AI to help identify high-value use cases and structure backlog items.
  • Manages and communicates tradeoff decisions between scope (value in expected ROI) and schedule (higher operating expense in longer release cycles).
  • Reviews technical and system solutions for compliance to business process, integration architecture, and IT and security standards, including performing integration and interoperability testing across connected systems.
  • Identifies, champions, and helps deliver AI use cases across the systems portfolio - including AI-assisted requirements definition, testing automation, and other applications that drive high business value.
  • Works proactively on customer and system issues and resolves them in a timely manner, applying AI-assisted diagnostics and automation where they improve speed or quality of resolution.

Minimum Requirements


  • Bachelor's Degree, with 6-10 yrs related information systems experience.
  • 4+ years experience with the implementation of best in class Procure To Pay processes and systems.
  • Demonstrable expertise of Salesforce is required, Working knowledge of Coupa, Workday Financials and other similar PTP systems is desired.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce required. Excellent, creative problem-solving skills.
  • Business process oriented systems engineering approach is preferred, including the ability to apply AI and automation to improve requirements definition, testing, and delivery of business processes.
  • Experience with enterprise system implementations, integration architecture, and solution architecture for global companies.
  • Experience with PTP system implementation for large companies.
  • Proven experience with process improvement or transformation.
  • Must have the ability to make decisions and recommendations on technology and systems architecture strategies.
  • Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment.
  • Excellent spoken and written communication as well as receptive listening skills, with ability to present complex ideas in a clear, concise fashion to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Excellent team player able to work with virtual and global cross functional teams.
  • Excellent influencing and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to juggle multiple projects and tasks. Demonstrated knowledge of project management concepts and techniques required.
  • Ability to work with deadlines and in a fast paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with complex project delivery & Agile/SCRUM techniques.
  • Strong knowledge in information technology architecture components, principles, procedures and practices, including system integration, interoperability testing, and performance monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to draft and refine requirements, build testing automation, and identify and deliver AI use cases that drive high business value.

Overview of the role


As an Account Solution Engineer (also known as a "Presales Consultant" or "Sales Engineer"), you are the visionary who transforms customer experiences. You aren’t just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner to Sales, owning the solutioning throughout the entire sales cycle. You will act as a trusted advisor to our customers, translating complex business objectives into enticing, practical recommendations that drive real change.


Business Acumen & Strategic Impact

  • Business Transformation Advocate: You are passionate about how technology solves real-world business puzzles. You enjoy digging into a company’s value chain to find where Salesforce can drive the most impact.
  • The "Bottom Line" Mentality: You understand that technology is only as good as the business outcome it creates. You are excited by the challenge of connecting high-level business strategy to technical execution.

Strategic Sales Partner: You thrive on the "win." You act as a co-pilot to the sales team, bringing a strategic lens to every deal to ensure we aren't just selling software, but building a long-term partnership.


The Ideal Profile: Passion & Mindset

Demonstrated Passion for Technology & AI

  • The "First to Know": You are a true technophile. You don't just wait for training; you are already experimenting with the latest in Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic workflows.
  • AI Visionary: You have a clear passion for how AI is transforming the workforce. You are eager to show customers how Agentforce and autonomous agents can augment human productivity.
  • Continuous Learner: You have a "Growth Mindset." Whether it’s passing a new Salesforce Certification or exploring a new API, you are driven by a natural curiosity to understand the how and why behind the tech.
     

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Sales Partnership: Act as the technical "North Star" for the sales team, aligning technical strategy with business outcomes to close complex deals.

  • Solution Innovation: Develop and deliver innovative custom solutions and demos (including Agentforce and Data Cloud) that address unique business challenges and prove tangible value.
  • Lead the Cycle: Coordinate and lead the entire solution cycle through close collaboration with other high-performing teams (Product, Marketing, Professional Services).
  • Value Communication: Articulate the benefits of Salesforce to audiences at every level—from IT Administrators to C-suite executives—using industry-specific insights.
  • Continuous Growth: Maintain expert-level knowledge of Salesforce products and industry trends to remain effective in a performance-driven environment.
     

Experience & Background


We are looking for a diverse range of backgrounds to join our high-performing South team. Whether you are a career SE or looking to pivot your technical and business acumen into a pre-sales career, we want to hear from you.
Core Experience (One or more of the following):

  • Solution Excellence: A proven track record in Solution Engineering (Pre-sales), technical consulting, or professional services delivery within an enterprise software organization.
  • SaaS & Cloud Fluency: Deep familiarity with the SaaS (Software as a Service) landscape, including an understanding of subscription-based business models and cloud architecture.
  • Consultative Mindset: A background in Business Consulting, with the ability to perform deep discovery, identify "pain points," and map them to high-value technology roadmaps.
  • Technical Foundation: A strong Technical Background—this could be a degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent hands-on experience with APIs, data modeling, or software development.
     

Required Skills & Qualifications

The Foundations

  • Professional Background: A track record in Solution Engineering, SaaS, Account Management, Management Consulting, or a deep Technical Background. We are open to a variety of backgrounds if you can demonstrate the core proficiencies of the role.

  • Demonstrated Passion: A visible passion for Technology, Business, and AI. You are curious about the latest trends and eager to learn how they apply to customer success.
  • Problem-Solving: Exceptional ability to find creative, pragmatic solutions to unique and complex business challenges.

Key Professional Skills

  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to manage and influence internal and external stakeholders, navigating different interests to reach a common goal.

  • Communication & Presence: Strong oral, written, and presentation skills. You are good at explaining complex ideas and finding ways to keep an audience’s attention.
  • Prioritisation: Strong organizational and time-management skills to manage multiple high-priority projects simultaneously in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Experience & Adaptability

  • Industry Insight: Ability to understand business requirements within multiple industries and translate them into a compelling vision and roadmap.

  • Agility: Comfortable working as part of a team to tackle problems in energizing environments and willing to travel occasionally.

Language Requirements

  • Fluency in English plus one or more additional languages is required from the following: Spanish, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, Czech, Romanian, Hungarian, Croatian, Serbian.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Ecosystem: Existing Salesforce product knowledge and certifications (e.g., AI Associate, Administrator, or Cloud Consultant) are highly preferred.

  • SaaS Mastery: Experience or background in solution selling and the enterprise software landscape.

  • Leadership Advisory & Coaching: Serve as a high-impact trusted advisor to the ES leadership team, utilizing advanced consultative skills to navigate a complex organizational ecosystem. You will provide values-aligned coaching—anchored in Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, and Equality—to empower leaders as they navigate organizational change and address engagement challenges. As a resilient communicator, you will leverage professional poise to bridge differing perspectives among high-level practitioners, building the consensus necessary to improve retention and achieve strategic people outcomes.

You will be responsible for designing, validating, and operationalizing enterprise-grade data and AI architectures centered on Salesforce D360 and the Agentforce platform. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and applied AI, requiring you to guide customer Chief Data Officers and Enterprise Architects through emerging AI solutions. You will work side-by-side with Account Executives and Product teams to ensure customers realize the full value of the platform by designing scalable, secure solutions that integrate D360 into complex enterprise ecosystems—including hyperscalers, data lakes, and governance frameworks.

Responsibilities

  • Lead pre-sales technical design by analyzing customer needs and recommending solutions aligned with Agentforce capabilities and integration with external agent frameworks.

  • Shape best practices around generative AI, agent interoperability, prompt engineering, Data Cloud, and cross-platform integrations.

  • Collaborate with AEs and SEs to build hands-on prototypes and demos using Agentforce and integrated external agents.

  • Develop thought leadership content—demo templates, whitepapers, enablement sessions—focused on agent lifecycle, integration strategy, and technical effectiveness.

  • Act as a central technical knowledge resource, proactively addressing internal technical inquiries, facilitating deep technical enablement, and documenting best practices to empower specialist teams across the organization.

  • If you are naturally curious about AI and Data, love diving into new technologies, and enjoy educating others while crafting solutions that deliver real business impact, we want to talk to you!

  • Understand Agent Interoperability - Map and integrate external agents from hyperscalers (e.g. Copilot, Gemini) into Agentforce via open standards (MCP, A2A); design how these systems collaborate.

  • Enable Conversational & Background Agents - Use Agentforce Studio and Agent Builder to configure chat and background agents; integrate with external channels including voice via hyperscaler APIs.

  • Drive Prompt Engineering & Lifecycle Strategy - Lead prompt design, testing, monitoring, and iteration; define agent lifecycle best practices from development through refinement.

  • Build Hands-On Demos & Prototypes - Co-create quick prototypes (<2 weeks) with AEs demonstrating integration between Agentforce and external agents or services.

  • Lead Pre-Sales Workshops - Facilitate whiteboarding, deep-dive sessions, and quick enablement for customers and internal teams.

  • Advise on Data & Integration - Integrate Data Cloud (D360), CRM, MuleSoft APIs, and external agent endpoints ensuring cohesive architectures that align with compliance and governance policies.

  • Support Early Adoption - Occasionally assist in proof-of-value engagements post-sale by tuning agents and guiding customers toward self-sufficient enablement.

  • Own Technical Architecture Decisions - Oversee data modeling, identity resolution, real-time vs. batch patterns, data graph design, and activation strategies within D360.

  • Own Technical Enablement - Create and manage accessible technical documentation, knowledge bases, and FAQ resources to rapidly resolve internal technical inquiries, empowering specialist teams to handle technical discussions confidently.

  • Technical Pre-Sales/Consulting - 7+ years of hands-on experience designing and delivering data, analytics, and AI architectures in enterprise environments.

  • External Ecosystem Knowledge - Strong understanding of external agent ecosystems and interoperability.

  • Proven Track Record - Experience in prompt engineering, agent lifecycle management, and hands-on prototype development.

  • AI & ML Expertise - Experience with machine learning concepts (predictive and generative AI), plus the ability to communicate value to diverse audiences.

  • Data Stack Knowledge - Deep expertise in modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift) and data ingestion patterns (batch, streaming, CDC).

  • Hands-On Development - Proficiency in programming (e.g., JavaScript, Python, SQL, R) and data frameworks like pandas or Jupyter.

  • Excellent Communication - Strong presentation skills; adept at explaining complex ideas and guiding stakeholders toward impactful solutions.

  • Curiosity & Continuous Learning - Passion for exploring new AI frameworks, sharing insights, and experimenting with cutting-edge technologies.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Expertise - Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce and deep fluency with D360 and core Salesforce platform services.

  • Advanced Integration - Experience integrating Salesforce with external agents via APIs and open standards (MCP, A2A).

  • Governance & Observability - Familiarity with prompt governance, observability, and monitoring frameworks.

  • Cross-Platform Background - Background in cross-platform integrations (e.g., Hyperscaler SDKs to Salesforce Flows).

  • Multimodal Pipelines - Prior exposure to conversational voice pipelines or multimodal integrations via hyperscaler services.

  • Advanced AI/ML Frameworks - Exposure to frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), MLOps practices, and cloud AI platforms like Google Vertex AI or AWS Sagemaker.

The Experience
本ポジションはEngagement managerとしてコンシューマビジネスや通信メディア事業の顧客(消費財メーカー、小売、ユーティリティ、旅行・運輸、製薬、通信、メディア業)の大規模な変革プロジェクトのあるべき姿やプロジェクトアプローチを策定し、また自らそのプロジェクトの実行を推進・リードすることにより、顧客とその変革プロジェクトを成功に導くために重要な役割を果たします。大きく2つの役割があります。

  • 顧客へのプロジェクト提案アカウントパートナー（サービスセールス担当者）と連携して、SalesforceのProfessional Servicesによるコンサルティングプロジェクト、インプリメンテーションプロジェクト等の提案を行い、受注前および受注後の提案活動を主導します。特にプロジェクト提案にあたって、顧客の課題、変革プロジェクトの目的から最適なプロジェクトアプローチを策定すること、必要なサービスリソースを特定するために、アカウントパートナーだけでなく組織全体の他の専門領域のメンバーと協力することが求められます。
  • プロジェクト成功に導くリーダーシッププロジェクト受注後にインダストリーまたはデリバリーのエキスパートとしてプロジェクト全体を推進、または支援し、プロジェクトを成功させること、最終的に顧客の成功に導くことに責任を持ちます。顧客のエグゼクティブとの関係を構築・維持すること、プロアクティブにプロジェクトの品質を高めること、また組織全体の専門領域のメンバーと協力することで必要な知見等をプロジェクトにもたらすよう働きかけることが求められます。


特に通信/メディア業界を中心とした顧客に対するコンサルティングビジネスの拡大に貢献いただきます。このロールでは、組織の関係者と協業しながら、顧客との関係性をどう構築するのか、SalesforceのProfessional ServicesをどうSellingするのかを裁量を持って働くことができます。戦略的で自由な発想を活かし、次のSalesforce Servicesのビジネスを作り上げる意欲のある方を採用したいと考えています。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 顧客固有の実装提案、SOW、人員配置計画の策定を主導し、組織全体の他の専門領域メンバと協力して、受け入れ可能な提案について合意形成を図ります。
  • アカウントセールスおよびサービスセールスと緊密に連携して、スコーピング、ソリューション作成、SOW作成、プロジェクト人員配置などのプリセールス活動に責任を持ちます。
  • プロフェッショナルサービスチームに、提案されたソリューションと顧客ニーズに関係する専門家としての知見を提供し、プロジェクトを確実に成功させます。
  • カスタマーサクセスに適切かつ必要な場合は、エンゲージメントのライフサイクル全体にわたってプロジェクトチームを直接リード、または支援し、プロジェクトの成功に貢献します。
  • プロジェクトチームと連携し、アカウントチームおよびデリバリーチームの両方へのエスカレーションポイントとして機能します。
  • 複数の戦略的顧客を同時にマネジメントし、新しい潜在顧客のリファレンスになりそうなプロジェクトを意図的に構築・実行することで、ビジネス拡大に貢献します。
  • 重要なエスカレーションやリスクのあるアカウントに対して、将来を見越したリスクの軽減やマネジメントをします。

ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。

descriptionHtml:
