You will be a Principal Engineer (PMTS) leading the Monitoring Cloud Events team in Hyderabad, India. Our team builds systems that handle huge amounts of data for Salesforce. We make sure everything in our cloud runs the way it should. In this role, your job is to guide the team, build great software, and own the services we create from start to finish.


What You’ll Actually Be Doing

  • Day-to-day work: You will build and maintain an Observability stack using in-house, open source and cloud managed services and run data pipelines (ETL) and use big data tools. You will check system health and fix problems quickly so our services stay online.
  • Leading the way: You will teach and mentor other engineers to help them grow and do their best work.
  • Working together: You will talk to partners and customers all over the world to make sure they get what they need.
  • Long-term goals & impact: You will make our cloud faster, safer, and easier to use for millions of people. You will learn how to run big, global systems and become a top leader in the tech world.

Tech Stack:

  • Cloud & Compute: AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) for stateless, scalable multi-cloud orchestration.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform for resilient, automated platform provisioning across environments.
  • Edge Ingestion: OpenTelemetry (OTel) for standardized instrumentation, and Vector/Fluent Bit for high-throughput log routing.
  • Message Buffering: Apache Kafka to ingest billions of telemetry events, ensuring durable, decoupled data pipelines.
  • Stream Processing: Apache Flink for real-time log parsing, rolling aggregations, and anomaly detection before storage.
  • Backend Languages: Java for building heavy stream-processing applications, supplemented by Go and Python for operators and tooling.
  • Ad-Hoc OLAP Analytics: Apache Druid to power sub-second, interactive dashboard queries over massive historical datasets.
  • Log & Trace Storage: ClickHouse for fast columnar event storage, natively tiered to AWS S3 / GCP Cloud Storage for cost-effective cold storage.
  • Time-Series Metrics: VictoriaMetrics, M3DB, or Prometheus to ingest and compress millions of high-cardinality metric rollups.
  • Visualization & Alerting: Grafana and Apache Superset for single-pane-of-glass UI, paired with Prometheus Alertmanager for incident routing.

You’re Our Person If…

  • You have deep experience building software and leading engineering teams.
  • You know how to move, store, and work with very large amounts of data.
  • You are highly skilled at building ETL data pipelines.
  • You have hands-on experience with open-source tools like Kafka, Flink, and Apache Druid.
  • You are a kind and helpful mentor to other engineers.
  • You are a great "service owner," meaning you care deeply about keeping systems online and running smoothly.

Even Better If…

  • You have worked on an Observability stack before (tools that monitor system health and logs).
  • You have experience working with global teams across different countries and time zones.
  • You enjoy talking directly to customers to understand and solve their problems.

This role calls for experience with SQL and AI/ML, hands-on use of AI and AI coding tools as well prior audit and related experience to accelerate analysis, documentation, and work paper development, plus some administration of the team's audit tooling.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Partner with Internal Audit teams throughout the audit lifecycle, building and applying the right solutions and capabilities.
  • Develop optimized SQL queries and AI system prompts (.md) to seamlessly extract, profile, and reconcile high-volume data from financial, operational, and source platforms.
  • Build Python and other scripts for data cleaning, transformation, and repeatable audit testing (e.g., exception testing, continuous assurance/monitoring).
  • Use AI tools and other capabilities to speed up data analysis, summarize findings, draft work papers, and build lightweight internal tooling.
  • Design clear, audit-ready visualizations and dashboards in Tableau that communicate risk and findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Develop a working understanding of the business systems in scope (e.g., ERP, CRM, ticketing, HR, or financial systems) well enough to assess data lineage, controls, and where risk actually lives.
  • Provide light system administration support for the team's GRC and other tooling, including user access, workflow/queue configuration, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Proactively identify AI and analytics opportunities and process gaps rather than waiting to be asked, flag risk trends, data quality issues, and automation opportunities as you see them.
  • Support training and enablement for audit staff on analytics tools, dashboards, and AI-assisted workflows so the broader team can self-serve.
  • Document methodology, assumptions, and results so analytics can be re-run, reviewed, and defended by audit leadership and external reviewers.

You're Our Person If...

  • 2–4 years of experience in AI, Agentic AI, data analytics, audit analytics, business intelligence, or a related analytical role. (any or all of the following: Claude/Cursor, Tableau, Snowflake, Python)
  • 1–2 years of experience in audit, internal audit, risk security or a related field
  • Experience building and deploying production-grade LLM systems, including agents, tool integration, MCP, retrieval/grounding, and prompt optimization. You know what it takes to monitor and scale real AI workflows.
  • Strong principles around agent engineering, from tool scoping and grounded reasoning to safe failure handling and continuous model evaluation.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for querying and manipulating large, complex datasets.
  • Working proficiency in Python for data analysis and scripting.
  • Capability to use probabilistic models and tune to behave as deterministically as possible for audit-defensible results.
  • Experience building dashboards or reports in Tableau (or a comparable BI tool).
  • Demonstrated ability to learn business systems and processes quickly, gather business requirements directly from stakeholders, and reason about data flow, controls, and risk.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach to identifying and solving problems, not just executing assigned tasks.
  • Comfort with basic system administration tasks (user access, configuration) on business platforms such as an eGRC tool.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to train and enable non-technical colleagues on new tools and workflows.
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, accounting, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Prior experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, or compliance analytics.
  • Hands-on administration experience with an GRC platform
  • Familiarity with control frameworks (e.g., COSO, SOX).
  • Experience with additional analytics or automation tools.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

The next Salesforce will be shaped by how well people and agents can understand one another, share context, delegate authority, recover from failure, and accomplish meaningful outcomes together. These behaviors unfold across roles, products, implementations, data, policies, channels, and time. They cannot be understood through episodic studies or a single adoption metric.

The SVP, Research + Insights will lead Research across Salesforce Experience Design and build a continuous intelligence capability spanning Customer 360, Platform, Data 360, Agentforce, Slack, and emerging surfaces. Reporting to the EVP, Chief Experience Officer, this executive will move Research further upstream into enterprise and product strategy while extending evaluation through implementation, production, and longitudinal use.

What you will lead - 4 Connected Capabilities:

  • Enterprise Experience Intelligence + Foresight. Foundational domain research, longitudinal customer programs, strategic opportunity intelligence, ecosystem and competitive synthesis, failed-adoption and win/loss evidence, foresight, and executive synthesis.
  • Portfolio Research + Insights. Deeply embedded research leadership and teams serving Salesforce's major product portfolios while operating within one enterprise agenda, talent system, evidence standard, and knowledge environment.
  • Human-Agent Research, Evaluation + Measurement. Human factors, behavioral science, trust and delegation, agent-behavior evaluation, scenario and rubric development, production-evidence interpretation, and experience-outcome measurement.
  • Research Operations + Knowledge. Participant systems, customer access, governance and ethics, methods and standards, knowledge infrastructure, evidence taxonomy, tooling, vendors, and research program operations.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Establish one enterprise Research + Insights agenda tied to Salesforce's most consequential customer, product, platform, architecture, and business decisions.
  • Build Experience Intelligence as a live, cumulative understanding of how customers, industries, organizations, roles, and work actually operate and how they change over time.
  • Ensure foundational, generative, and evaluative research shape product strategy before solution direction and roadmap commitments harden.
  • Create a continuous evaluation system spanning early concepts, working prototypes, implementations, shipped products, production behavior, and longitudinal customer outcomes.
  • Define the research and measurement models Salesforce needs for human-agent collaboration, including trust, delegation, autonomy, authority, observability, intervention, correction, escalation, learning, and recovery.
  • Integrate relevant evidence across Product Analytics, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, Services, Trust, implementation, and market intelligence without duplicating those organizations or collapsing distinct evidence into one score.
  • Build a durable knowledge system that makes customer and product evidence searchable, reusable, appropriately contextualized, and available at the moment consequential decisions are made.
  • Protect the independence and integrity of customer evidence, including confidence, limitations, contradictions, and unresolved questions, even when the findings challenge a committed direction.
  • Recruit and develop an exceptional bench of research leaders, distinguished researchers, behavioral scientists, measurement experts, research technologists, knowledge architects, and Research Operations talent.



You're Our Person If...

  • A record of leading Research across a complex, multi-product enterprise, platform, or ecosystem at significant scale.
  • Evidence that research you personally led changed product strategy, architecture, investment, operating decisions, or shipped experiences, not merely stakeholder understanding.
  • Deep expertise across qualitative research, behavioral science, mixed methods, experimentation, measurement, and interpretation of product and production data.
  • Meaningful experience with AI, automation, human factors, intelligent systems, trust, or human-machine collaboration.
  • The ability to reconstruct how complex domains and people actually work across roles, systems, incentives, constraints, implementations, and time.
  • Demonstrated strength in foundational research, generative product influence, continuous evaluation, and enterprise synthesis.
  • Experience integrating qualitative, quantitative, behavioral, commercial, implementation, and service evidence without overstating certainty or confusing correlation with customer understanding.
  • Executive presence and organizational courage sufficient to challenge powerful stakeholders, protect difficult findings, and redirect consequential decisions.
  • Experience leading a centrally connected research organization with senior portfolio leaders and deeply embedded teams.
  • A record of identifying, recruiting, and developing exceptional research leaders and distinguished practitioners.



What success looks like:
Within the first year, Research should operate as an enterprise decision system: close enough to change the work and independent enough to challenge it.

  • A single enterprise research agenda is actively shaping priority product, portfolio, architecture, and business decisions.
  • Live domain and work models are in place for the highest-priority areas and are changing what teams choose to build or stop.
  • A continuous evaluation model connects prototypes, production behavior, implementation evidence, customer outcomes, and longitudinal learning.
  • Human-agent research and measurement are informing Agentforce, Slack, Experience Architecture, and selected portfolio experiences.
  • Evidence from implementation, support, service, win/loss, telemetry, and direct research is entering decisions with clear provenance and interpretation.
  • The research knowledge environment is reducing duplicated discovery and making prior evidence available without stripping it of context.
  • Salesforce has one strong Research leadership and talent system, with deep portfolio proximity and a credible distinguished-practitioner bench.
  • Unsupported directions are redirected or stopped before major investment because the evidence is timely, credible, and consequential.



Your leadership signature
You are a truth-teller with product consequence. You combine deep curiosity and methodological rigor with exceptional product judgment. You can hold contradiction, identify the non-obvious implication, and make complex evidence clear without manufacturing certainty. You are independent without becoming distant from the work, and influential without allowing stakeholder preference to rewrite what is true.

Why this role matters
The Agentic Enterprise introduces questions of trust, authority, delegation, learning, and organizational change that no existing product metric can answer alone. This role will ensure Salesforce builds from a continuously updated understanding of customers and real work, and that the company learns as its products and agents change. The right leader will make customer truth a durable source of strategic and product advantage.

Salesforce is looking for a Technical Product Strategist to join its Product Strategy & Innovation team. You will contribute to our forward-looking technology thesis. Rather than managing sprint backlogs, feature prioritization, or short-term execution roadmaps, you will work within a team of technical product strategists to identify emerging opportunities ("white spaces"), evaluate "build-buy-partner" options, and translate major market trends into concrete platform strategies.

We are looking for a strategy professional who can anticipate trends: someone who can methodically analyze portfolio gaps, evaluate technical investment options, and help design the strategic frameworks that will shape our enterprise platform.

From analyzing the productization trajectories of key capabilities (from trust infrastructure to workflow automation to agentic AI architectures) to researching investment theses in high-growth areas such as supply chain agentification, developer tools, and AI-native systems of record, you will help Salesforce make the right bets through solid commercial and technical models.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Support long-term product strategy: Conduct market studies, whitespace analyses, and competitive assessments to support multi-year positioning frameworks across Salesforce's enterprise AI and platform portfolio.
  • Analyze productization trajectories: Evaluate the strategic transition of internal technical capabilities (trust infrastructure, workflow automation, agentic AI, and data platforms) into standalone product lines or platform-integrated offerings.
  • Apply "Build-Buy-Partner" frameworks: Conduct structured assessments for internal development, acquisition, or partnership decisions, analyzing platform integration timelines against independent go-to-market strategies.
  • Translate technology and market paradigms: Track fundamental shifts (including agentic coding, AI-native application architectures, supply chain automation, and open source ecosystems) and translate them into clear, data-backed investment theses.
  • Map portfolio gaps: Collaborate with strategy and product management leaders to identify portfolio vulnerabilities and market opportunities beyond traditional competitive analysis.
  • Synthesize cross-functional signals: Integrate technical research, engineering capabilities, strategic market intelligence, and M&A (mergers and acquisitions) trends into solid, well-supported strategic perspectives.
  • Assess market viability: Perform market sizing, economic modeling, and competitive analyses to justify capital allocation and strategic redirections.
  • Support global strategic initiatives: Work with regional leadership to adapt platform strategies to international markets, accounting for local regulatory frameworks and the competitive landscape.
  • Evaluate go-to-market models: Analyze monetization structures (open source, platform integration, standalone SaaS, API-first), balancing long-term revenue potential, developer adoption, and defensibility.
  • Monitor emerging signals: Track venture capital activity, developer ecosystem shifts, and emerging research to identify new technology paradigms before they become consensus.
  • Make recommendations to the leadership committee: Write clear, well-structured strategic memos and presentations for chief strategy officers, product VPs, and executive leaders.



You're Our Person If...

  • 5 to 8 years of experience (post-bachelor's or advanced degree) in product strategy, technology strategy, corporate strategy, management consulting, or technical product management at a major cloud or enterprise software company.

And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly accomplished technologist to join our Forward Deployed Engineering Team as an Expert Agent Builder. This role represents the pinnacle of AI technical expertise, focusing on architecting, designing, and building the most complex and sophisticated agentic systems to solve our customers' most difficult challenges. You will be the technical conscience and thought leader, translating ambiguous customer needs into concrete, executable AI solutions.

You will drive transformative AI solutions by tackling the technical frontier of intelligent automation. You will build first of their kind best in class experiences for the world’s biggest brands - including headless agent automations, dynamic AI driven custom user interfaces, and complex multi-agent solutions.  This demands unparalleled software development mastery, deep software architecture skills, and a relentless focus on implementing engineering best practices to deliver maximum tangible value in dynamic, real-world enterprise environments. This isn't just about coding; it's about deeply understanding our customers' most complex problems, architecting sophisticated solutions, and leading the end-to-end technical delivery of innovative, impactful solutions that leverage our Agentforce platform and beyond.

Your Impact

  • Define Agentic Architecture: Design, architect, and hands-on develop the most difficult and bespoke agentic AI solutions that leverage the full power of the Agentforce platform and integrate with complex enterprise systems to solve critical customer challenges.

  • Build and Deploy Agent Systems: Apply extensive hands-on experience to integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and expertly utilize agent-building and orchestration frameworks (e.g., Agentforce, LangChain, LlamaIndex) to implement and deploy complex agent-based solutions.

  • Lead Engineering Best Practices: Master our development process, culture, and code base, then define, improve, and enforce engineering best practices for code quality, scalability, and security across all deployed agentic solutions.

  • Drive Platform Customization: Utilize significant direct experience with the Salesforce platform to perform advanced configuration, customization, and complex development necessary to support and integrate agentic solutions.

  • Develop Data & Integration Solutions: Design strategic data models and build efficient processing pipelines to ensure data is ready, optimized, and secure for advanced AI applications.

  • Proactively Remove Technical Blockers: Identify, analyze, and directly resolve the most complex technical challenges during all phases of solution delivery, serving as the ultimate go-to expert for advanced agent orchestration and intricate data integration issues.

  • Drive Agentforce Innovation: Become the foremost expert in our innovative Agentforce platform, leading the development of custom intelligent agents and influencing future product enhancements based on deep field insights.

  • Undertake Continuous Learning: Maintain expertise in the latest AI advancements, both within the company and the wider industry, and proactively seek opportunities to integrate this knowledge for product and process innovation.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in a hands-on, end-to-end delivery role for high-quality, scalable production solutions. Strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline.

  • Expert-level proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, Apex, JavaScript, Python). Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and databases.

  • Experience building applications with modern web component frameworks like React, Angular, or LWC.

  • Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying solutions with AI/LLM technologies, including:

    • Integrating LLMs and applying advanced AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex).

    • Developing custom agentic frameworks and systems.

    • Deep understanding of machine learning and natural language processing.

    • Expertise in prompt engineering, advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) strategies, and defining/automating rigorous evaluation and testing frameworks for LLM outputs and agentic workflows.

  • Deep expertise in data modeling, processing, integration, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency in enterprise data platforms (e.g., Salesforce Data Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery).

  • Proven experience in automated testing, including unit and functional testing, and the ability to develop test strategies and design automation frameworks.

The Opportunity: The Platform Guardian

We are seeking a Salesforce Platform Expert who specializes in security implementation. You are not just a compliance officer; you are a builder. You understand the Salesforce metadata API better than anyone, you know the limits of Apex Managed Sharing, and you know exactly which "Session Settings" break the user experience if configured incorrectly.

In this role, you will be the bridge between our security requirements and the technical reality of the Salesforce platform. You will use your deep platform expertise to architect, configure, and implement the controls that keep our ecosystem secure without sacrificing performance or agility.


Role Summary

The Salesforce Platform Security Architect is responsible for the hands-on design and implementation of security controls within the Salesforce org. You will own the technical configuration of Sharing & Visibility, Shield Encryption, and Identity flows.

You will work alongside developers and admins to ensure that every Flow, Apex Class, and Integration is built securely from the ground up. You translate abstract security policies (e.g., "Least Privilege") into concrete Salesforce configurations (e.g., "Permission Set Groups" and "Field Level Security").


Key Responsibilities

Platform Security Implementation (The "Hands-On" Work)

  • Sharing Architecture: Design and implement complex sharing models. Optimize Org-Wide Defaults (OWD), Sharing Rules, Account Teams, and Territory Management to ensure strict data segregation.
  • Shield Implementation: Lead the technical deployment of Salesforce Shield. Manage Tenant Secrets, define encryption policies for standard/custom fields, and configure Field Audit Trails to meet retention policies.
  • Identity Configuration: Configure and troubleshoot SSO (SAML/OIDC), Connected Apps, and Login Flows. managing certificates and Key Management (BYOK) where applicable.

Event Monitoring & Detection

  • Real-Time Monitoring: Build Transaction Security Policies (using Apex or Low-Code) to block data exfiltration attempts in real-time.
  • Log Analysis: Configure Event Monitoring to export logs to our SIEM (Splunk/New Relic). Create dashboards to visualize login anomalies and report exports.

Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

  • Code Security: Act as the "Security Gatekeeper" for deployments. Review Apex and LWC code for common vulnerabilities (SOQL Injection, XSS, Enforcing Sharing).
  • DevOps Integration: Configure static code analysis tools (e.g., PMD, Checkmarx, Clayton) within our CI/CD pipeline (Copado/Gearset/Jenkins) to auto-reject insecure code.

Connected App & OAuth Governance (Critical Focus)

  • OAuth Flow Architecture: Select and implement the correct OAuth flows for specific use cases (e.g., JWT Bearer Flow for server-to-server integration vs. Web Server Flow for user-facing apps vs. Device Flow for IoT).
  • Scope Management: Enforce the principle of Least Privilege by meticulously defining and auditing OAuth Scopes (e.g., ensuring an integration only has api access and not full access).
  • Session Policies: Configure granular session policies per Connected App, enforcing High Assurance sessions (MFA) for sensitive apps and defining strict timeout values.
  • Client Secret Management: Manage the lifecycle of Consumer Keys and Secrets, including rotation strategies and ensuring secrets are never hardcoded in external systems.
  • IP Relaxation: configure "Enforce IP Restrictions" vs. "Relax IP Restrictions" settings on a per-app basis to balance security with accessibility.
  • Security Center & Multi-Org Governance
  • Centralized Policy Management: Implement and manage Salesforce Security Center to define and push baseline security policies (e.g., Password Policies, Session Settings, Trusted IP Ranges) from a central tenant to all child orgs.
  • Drift Detection: Configure Security Center to monitor for Configuration Drift. Create alerts that trigger immediately if a local admin in a child org attempts to weaken security settings (e.g., disabling MFA or relaxing IP restrictions).
  • Health Visibility: Maintain a single-pane-of-glass view of security health scores across the entire multi-org landscape, reporting on KPI improvements to leadership.

Technical Advisory

  • Platform Limits: Advise the business on the performance impacts of security decisions (e.g., "How will encrypting this field impact SOQL query performance?").
  • Release Readiness: Review the Salesforce Release Notes (3x/year) specifically for security updates (e.g., MFA enforcement, Browser policy changes) and proactively prepare the org.

Qualifications

  • Required Salesforce Expertise (The "Must Haves"):
  • 10+ Years of hands-on experience in the Salesforce ecosystem as a Technical Architect, Developer, or Senior Administrator.
  • Sharing & Visibility Master: You can explain "Implicit Sharing," "Group Maintenance Tables," and "Apex Managed Sharing" in your sleep.
  • Apex & Metadata Fluency: You can read Apex triggers and understand how to query the LoginHistory or SetupAuditTrail objects via SOQL.
  • Implementation Experience: Proven track record of actually turning on and configuring Platform Encryption, Event Monitoring, or multi-factor authentication in a large, complex org.
  • Security Fundamentals:
  • Understanding of basic security concepts: Least Privilege, Separation of Duties, Encryption (At Rest vs. In Transit), and CIA Triad.
  • Familiarity with common web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10) specifically in the context of Salesforce (e.g., "How to prevent XSS in Visualforce/LWC").

Certifications:

  • Required: Salesforce Certified System Architect (or progress towards it).
  • Required: Salesforce Certified Sharing and Visibility Architect.
  • Required: Salesforce Certified Identity and Access Management Architect.
  • Bonus: Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA).

Why This Role?

Technical Depth: You won't be writing policies in Word documents all day. You will be in the Setup menu, in the IDE, and in the metadata, building tangible security solutions.

High Impact: You will control the keys to the kingdom, securing the data of millions of customers on one of the world's largest SaaS platforms.

descriptionHtml:

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience
 

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.

  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.

  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures — and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.

  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.



What You'll Actually Be Building
 

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.

  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.

  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.

  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output.

  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.

  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.

  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.

  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.

  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.



You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…
 

  • You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through — ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models.

  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.

  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.

  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.

  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.

  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.

  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.

  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.

  • You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.

  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.



Nice-to-Haves
 

  • Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)

  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns

  • Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

  • Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

À propos du poste

Expérience en production requise. Mentalité Builder non négociable.

Salesforce recrute des Forward Deployed Engineers — des Technical Builders expérimentés qui conçoivent, développent et déploient des solutions d'IA agentique directement dans les environnements clients en entreprise. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe de delivery, en étroite collaboration avec un Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder — un conseiller orienté client qui façonne la stratégie IA et pilote l'adoption) pour co-construire des solutions mises en production dès le premier jour. Les missions vont d'un grand compte stratégique unique à plusieurs comptes simultanés. Le fil conducteur : du vrai code, de vrais environnements, et un impact business mesurable. Ce travail couvre la configuration, la personnalisation et le déploiement full-stack — en livrant des solutions dont les clients dépendent.

L'expérience Builder
 

  • Développement assisté par l'IA : Livrez de vraies solutions clients, avec les meilleurs outils IA du marché — Cursor, Claude, et les produits Salesforce comme Vibes — intégrés à votre quotidien.

  • Delivery collaboratif : Vous travaillerez aux côtés de Senior Forward Deployed Engineers et d'un Deployment Strategist. Vous serez responsable de composants concrets, bénéficierez d'un mentorat structuré de personnes ayant déjà livré des systèmes agentiques à grande échelle, avec une trajectoire claire vers la conduite de projets complexes.

  • Accès à la frontière technologique : Notre plateforme d'IA agentique évolue en temps réel. Vous travaillerez sur des capacités que la plupart des ingénieurs n'aborderont pas avant des mois — couvrant Agentforce, la data, la plateforme et les architectures headless — et vos insights terrain alimenteront directement les équipes produit qui les développent.

  • Innovation continue : Vous devrez rester à la pointe, en expérimentant de nouveaux outils IA, modèles et frameworks, et en partageant vos apprentissages avec votre équipe et vos clients.



Ce que vous allez concrètement construire
 

  • Développer des agents IA et des expériences qui réalisent de vraies actions pour de vraies organisations. Nos solutions sont en production chez certaines des plus grandes entreprises mondiales. Ce travail a du sens parce que les clients en dépendent.

  • Concevoir l'intelligence des agents : prompts, raisonnement, appels d'outils et intégration avec les systèmes clients, en s'appuyant sur notre plateforme d'IA agentique et les techniques LLM actuelles.

  • Prendre en charge des composants techniques de bout en bout : du choix d'architecture jusqu'au déploiement, validé et observable en production.

Vous êtes notre Forward Deployed Engineer si…
 

  • Vous avez 3+ ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle ou en delivery technique, avec au moins un système en production dont vous seriez fier de nous parler — idéalement dans une stack IA, du développement full-stack, ou avec des modèles frontier.

  • Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme en Informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.

  • Vous comprenez la modélisation de données, les APIs et les patterns d'intégration suffisamment en profondeur pour les concevoir, pas seulement les consommer.

descriptionHtml:

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Join Salesforce’s Digital User Research team, part of Digital Marketing Technology. We deliver objective, actionable insights that shape customer-facing experiences and internal tools across Salesforce’s digital marketing portfolio, including websites and digital destinations, email and messaging, in-person and virtual events, and marketing-focused agentic experiences.

As Lead User Researcher, you will own research across two of the team’s most strategic areas: agentic experiences and event technology. You will help teams understand emerging mental models, unmet needs, friction, trust, and where people need transparency, control, guidance, or human support. You will also lead research that improves the digital experiences supporting Salesforce events across in-person, virtual, and on-demand formats.

We are seeking a curious, experienced researcher who knows how to select and combine methods such as interviews, usability testing, surveys, and behavioral data analysis to answer complex questions. You will lead research across multiple products and stakeholder groups, develop strategy across a portfolio of projects, build alignment around the research questions and opportunities that matter most, and communicate insights that influence product strategy and experience decisions.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Shape Research Strategy by proactively identify emerging research needs, surface gaps and opportunities, and provide a clear, evidence-based point of view to inform research priorities across the digital marketing portfolio.
  • Independently scope and plan multiple projects end to end, defining the decisions to inform, milestones, dependencies, audiences, methods, risks, and measures of success.
  • Translate ambiguous business and product questions into strategic and tactical research plans, reframing the opportunity and adjusting the approach as the evidence and business context evolve.
  • Creatively combine qualitative and quantitative methods to overcome constraints and deliver a more complete picture of the data. Methods may include interviews, contextual inquiry, jobs-to-be-done research, concept evaluation, usability testing, task studies, surveys, benchmarking, and experimentation.
  • Define credible audiences and recruitment criteria, protect data quality, and ensure findings appropriately represent the people and contexts the product is intended to serve.
  • Connect evidence across sources by synthesizing user research, analytics, experimentation, and industry research to identify patterns, communicate confidence and limitations, and deliver a more complete understanding of the user experience.
  • Build a deep understanding of customer and employee needs, digital behaviors, marketing goals, and evolving technologies to uncover opportunities across channels, journeys, audiences, and connected digital experiences.
  • Advance agentic experience research. Study how people understand, trust, and engage with AI agents, including expectations for autonomy, transparency, control, personalization, human oversight, failure recovery, and escalation.
  • Establish customer-centered measures of usefulness, task success, quality, trust, adoption,and agent performance across connected AI-powered experiences.
  • Conduct foundational and evaluative research across Salesforce’s in-person, virtual, and on-demand event experiences, including onsite observation, intercept interviews, surveys, and usability testing.
  • Translate evidence into clear recommendations, strategic guidance, measurement frameworks, and future-state direction that shape digital strategies, experience roadmaps, requirements, and experiments.
  • Create compelling narratives and data visualizations, present to audiences ranging from product teams to executives, and lead workshops that turn research findings into aligned decisions and follow-up actions.
  • Advance research methods, reusable tools, measurement standards, and responsible uses of AI; mentor others, and champion inclusive and accessible research.



You're Our Person If...

  • Deep expertise in qualitative research and strong fluency in quantitative methods, with excellent judgment about research questions, method selection, audience recruitment, evidence quality, and maintaining methodological rigor across research of varying scope and pace.
  • Ability to plan, design, execute, analyze, and communicate foundational, generative, evaluative, and measurement research at both strategic and tactical levels.
  • Comfortable conducting research in fast-paced, live event environments and are willing and able to travel approximately four to five times per year to support onsite research at Salesforce events.
  • A record of proactively identifying high-value research opportunities and influencing product strategy, roadmaps, requirements, designs, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing experiences and the ability to connect research evidence to customer and employee needs, business goals, channel strategies, technical considerations, and potential implications across the broader digital portfolio.
  • Working knowledge of basic statistical concepts and behavioral data, with the ability to interpret and integrate survey findings, digital analytics, and experimentation results alongside qualitative evidence while clearly communicating limitations.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency and experience building AI-assisted research workflows, with sound judgment about where AI adds value, where human expertise is essential, and how to prevent speed or automation from distorting a finding.
  • Strong facilitation, storytelling, and communication skills, with experience tailoring evidence and recommendations for product teams, cross-functional leaders, and executive audiences.
  • Experience strengthening a research practice through mentoring, reusable frameworks, enablement and research knowledge systems.
  • Ability to deliver high-quality work in a fast-moving environment with constrained timelines and collaborate effectively across globally distributed teams and time zones.
  • A commitment to responsible, ethical, and inclusive research, particularly in rapidly evolving AI contexts.

descriptionHtml:

Salesforce brings customer data, CRM, analytics, and AI together on a trusted platform. Our teams help organizations turn complex business and data requirements into secure, scalable solutions. In this role, you will help customers put Data 360 into production and build the technical foundation for reliable, enterprise-grade use cases.

The Experience

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.
  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.

You're Our Person If....

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
  • You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
  • You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
  • You've built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
  • You've implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.
  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.
  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.
  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Join an agile team with deep startup roots. We operate as a high-velocity 'startup-within-Salesforce,' following our recent acquisition. You’ll be managed by the same founders and engineers who built the original company, offering the autonomy of a small team backed by the global scale and trust of Salesforce. You will have the unique opportunity to perfect the original  '0 to 1' product with the founding team, as we push towards an order-of-magnitude increase in the scale of our customer base. 

Global supply chains still rely on slow, manual processes—email, spreadsheets, and fragmented data. The economy moves fast but supply chains don’t, creating an inefficiency that affects the $13T of goods shipped annually and is one of the largest untapped opportunities in modern enterprise.

Agentforce Operations is reimagining the supply chain with an AI-powered platform for designing, automating, and orchestrating end-to-end business processes, with seamless collaboration through familiar channels like email and Slack. For Salesforce, this represents a major back-office growth opportunity, while also delivering innovations that enhance the existing front-office business. Customers are clamoring for more, rapidly expanding their use cases as we enter an exhilarating growth phase. As one user put it: “I’ve been waiting for this for 20 years.”

What you’ll do

You would be joining at an exciting inflection point in Agentforce Operations’ history. Our product was built with intentional startup speed that created tight coupling, limited observability, and reliability and scaling gaps that are now surfacing as customer adoption accelerates.

As a performance engineer for Agentforce Operations, your mandate will be to radically optimize the scalability, resilience, and performance of our product and platform across the entire stack to help usher in this next phase of growth. The ideal candidate would be able to develop a deep technical understanding of our architecture and then deliver the end-to-end implementation of optimizations that would enable us to achieve greater scalability while simultaneously improving our reliability. Agentforce Operations manages complex, infinitely configurable states with equally complex state transitions and interfaces to teams across the organization. That means you'd be tackling a wide array of challenges that would include optimization of our existing data model, streamlining of our asynchronous operations patterns, profiling and rightsizing our infrastructure, and developing both the tools and observability to run experiments and empirically validate results. 


You would be considered the subject matter expert in matters of application performance and as such you’d operate with meaningful autonomy while building alignment across engineering. This role comes with ample opportunity for advancement by raising the bar on system quality, leveling up the engineers around you, and ultimately accelerating us toward our ambitious scaling goals.


Responsibilities

  • Diagnose and prioritize architectural problems across our distributed backend systems, contributing technical perspective to help the team invest in the right foundational work at the right time
  • Design and implement solutions to hard system problems including application performance optimization, infrastructure management, and data model improvements. 
  • Raise and maintain our engineering quality bar through pragmatic standards, guardrails, and team practices that prevent regressions and keep our product healthy and performant. 
  • Collaborate with peers across customer, product, and engineering to deeply understand customer needs, make pragmatic tradeoffs that maximize impact, and align on engineering reality
  • Mentor engineers as a senior peer and force multiplier, sharing expertise across backend architecture and system design while helping shape stronger engineering judgment, more effective collaboration, and a higher-performing team

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience as a backend engineer, building and operating user-facing applications and their underlying infrastructure 
  • Mastery of Golang, GraphQL, and Postgres, with demonstrated experience delivering high-performance optimizations. 
  • Major public cloud provider experience (AWS preferred). 
  • Deep expertise in multiple areas of backend engineering such as data modeling, db performance tuning, state management, API design, transactionality, concurrency, memory management, fault tolerance, and scaling, with the ability to pick up new technologies quickly
  • Repeated ownership of foundational system work in complex distributed systems, from diagnosing architectural problems to designing solutions to driving adoption across a team. 
  • Excellent writing and speaking skills and ability to lead real-time technical-design discussions
  • Demonstrated ownership and accountability, with a consistent track record of high standards, continuous improvement, and low-ego collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

  • B.S. in Computer Science (M.S. preferred)
  • Experience working in AWS, specifically with RDS, Elasticache, S3, and EKS. 
  • Exposure to Temporal, Istio, or Typesense 
  • Experience with CI/CD systems, specifically Jenkins and Spinnaker. 
  • Exposure to the supply chain, logistics, or manufacturing industry. (We will teach you otherwise!)
  • Familiarity with the Salesforce platform
  • Experience with workflow engines

Critically, this leader will bring the voice of the customer and frontline teams back into Product and Platform, using insights, data, and market signals to influence product priorities and improve the customer experience. What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Strengthen the Cloud Success Platform partnership: Establish a two-way operating model that ensures Cloud Success has early visibility into upcoming platform and product changes, while bringing the voice of the customer and frontline teams into product planning. Create clear communication channels, shared readiness mechanisms, and regular feedback loops that enable joint prioritization, faster readiness, and continuous influence on the platform roadmap.
  • New Product Introduction Framework: Strengthen and scale an enterprise-wide NPI framework across Salesforce product and platform innovation, ensuring Customer Success has early visibility and is ready to support new products and changes at scale. Embed readiness requirements across the full lifecycle—including digital support, offers, serviceability, customer support, enablement, and operational readiness—with consistent mechanisms to assess impact, prioritize actions, and coordinate execution. Move from reactive preparation to a proactive model where every innovation is designed and launched with Cloud Success readiness built in.

Partner closely with the CISO and Security teams to anticipate upcoming security programs, assess customer and operational impact, and build readiness well ahead of launch. Use strong cross-functional collaboration and executive influence to shape key decisions, ensuring every security rollout has a clear communication and go-to-market plan, with digital, self-service, support, and enablement capabilities in place to help customers adopt changes seamlessly while minimizing avoidable support demand.

You're Our Person If...

Demonstrated ability to understand complex technical concepts, anticipate platform and product dependencies, assess customer and operational impact, and translate emerging technology into actionable readiness, supportability, and go-to-market strategies. Comfortable engaging deeply with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Customer Success leaders to influence technical and product decisions.
  • Program Leadership: Proven experience leading NPI and building scalable readiness and governance frameworks within large, complex organizations. Ability to establish operating models that span multiple products, teams, and clouds, with strong rigor around tracking, gating, prioritization, dependencies, and accountability from innovation through launch and adoption.
  • Process Redesign: Experience diagnosing and fixing upstream engagement gaps in cross-functional release/readiness processes — shifting a function from reactive, late-stage involvement to proactive, early engagement.
  • Security & Risk Fluency: Experience anticipating and mitigating the operational/support impact of security mandates and controls before they reach customers — balancing security urgency with support capacity.

  • Cross-Functional Influence: Track record of aligning disparate stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Security, Platform teams) around a shared roadmap and priorities, including at the executive/SteerCo level.

What You'll Actually Be Doing


  • Become a Trusted SME: Act as the primary authority for Data Cloud to support project delivery, including how data architecture relates to the success of Agentforce and AI.
  • Strategic Design: Drive the creation of application and technical design documents (Blueprints/FSD) which leverage Salesforce best practices and effectively integrate Salesforce into the customer's infrastructure.
  • Data Democratization: Design and guide customer's enterprise data architecture, highlighting the importance of Data Governance and ensuring solutions adhere to security and privacy regulations.
  • Technical Excellence: Provide guidance on integration development best practices, Enterprise Architecture standards, and environment management. Lead code reviews and define coding standards (SQL, SSJS, AMPScript).
  • Stakeholder Management: Facilitate and influence Executive Customer stakeholders while aligning technology strategy to business value and ROI.
  • Risk Mitigation: Troubleshoot key customer implementation issues and demonstrate the ability to drive to a successful resolution through proactive risk management.

Knowledge of AMPScript and SSJS is a strong plus.
  • Minimum of 10 years' experience in professional services
  • Architectural Proficiency: Deep knowledge in MDM, Data Distribution, and Data Modeling concepts, with a strong understanding of metadata and lineage.
  • Solution Documentation: Ability to clearly and articulately document solutions, including data flows, engineering flowcharts, and technical artifacts.
  • Requirement Translation: Ability to create a solution based on client requirements and map Business Processes into our technical product suite (e.g., mapping Data Cloud DMOs to Marketing Cloud Data Extensions).

You bring the Data Foundation Delivery to life, including core data capabilities, associated frameworks, and the ability to operate across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft). As a Salesforce practitioner/leader, you help customers bring the Salesforce ecosystem into the broader landscape of technology investments they've already made — balancing platform-agnostic execution (interoperable, open-standards, multi-vendor) and platform-centric execution (Salesforce-native), so the data foundation fits the customer's reality rather than forcing a single stack. You are a hands-on practitioner of AI-augmented professional services delivery and an emerging-to-established thought leader on the agentic future of the SaaS industry — applying a forward-looking perspective on enterprise data, AI agents, and the SaaS ecosystem to how you advise and deliver, and contributing that experience back to the practice's point of view. What You'll Actually Be Doing
Advisory & Strategy

  • Lead discovery: stakeholder interviews, current-state assessment, use-case and KPI definition; at senior levels, serve as trusted advisor to customer CxOs and shape the business case
  • Assess data maturity and build a phased, customer-calibrated roadmap
  • Align customer stakeholders and sponsors; contribute to/own the business case and expected outcomes
  • Frame guidance as adaptable options, meeting customers at their entry point (customer-360, regulatory governance, analytics modernization, unstructured/RAG)

Architecture & Delivery

  • Design/set/approve target-state architecture across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360 / Informatica IDMC / MuleSoft)
  • Deliver both platform-agnostic and platform-centric execution — integrate Salesforce cleanly with (or position it as the center of gravity within) the customer's existing multi-vendor technology investments (data platforms, warehouses, lakes, and tools)
  • Validate architecture decisions through scoped POCs before production build
  • Deliver working software/value every phase — no big-bang, governance-first discipline
  • Embed governance, quality, security, and privacy from the start
  • Build for dual consumption: analytics for people and agentic AI for machines



Delivery Oversight & Risk (Director-level emphasis)

  • Provide architectural governance and quality assurance across concurrent engagements
  • Own delivery risk: exec buy-in, business engagement, scope, and dependency management



AI-Augmented Delivery

  • Apply/set the standard for AI-augmented professional services delivery — use AI tools (Claude Code, Gemini, Lucid AI, NotebookLM) across the engagement lifecycle to compress effort and raise quality
  • Build (or define the approach for) reusable, capability-driven (not tool-centric) assets: prompt templates, skills, and agents that deliver a capability regardless of underlying tool
  • Work with human-at-the-helm rigor so AI-accelerated output stays trusted, auditable, and grounded; at senior levels, set measurable AI-acceleration targets and quality guardrails
  • Contribute proven patterns and assets back to the practice's playbook, accelerators, and reference IP



Industry Thought Leadership (Agentic SaaS Future)

  • Bring (or own) a forward-looking perspective on the agentic future of the SaaS industry into engagements — helping customers build AI-ready, agent-native data foundations
  • Contribute to (or shape) the practice's point of view — POVs, reference patterns, and enablement on where enterprise data and AI agents are heading
  • Grow as, or represent the practice as, an internal and customer-facing voice on agentic delivery



Governance & Enablement

  • Establish stewardship, RACI, and sustainable operating models with the customer
  • Produce clear, concise, executive-ready summaries alongside deep technical detail
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance/leadership to Consultants, Architects, and (at Director level) Senior Advisors on the engagement; hand off with runbooks and a sustainable operating model

  • Advisory impact / Business outcomes: measurable stakeholder alignment and adoption; clear business (not just technical) outcomes realized
  • AI-augmented delivery: apply AI tooling to reduce delivery effort while improving consistency; contribute reusable prompt/skill/agent assets to the practice, adopted team-wide at senior levels

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Solution Engineering Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both solution engineering and sales. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Solution Engineering careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned an experienced Solution Engineering Buddy who will provide hands-on coaching and involve you in some of their live deals. You will also be paired with experienced Sales Development Buddies during the Sales Rotation and you also get to call your first salesforce leads and find your first deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior solution engineering and sales professionals during our inspiration sessions.

By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a fast-paced, successful career. We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards.

Who are we looking for?


  • You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree)
    • For the Solution Engineering Path, we consider applicants from the following academic backgrounds:
      Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science/Data Engineering, Information Systems, or other disciplines
  • You are a creative problem-solver
  • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English and Arabic is essential

What does our new EMEA Graduate Program look like?


The program is structured as follows:

Introduction Month

During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

Rotations

During the Graduate Program, you will experience both the Solution Engineering Path and the Sales Path. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.

If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Solution Engineering, you will then join the Sales Graduate Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will gain exposure to both roles. The time spent mastering the fundamentals of these complementary disciplines will enable you to be more productive and impactful upon promotion.

Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.

Examples of what you can expect during the rotations


Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation

  • Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level
  • Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations
  • Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view

Sales Graduate Rotation

  • Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies
  • Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation

What’s in it for you?

  • A clear and structured career path within our Solution Engineering organisation
  • The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment
  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

Map your future for the coming years

With the EMEA Graduate Program - Solution Engineering Path, you can continue to progress:

  • After completing the Graduate Program rotations, you may progress to Associate Solution Engineer, with opportunities to work across ESB, SMB, and GRB customer segments, or join our Specialist SE team. In some instances, this path may vary or be subject to change.
  • With our strong mentoring culture, we strive to develop industry-leading Solution Engineering leaders. This is a phenomenal opportunity to build international experience within an organisation that has transformed the enterprise software market through cloud computing.

Vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler au sein d'une équipe dynamique avec des clients variés, tout en bénéficiant de formations personnalisées et de belles perspectives d'évolution de carrière.

Ce rôle implique la vente de solutions de gestion des revenus des canaux de vente, incluant :

  • La gestion de l'écosystème de partenaires Salesforce (Partner Ecosystem Management - PEM, qui comprend le PRM, les parcours partenaires/Parcours Partenaires, les incitations unifiées, la planification des comptes, etc.)
  • La gestion des revenus des canaux de vente Salesforce (Channel Revenue Management - ChRM)
  • Les offres Cloud associées s'inscrivant dans la plateforme Customer 360, le cas échéant

Au quotidien

Nos Account Executives interagissent avec les clients existants ainsi qu'avec de nouveaux prospects pour vendre l'ensemble de la plateforme Salesforce Customer 360, en se focalisant particulièrement sur la croissance du chiffre d'affaires via les écosystèmes de partenaires et l'optimisation des opérations de vente indirecte. Ils construisent des relations solides et de confiance tant avec les collaborateurs clés qu'avec les dirigeants décisionnaires (C-Level) de leur secteur, et deviennent des experts pour aider les clients à mesurer la valeur de leurs investissements Salesforce. Les parties prenantes clés incluent notamment les Directeurs/VP des ventes indirectes, les Directeurs des partenariats, les Directeurs des Systèmes d'Information (DSI/CIO), les Directeurs Commerciaux (CRO), les responsables financiers, les Directeurs Financiers (CFO) et les responsables des remises et incitations (Rebate/Incentive Managers).


Vous mettrez à profit vos compétences pour développer des opportunités, tant à partir de prospects qualifiés que par de la prospection sur des comptes vierges (whitespace), en vous ciblant sur les entreprises qui vendent via des revendeurs, distributeurs, prestataires de services gérés (MSP), concessionnaires, courtiers indépendants ou agents. 75 % du commerce mondial passe par les canaux de vente indirects. Vos activités quotidiennes comprendront :

  • Le développement de relations clés avec les parties prenantes chez les clients et la maximisation de la satisfaction client sur les comptes attribués, en vous concentrant spécifiquement sur leurs ventes indirectes et leurs stratégies de partenariat.
  • L'élaboration et le pilotage de la stratégie globale à long terme pour le compte, alignée sur les objectifs commerciaux du client liés à l'optimisation des revenus des canaux de vente, à l'engagement des partenaires et à la rentabilité.
  • La coordination des ressources internes de Salesforce, comme les spécialistes en gestion des revenus des canaux de vente, pour répondre aux besoins métiers du client.
  • La planification stratégique sur les comptes attribués (account planning), en coordination avec les équipes de vente Prime et Cloud pour garantir un alignement stratégique sur les initiatives liées aux canaux de vente.
  • La mise en valeur de la proposition de valeur de Salesforce pour les solutions de gestion des revenus des canaux de vente, en mettant en avant des bénéfices tels que : la simplification de l'ensemble du cycle de vie des partenaires, la stimulation de la croissance de l'écosystème, la maximisation de la rentabilité, la simplification des flux de travail des partenaires grâce à l'automatisation, l'accélération de la collaboration en temps réel, l'amélioration de la productivité des partenaires, l'obtention d'une visibilité de bout en bout sur les stocks, incitations et prix des canaux de vente, ainsi que la maximisation des profits grâce à une gestion automatisée des remises.
  • La prise en charge des problématiques clients telles que : une stratégie partenaire inefficace, des difficultés à fidéliser les partenaires, des problèmes de routage des pistes commercialisables (leads), une mauvaise qualité des données impactant les transactions partenaires, des difficultés de communication avec les partenaires, des architectures technologiques complexes pour la gestion des canaux, des difficultés à engager efficacement les partenaires et une charge de travail administrative manuelle excessive.
  • Le pilotage de la croissance au sein des comptes existants attribués en identifiant des opportunités d'extension de l'utilisation des solutions PRM, PRM+ et ChRM.
  • L'utilisation des fonctionnalités d'IA de la plateforme pour démontrer sa valeur, notamment via le lead scoring (notation des pistes) et l'analyse du pipeline des partenaires.
  • Le positionnement de la solution Partner Tracks comme un module complémentaire pour les clients PRM existants afin d'optimiser la montée en compétences des partenaires, de développer et d'étendre le réseau de partenaires, et d'augmenter le chiffre d'affaires par canal.

  • Une expérience dans la vente auprès d'entreprises utilisant des canaux de vente indirects (revendeurs, distributeurs, concessionnaires, etc.) constitue un atout majeur.
  • Une expérience dans la vente de solutions CRM, PRM ou de gestion des canaux de vente est très vivement souhaitée.
