Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

A Salesforce Solution Architect is a trusted advisor first. They work alongside enterprise customers to understand their business, shape the right solution, and guide its delivery from vision to value. They connect business strategy to technical execution — bringing the clarity, judgment, and experience needed to make the right calls in complex, high-stakes environments.

On top of that foundation, we expect our SAs to bring genuine enterprise solution depth and to operate with an AI-native delivery mindset — using AI as a standard instrument of how they architect, deliver, and coach. These are not separate capabilities: the best SAs in our practice combine strategic business context, architectural rigor, and modern delivery practices fluently.

Native AI Delivery — Our Operating Model
At Salesforce Professional Services, Native AI Delivery is how we work:

  • Leveraging modern AI toolchains (Claude, Cursor, Agentforce, Apromore, etc.) across the delivery lifecycle to accelerate ideation, architecture, and governance
  • Architecting agentic solutions that automate and optimize end-to-end business outcomes for customers
  • Accelerating discovery, functional modeling, and solution design through AI-assisted workflows
  • Compressing delivery timelines: days → hours, hours → minutes
  • Coaching customers and delivery teams on adopting AI-native ways of working to maximize business agility



Solution Mastery — What We Expect
Strategic solution depth requires platform literacy and architectural vision. Candidates must demonstrate:

  • Enterprise platform fluency on Salesforce or a directly comparable enterprise platform (Veeva Vault/CRM, IQVIA OCE, SAP S/4HANA, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics) — understanding platform boundaries, governance, and capabilities at scale
  • Architecture ownership: multi-cloud/multi-system landscape design, target-state blueprints, capability gap analysis, and build vs. buy vs. configure trade-off decisions
  • Integration & data strategy: establishing enterprise integration patterns, system-of-record boundaries, and unified data models without getting bogged down in low-level API mechanics
  • Agentic & AI solution strategy: defining agentic business use cases, orchestrating AI workflows within core business processes, and ensuring trustworthy enterprise AI adoption



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to enterprise customers — understand their business, define the right solution, and earn their trust as a long-term partner
  • Lead end-to-end solution design across one or more workstreams: aligning business capabilities, solution blueprints, and acceptance criteria
  • Co-create the vision with the customer and own the solution narrative — from executive alignment to enterprise architecture governance
  • Drive consultative discovery sessions that uncover core business drivers and translate complex business problems into viable, high-impact solutions
  • Architect Agentforce and agentic capabilities that drive operational efficiency and transform customer business models
  • Remove delivery roadblocks, navigate trade-offs, and ensure functional alignment across business, technical, and executive stakeholders
  • Guide customers and project teams on architectural best practices, solution governance, and AI-native delivery models
  • Connect across all levels — from delivery squads to the C-suite — translating technical complexity into clear business value and actionable decisions



You're Our Person If...

  • 10+ years of enterprise solution delivery or digital transformation experience, with proven end-to-end solution ownership on complex, multi-workstream programs
  • 1+ year of deep domain experience within a relevant industry vertical (pharma, insurance...)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead enterprise-level architecture blueprints, multi-system integration strategies, and business capability mapping
  • Proven experience embedding AI-native tools and agentic solution concepts into delivery and customer workflows
  • Strong track record of executive stakeholder management, storytelling, and cross-functional leadership

The Experience

Un Solution Architect Salesforce est avant tout un conseiller de confiance. Il travaille aux côtés de clients grands comptes pour comprendre leur activité, façonner la solution adaptée et piloter sa mise en œuvre, de la vision à la création de valeur. Il relie la stratégie métier à l'exécution technique, en apportant la clarté, le discernement et l'expérience nécessaires pour prendre les bonnes décisions dans des environnements complexes et à forts enjeux.

Sur cette base, nous attendons de nos SAs qu'ils apportent une réelle profondeur de solution à l'échelle de l'entreprise et qu'ils adoptent un état d'esprit de delivery « AI-native », en utilisant l'IA comme un outil standard dans la manière dont ils conçoivent, livrent et accompagnent. Ces compétences ne sont pas distinctes : les meilleurs SAs de notre practice combinent avec aisance contexte business stratégique, rigueur architecturale et pratiques de delivery modernes.

Native AI Delivery — Notre modèle opérationnel
Chez Salesforce Professional Services, la Native AI Delivery est notre façon de travailler :

  • Exploiter les chaînes d'outils d'IA modernes (Claude, Cursor, Agentforce, Apromore, etc.) tout au long du cycle de delivery pour accélérer l'idéation, l'architecture et la gouvernance
  • Concevoir des solutions agentiques qui automatisent et optimisent les résultats business de bout en bout pour les clients
  • Accélérer la phase de discovery, la modélisation fonctionnelle et la conception de solutions grâce à des workflows assistés par l'IA
  • Réduire les délais de delivery : de jours à heures, d'heures à minutes
  • Accompagner les clients et les équipes de delivery dans l'adoption de méthodes de travail AI-native afin de maximiser l'agilité business



Solution Mastery — Ce que nous attendons
La profondeur stratégique des solutions exige une bonne maîtrise des plateformes et une vision architecturale. Les candidats doivent démontrer :

  • Une maîtrise des plateformes d'entreprise sur Salesforce ou sur une plateforme d'entreprise directement comparable (Veeva Vault/CRM, IQVIA OCE, SAP S/4HANA, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics), avec une compréhension des limites, de la gouvernance et des capacités de la plateforme à grande échelle
  • La responsabilité de l'architecture : conception de paysages multi-cloud/multi-systèmes, blueprints de l'architecture cible, analyse des écarts de capacités et arbitrages entre développer, acheter ou configurer
  • Une stratégie d'intégration et de données : définir des patterns d'intégration d'entreprise, les périmètres de système de référence et des modèles de données unifiés, sans s'enliser dans les mécanismes d'API de bas niveau
  • Une stratégie de solutions agentiques et d'IA : définir des cas d'usage métier agentiques, orchestrer des workflows d'IA au sein des processus métier clés et garantir une adoption de l'IA d'entreprise digne de confiance



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Agir comme conseiller stratégique auprès des clients grands comptes : comprendre leur activité, définir la bonne solution et gagner leur confiance en tant que partenaire de long terme
  • Piloter la conception de solutions de bout en bout sur un ou plusieurs workstreams : alignement des capacités métier, des blueprints de solution et des critères d'acceptation
  • Co-construire la vision avec le client et porter le récit de la solution, de l'alignement avec la direction à la gouvernance de l'architecture d'entreprise
  • Animer des sessions de discovery consultatives qui font émerger les moteurs business essentiels et traduisent des problématiques métier complexes en solutions viables et à fort impact
  • Concevoir des capacités Agentforce et agentiques qui améliorent l'efficacité opérationnelle et transforment les modèles économiques des clients
  • Lever les obstacles de delivery, arbitrer les compromis et assurer l'alignement fonctionnel entre les parties prenantes métier, techniques et de direction
  • Conseiller les clients et les équipes projet sur les bonnes pratiques d'architecture, la gouvernance des solutions et les modèles de delivery AI-native
  • Dialoguer à tous les niveaux, des équipes de delivery au comité de direction, en traduisant la complexité technique en valeur business claire et en décisions concrètes



You're Our Person If...

  • 10+ ans d'expérience en delivery de solutions d'entreprise ou en transformation digitale, avec une responsabilité avérée de bout en bout sur des programmes complexes multi-workstreams
  • 1+ an d'expérience approfondie dans un secteur d'activité pertinent (pharma, assurance...)
  • Capacité démontrée à piloter des blueprints d'architecture d'entreprise, des stratégies d'intégration multi-systèmes et la cartographie des capacités métier
  • Expérience avérée d'intégration d'outils AI-native et de concepts de solutions agentiques dans les workflows de delivery et clients
  • Solide expérience en gestion des parties prenantes de direction, en storytelling et en leadership transverse

title: Applied AI Architect (Principal/Lead)
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications will be accepted until 01/31/2027.

About the Role

Our architect team is organized into four domains that together make the platform work for customers: Platform Advantage (why Salesforce, why now), Emerging Tech & UI Innovation (agent execution and dev tooling), Data & AI Excellence (data, semantics, and AI context), and Governance & Trust (identity, security, and audit). This req can land in any of the four, based on where your deepest expertise fits and where the team has the most need at the time of hire.

Across all four domains, the DNA is the same: you lead with the customer's business and technical problem, not a product pitch, you're fluent across Salesforce and its alternatives, and you stay engaged through execution so the work actually lands, not just the recommendation.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day will concentrate in one or two of the following, depending on domain placement:

  • Agent Architecture (Platform Advantage / Governance & Trust): orchestration, agent-to-agent interaction, state and memory, guardrails, testing.
  • MCP & Capability Architecture (Platform Advantage / Emerging Tech): exposing business capabilities for agents to discover and act on, not just raw objects.
  • Data 360 & Semantic Architecture (Data & AI Excellence): unified customer data, semantic layers, and the context AI needs to be useful.
  • Headless & Composable Architecture (Platform Advantage / Emerging Tech): APIs, headless experiences, and composable extensions of Salesforce beyond the standard UI.
  • AI-Assisted Development (Emerging Tech): coding assistants, reviewing AI-generated work, dev lifecycle and quality practices.
  • AI Governance & Security (Governance & Trust): identity and permissions, data access, agent authority, human-in-the-loop controls, audit.


Regardless of domain, you'll also:

  • Work collaboratively across multiple pre and post sale teams.
  • Align C-suite stakeholders around a shared view of a business problem and map it to a capability someone can act on.
  • Help resolve platform-fit ambiguity for customers facing conflicting internal recommendations or a troubled prior rollout.
  • Name ambiguity and route it explicitly to the right domain rather than letting unclear work default to whoever's in the room.


What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 5+ years in enterprise or solutions architecture, with direct experience influencing senior technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience with AI tooling to build solutions, learn new skills, and be more efficient with your job.
  • Deep, credible expertise in at least one of the six focus areas above, deep enough to be the final word in a room, not conversational familiarity.
  • Fluency across the Salesforce platform or at least one major alternative / adjacent technology relevant to your focus area.
  • A track record of staying engaged through delivery, including recovering stalled or politically stuck work.
  • B.S., M.S. or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering or MIS

Preferred:

  • Working knowledge of a second focus area above, enough to know when to hand off rather than overreach.
  • Experience untangling a failed or stalled enterprise rollout (data, MDM, platform, or AI) for a customer.
  • Strong visual communication skills for architecture storytelling.


Domain Placement

Final domain assignment (Platform Advantage, Emerging Tech & UI Innovation, Data & AI Excellence, or Governance & Trust) is determined during the interview process based on demonstrated depth and current team need, not fixed at the time of posting.

Your passion for well-crafted software that solves real problems will be supported by best-in-class AI tools and a team of talented builders around you.


The Senior Builder Experience

  • Technical Ownership: Partner with a Deployment Strategist to own customer outcomes end-to-end. You're the senior technical authority in the room, ensuring deliverables meet the  highest engineering  standards, whether it was generated by an AI tool by a colleague or written by you directly. 
  • AI-Supported  Engineering: Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes are embedded in your  daily workflow. The conventions and patterns you develop tend to propagate through the team because other Builders look to your work as reference.
  • Roadmap Influence: Your field experience routes directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps you hit and the edge cases you encounter in real life customer environments become the features they ship. Senior Forward Deployed Engineers are the most credible voice in agentic AIproduct evolution.
  • Continuous Innovation: You're expected to stay at the forefront — piloting emerging AI tools, experimenting with new models and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Own end-to-end build and deployment of agentic AI solutions for Salesforce's most strategic customers — from architecture decisions through production handoff.
  • Design and ship agentic systems on the Agentforce platform: agent logic, tool calls, multi-agent orchestration, deterministic guardrails, and the integration patterns that hold up in enterprise environments. Your reference implementations become the basis for how other Builders approach similar problems.
  • Own the data lifecycle: model design, processing pipelines, and data readiness for AI applications across Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer-specific platforms.
  • Resolve the technical blockers that other engineers can't — data integration failures, model deployment issues, orchestration breakdowns, performance regressions. These problems are routed to you because of your track record of solving them.
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes across engagements.
  • Develop proofs-of-concept and MVPs quickly, with the judgment to know which decisions can be deferred and which need to be right the first time.
  • Codify what you learn. The patterns, reusable assets, and internal frameworks that come out of your real customer work become the playbooks the rest of the org draws from.
  • Mentor other Engineers through code reviews, pair sessions, and shared work. Most of your influence on developing engineers happens inside the same codebases you're building in.
  • Provide technical depth on at-risk or strategically critical deployments when senior engineering judgment is needed.
  • Surface field insights directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps and edge cases you encounter in real customer environments are some of the most valuable inputs to the Agentforce roadmap.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist on your team to translate complex customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Senior Forward Deployed Engineer If…

  • You have 6+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with proven end-to-end ownership of scalable production systems in enterprise AI, cloud, or SaaS environments.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • You're an expert in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex, and conversant in the others.
  • You've integrated LLMs into production, used frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and applied prompt engineering and responsible AI practices in real customer contexts.
  • You have deep experience in data modeling, processing, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency across platforms like Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, or Databricks.

  • Partner with Engineering, Security, Procurement, and FinOps on vendor commitments, consumption tracking, usage optimization, and spend dashboards

  • Prepare and present executive-ready materials for council and leadership reviews that turn complex data into clear recommendations

  • You have extensive financial modeling experience, including scenario planning, ROI analysis, unit economics, and margin analysis.

  • Act as EMEA's subject-matter expert on treasury regulatory compliance across jurisdictions.

  • Support FX team in monitoring regional currency exposures.

  • Drive operational transformation across EMEA workflows, ensuring seamless administration of TMS, BAM, payment controls, and automated cash pooling infrastructure.
  • Own treasury-related audit requirements and bank confirmations; serve as the region's primary interface with internal auditors on SOX testing.
  • Represent EMEA treasury performance, risks, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership, including Global Treasury and the Treasurer.
  • Step in as regional backup for other Treasury teams when needed on payments, cash reconciliation, FX settlements, and bank user administration.



You're Our Person If...

  • Strong command of EMEA regulatory, compliance, tax, and banking frameworks with sound judgment in risk mitigation.
  • People management experience, developing team members into strong operational and strategic contributors.

The Experience:


The Engagement Delivery Senior Manager role is part of Salesforce Professional Services in Iberia, a team of delivery professionals working directly with Spain and Portugal's enterprise customers. You'll join a practice navigating one of the most demanding moments in its history: the shift to Agentforce and Life Sciences Cloud delivery at enterprise scale, in regulated industries.


As an Engagement Delivery Senior Manager specialised in Life Sciences, you own the successful end-to-end delivery of our most complex pharma, biotech and medtech programs. You will be accountable for scope, timeline, financials, quality and customer satisfaction across programs built on Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, Data Cloud and Agentforce, and you will lead programs that coexist with, integrate with or migrate from Veeva Systems. You'll be a trusted delivery partner for CIO/CTO-level and IT leadership stakeholders, working hand-in-hand with the delivery team, who owns the technical directio, while you own the engagement, and you'll raise the bar for the Iberia delivery community.

What You'll Actually Be Doing:


Lead & Deliver

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of large, multi-cloud, multi-workstream Life Sciences programs, from discovery through go-live and hypercare
  • Serve as the overall leader of the project team, form the team, establish strong communication channels, and give clarity, motivation and direction throughout the engagement
  • Build and lead project plans; supervise progress and timelines, adjust schedules and plans as needed, and ensure on-time, on-budget delivery
  • Lead Veeva-to-Salesforce coexistence, migration and replacement programs, coordinating data migration, cutover and parallel-run strategies in partnership with the delivery team
  • Perform project management activities that ensure adherence to Salesforce methodology, project gates and governance (steering committees, status reporting, decision logs)
  • Anticipate and remove obstacles that slow down or prevent teams from delivering on project goals; act as the primary escalation point for delivery issues

Own the Commercials

  • Own engagement financials: revenue recognition, margin, forecasting, utilisation and resourcing across your portfolio
  • Supervise utilization of project resources in alignment with resource allocation and budget, including timely entry and approvals of project timesheets
  • Manage scope and change control rigorously; identify, negotiate and land change requests to protect margin and outcomes
  • Partner with Sales and pre-sales on shaping, estimating, staffing and de-risking Life Sciences opportunities and SOWs
  • Work as an extension of the account team to extend the Salesforce footprint

Manage Risk, Quality & Compliance

  • Identify, quantify and mitigate delivery risk early; maintain risk, issue and dependency management across the program
  • Participate in end-to-end implementation planning, including risk and issue management, communication and business organizational change
  • Ensure delivery meets the regulatory and compliance expectations of the industry (GxP, CSV/validation, 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR, Sunshine Act / transparency regulations, consent and data privacy), coordinating validation and quality activities within the project plan
  • Govern quality gates, cutover readiness and go-live criteria in partnership with the delivery team
  • Facilitate User Acceptance Testing with business end users, including coordination and user acceptance sign-off

Advise & Influence

  • Be the trusted delivery advisor of customer IT and business leadership, translating business strategy and regulatory constraints into a pragmatic, deliverable roadmap
  • Facilitate requirements gathering and assist with crafting project deliverables and Salesforce documentation as needed
  • Build and sustain senior customer relationships; manage expectations and satisfaction (CSAT) throughout the engagement
  • Produce and own the key delivery artefacts: statement of work, delivery plan, governance model, RAID log, status reporting, and go-live / cutover plans
  • Represent Salesforce Professional Services in executive conversations, steering committees and customer events

Enable & Grow

  • Mentor and coach Engagement Managers and Delivery Leads, building the next generation of delivery leaders in the practice
  • Build and share Life Sciences and Veeva-related delivery assets, accelerators, playbooks and lessons learned across Iberia and EMEA
  • Drive delivery excellence and champion adoption of AI tooling in delivery
  • Maintain and grow certifications aligned with the practice (project management, Life Sciences, Agentforce, Data Cloud)
  • Lead delivery community sessions, internal reviews and knowledge-sharing initiatives

You're Our Person If...

  • 7+ years of professional services, consulting, or program/project management experience, with 3+ years managing complex technology implementations (Salesforce platform experience strongly preferred)
  • Proven track record owning end-to-end delivery and financials of enterprise programs (scope, timeline, margin, quality, CSAT), including external client projects with a focus on software development, CRM and SaaS environments
  • Proven experience in Life Sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech) delivering with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud / Health Cloud and/or Veeva Systems (CRM, Vault, Network), including coexistence or migration scenarios
  • Solid understanding of Life Sciences commercial and medical processes: HCP/HCO engagement, call planning, omnichannel, samples, consent management, MLR/approved content, field force operations
  • Working knowledge of industry regulation and compliance: GxP, computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR, transparency and aggregate-spend reporting
  • Ability to balance business and technical requirements to produce a project plan, and to lead enterprise-wide engagements, facilitating meetings with client executives and proactively managing project risks, dependencies and estimates
  • Demonstrated project management skills, with direct responsibility for leading project teams of 10+ members and managing budgets and schedules
  • Demonstrated ability to have difficult conversations, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality results on time and within budget
  • Experience managing and maintaining clear communication with remote consultants, with outstanding interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
  • Practical, daily use of AI tools (Agentforce-style assistants, ChatGPT/Claude) for planning, reporting and productivity
  • Fluent in Spanish and English (Portuguese is a plus for our Iberia coverage)
  • Availability to travel regionally, and occasionally internationally, depending on customer needs

Even Better If...

  • Project management methodology certification such as PMP, SAFe or Scrum
  • Experience leading one or more Veeva-to-Salesforce migration programs as engagement / delivery owner
  • Hands-on delivery of Agentforce or Data Cloud use cases in Life Sciences (e.g. HCP assistants, medical inquiry, field rep copilots)
  • Veeva knowledge or certifications, or in-depth Veeva Vault / Veeva CRM program experience
  • Experience with validated environments and formal quality systems in pharma
  • Experience providing senior-level consulting and counsel to client business and technology executives as a trusted advisor

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

As a member of the Cloud Success Readiness team, you will be deeply invested in every aspect of the Industries Cloud customer experience. You will work closely with Technology & Product (T&P) and our Customer Success Group (CSG) teams to ensure that we are delivering customer success to every customer at scale.

  • Cloud Success Readiness improves customer Adoption and Product Quality by proactively addressing the most relevant customer needs, and by readying our stakeholders to deliver product innovation to our customers.
  • As a Readiness Architect, you will be responsible for understanding the  Industries Cloud product portfolio, maintaining deep knowledge of product capabilities, and how they map to key customer use cases.
  • You will leverage your product knowledge and technical expertise to surface product insights and recommendations, and document Product Feedback for the T&P organization. You’ll work closely with Cloud Success teams, including Success Architects, Success Guides, Support Engineers, and Account Success stakeholders to scale your product expertise and knowledge of the product lifecycle to better enable their work with customers.
  • You will manage your work via Strategic Initiatives across the product lifecycle including new products and features, end-of-life retirements, and strategic programs such as migration or adoption efforts.
  • You will act as early adopters to bring architectural guidance, product expertise, innovation, and knowledge capital to our stakeholders in Customer Success and Technology & Products.
  • The ideal candidate will be comfortable collaborating within a larger team of subject matter experts and developing key stakeholder relationships across the organization to influence decision making.

Key Responsibilities

Product Lifecycle & Subject Matter Expertise

  • Maintain a deep technical, functional, and domain understanding of the Industries Cloud product portfolio, roadmap, and all in-market and new products.
  • Act as an early adopter, developing expertise for all new product introductions, feature releases, large-scale migrations, or product retirements.
  • Practice continuous learning through first-hand product experimentation and participation in Product-driven betas and pilots.

Strategic Alignment & Product Feedback

  • Establish and own relationships with Product Management Leaders and key subject matter experts, strengthening the strategic partnership with T&P.
  • Engage T&P and CSG stakeholders in the development of product feedback and roadmaps.
  • Identify, document, and track recommended product enhancements based on customer, partner, and internal stakeholder input.
  • Develop product requirements and deliver them to Product Leadership for roadmap consideration.

Stakeholder Enablement & Readiness

  • Document best practices and learnings from product interactions (like pilots and pre-launch discovery) to deliver readiness for scale.
  • Deliver this knowledge capital and architectural guidance to Cloud Success teams, including Success Architects, Success Guides, Support Engineers, and Account Success stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with your Cloud Success team to create a holistic strategic approach that supports the overall product strategy and customer success.

Customer Adoption Strategy

  • Provide product expertise to support the creation and rollout of strategies aimed at improving the product adoption score.
  • Actively participate in efforts to improve overall customer health for the product.

Continuous Improvement

  • Work with other Readiness Success Architects across Cloud Success to share best practices and continuously improve the team's operating model

Skills & Expertise

  • Executive Communication: Strong oral and written communication skills. Proven record of presenting to and updating internal and external stakeholders, including executive personas.
  • Prioritization Agility: Approach work with a ‘beginner’s mind’ and shift focus and direction when needed to drive higher priority outcomes.
  • Drive for Results: Can be counted on to exceed goals successfully; is constantly and consistently one of the top performers; very bottom-line oriented; steadfastly pushes self and others for results.
  • Critical & Strategic Thinking: Ability to confidently synthesize a broad array of information, identify themes, and develop tactical plans to drive meaningful business changes with executives.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Can apply domain and product knowledge to influence product leaders priorities and design decisions. Build relationships as trusted partner with Technology & Product organization.
  • Content & Training Development: Creating, managing, and distributing relevant training materials that is visually clear to meet needs of varying audiences of business and technical aptitude.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Acting as a liaison between departments such as product and engineering, and customer success roles like Guides, Support and Architects to ensure content is accurate, and impactful.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 9+ years experience in Customer Success or Product Management individual contributor role in the SaaS industry.
  • Hands-on experience working with Salesforce products, including deep understanding of current product suite and product capabilities that meet common customer use cases; understanding of competitor products and landscape a plus.
  • Track record of collaborating within a team of subject matter experts who deliver against strategic business initiatives.
  • Has held positions requiring interaction with both technical and non-technical stakeholders across different functions. Understands and can translate customer use cases to technical and functional requirements.
  • Has developed enablement materials and delivered training to functional and technical audiences
  • Enablement, consulting or Salesforce product experience a plus.

We are looking for a seasoned Security Practices Director with strong Application Security (AppSec) credentials to join our Professional Services team, leading security and compliance engagements that help customers maximize the value of their Salesforce investments — safely and at scale. This role is primarily an AppSec expertise role; prior consulting/engagement management experience is a plus but not required — we'll support your growth into the client delivery and engagement-management aspects of the role.


What You'll Do

  • Apply AppSec expertise (secure SDLC, vulnerability assessment, threat modeling, pen-test interpretation) to lead and validate technical security engagements for enterprise customers
  • Identify and advise on common application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, injection, broken access control, SSRF, insecure deserialization, etc.)
  • Advise customers on how to securely implement and use SaaS platforms day-to-day — configuration hardening, access/identity management (SSO, MFA, OAuth), integration and API security, data protection, and ongoing operational security hygiene across the SaaS lifecycle
  • Translate AppSec findings into prioritized, risk-based remediation roadmaps for client stakeholders
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of security engagements — scoping, staffing, timeline, and risk ownership
  • Partner with account teams and sales leadership on pre-sales — discovery, solution scoping, SOW development, and executive presentations
  • Act as trusted advisor to C-suite and senior security stakeholders (CISO, CTO, VP of IT Security), translating technical risk into business terms
  • Oversee delivery teams to ensure consistent methodology and quality across engagements
  • Develop reusable delivery accelerators, methodologies, and playbooks grounded in AppSec best practice
  • Mentor practice staff on both security substance and client-facing engagement skills

What We're Looking For

  • 7–12+ years of AppSec experience (secure SDLC, vulnerability management, threat modeling, pen testing) — core, hands-on requirement
  • Deep, working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and common application-layer vulnerability classes, and how to assess/mitigate them in practice
  • Practical understanding of how to secure a SaaS platform through implementation and ongoing use — configuration hardening, IAM, API/integration security, and the shared-responsibility model, not just theoretical SaaS architecture
  • Strong executive communication and presence; comfortable with CISO/CTO-level conversations
  • Security certifications strongly preferred (CISSP, OSCP, or equivalent AppSec certs)

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with the Salesforce Platform (org architecture, sharing model, Shield, Data Cloud, Agentforce), including Salesforce-specific certifications
  • Prior consulting/professional-services engagement management experience (scoping, client delivery ownership, SOW development)
  • Experience with zero-trust architectures or CSPM in SaaS environments
  • Big 4 or equivalent professional services tenure

What You'll Actually Be Doing


  • 最重点アカウントへの深い参画と中長期IT戦略の推進
    • 中長期アカウント戦略の立案: 営業チームやアカウント担当SEと密に連携し、お客様の2〜3年先を見据えたIT変革ロードマップおよびアカウントプランを共同で策定・推進します。
    • 経営層・ITリーダーとの関係構築: お客様のCIO、CTO、IT部門責任者等のキーマンと対話し、定期的なディスカッションや戦略レビューを通じて中長期的な信頼関係を築きます。

    • ソリューションアセットの共有: 高難度案件で確立したアーキテクチャパターンや提案フレームワークを標準化し、ソリューションエンジニアリング組織全体へ展開します。

当ポジションの魅力・キャリアパス

日本を代表する大手企業の変革に寄与: 個別システムの導入にとどまらず、業界をリードするエンタープライズ企業の経営層とともに未来のIT姿を描く、社会的インパクトの大きい役割です。

ソリューションエンジニアとしての専門性とキャリアの拡大: 高度なアーキテクチャ設計力、Executive交渉力、広域なソリューション展開力を磨き、ソリューションエンジニアとして市場価値の高いキャリアを形成できます。

The Strategic Solution Engineer (Strategic SE) is an expert who designs strategic solution architectures and leads technical proposals for the most important, large-scale enterprise customers and the most complex deals, especially in industries such as B2C retail, consumer goods, and life sciences. You will work alongside Account Solution Engineers (Account SEs), who drive individual deals, as a specialist who supports architectural vision from a broader IT landscape and long-term technology perspective. You will bring integrated coverage across all products (All Products), not limited to any single product framework.


Building on your experience earning customer trust and driving business, you can expand your impact beyond individual proposals to industry-wide technology vision, partner collaboration, sharing technical knowledge with the team, and Executive Alignment with C-level leaders (CxO).

descriptionHtml:

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Role
The Life Sciences Engagement Delivery Senior Manager is a senior, delivery-focused individual contributor within Salesforce Professional Services, focused on our Life Sciences customers. As an IC, you hold no direct reports, yet you lead cross-functional project teams across complex Life Sciences Cloud engagements. These are multi-workstream implementations for pharma, biotech and medtech customers, where delivery quality is visible to senior business and IT stakeholders.

You own end-to-end delivery for your engagements. This covers scope, plan, budget, risk and quality, from kickoff to go-live and handover. You lead the Salesforce project team, run steering committees and manage the customer relationship up to director and VP level. You partner with Program Executives and Professional Services leadership on the most strategic accounts. The ideal candidate combines Life Sciences domain credibility (pharma, biotech, medtech or related sectors) with IT or management consulting delivery experience. You use that credibility to advise customers, partners and internal teams.

Engagement Delivery Senior Managers help deliver AI and Agentforce transformations. These speed up drug commercialisation, simplify field and HCP engagement, and modernise commercial and medical operations through intelligent agents. You are measured on delivery outcomes, risk management and customer confidence.

Your Impact
AI and agentic delivery are part of how you work: You use AI tooling and agentic workflows to reduce manual effort, speed up insight and improve how your teams deliver. You show the productivity gains our Life Sciences customers expect from Salesforce.
Engagement success is well defined and honored: You set the delivery approach, governance and plan, and align customer stakeholders on objectives, outcomes and KPIs.

Customer outcomes have clear ownership: You are the delivery contact for your engagements. You communicate on expectations, performance, governance and escalations with the customer and within Salesforce, up to director and VP level. You earn trust through accurate forecasting, honest risk communication and follow-through.

The delivery team performs better because you lead it: You lead, coach and uplift architects, consultants and project managers without positional authority. You contribute to the processes, assets and methodologies that raise delivery standards across Life Sciences.

The full engagement is yours to deliver: You oversee delivery from scoping to go-live and are accountable for meeting contractual commitments. You own engagement financials: forecast, utilisation, change control and bid-versus-delivered margin.

Value delivered turns into adoption and consumption: You drive the changes needed to meet customer objectives, especially around AI and agentic capabilities. You use your Life Sciences and product expertise to link solution design, governance and stakeholder decisions to measurable business impact.

Risk is identified and managed early: You identify, mitigate and escalate risk early, and you bring a recommended path, not just a problem statement. You manage regulated-industry risk, including GxP and validation, data privacy and promotional compliance.

Customer relationships create new opportunities: You build relationships that help Salesforce expand its work with customers. You work with Sales, Success, Technology, Product and Support to drive adoption and keep One Salesforce alignment. You also partner with Resource Management on staffing and Resource Requests, and with Sales on scoping, SOW shaping and Services Work Exception governance.

Minimum Requirements
- Demonstrated use of AI productivity tools, automation or agentic workflows in professional services or program delivery, with measurable impact on efficiency or customer outcomes
- 8+ years of professional services or consulting delivery experience, with direct accountability for execution across scope, financials, risk and customer outcomes
- 3+ years leading large, complex, multi-workstream programs or a portfolio of engagements ($3M+ scope) with measurable outcomes
- 3+ years of direct Life Sciences industry experience (pharma, biotech, medtech or related sectors), enough to engage credibly with commercial, medical, regulatory and IT stakeholders
- Experience leading cross-functional delivery teams across geographies and workstreams, including third-party system integrators, without positional authority
- Experience managing engagement financials: forecasting, revenue control, utilisation and delivered-versus-bid margin
- Working knowledge of system implementation and operational readiness in regulated Life Sciences environments (for example GxP/CSV, data privacy and promotional compliance)
- Proven ability to run steering committees and customer relationships, including difficult data-driven conversations on budget, resources, timelines and outcomes
- Strong executive presence and communication skills, verbal and written, tailored to technical, commercial and regulatory audiences
- Ability to operate as a billable IC where the engagement requires it

Preferred Qualifications
- Hands-on delivery of Agentforce or equivalent AI platform implementations, with the ability to advise Life Sciences customers on agentic transformation
- Knowledge of Life Sciences commercial operations: field and HCP engagement, omnichannel, territory management, sampling, MSL workflows, compliance controls and data-driven customer insights
- Experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, or with Veeva CRM, IQVIA OCE or similar CRM platforms for pharma and biotech, including migrations
PMP, PgMP or SAFe certification, or equivalent program management discipline
- Salesforce certifications (Admin, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud), available through the global education reimbursement program
- Experience in outcomes-based or fixed-fee delivery models where margin is set at proposal and protected through execution
- Ability to negotiate and resolve conflict in delivery, including change orders, scope disputes and steering committee decisions
- Fluency in English + language, e.g. German, Italian or French to support Swiss customers

Additional Information
- Travel approximately 25%, depending on customer need
- Bachelor’s degree required
- Location: Zurich or Lausanne
- Reports to: Services Delivery Leader

In this capacity, the consultant leads critical work streams within enterprise engagements by architecting solutions, guiding technical implementation teams, presenting and defending technical designs before client governing bodies, evaluating complex solution trade-offs, proactively mitigating architectural risk, and seeing issues through to complete resolution.
Building upon this organizational mission, the following section outlines the specific technical responsibilities, domain implementations, and high-impact work streams that define daily execution in this role.

  • Strategic Impact & Core Responsibilities
    The Senior Technical Consultant accelerates time-to-value, mitigates architecture-level risk, and drives sustained enterprise value across high-stakes customer engagements. By combining hands-on technical design with strategic risk management, the role ensures that automotive clients successfully translate complex platform capabilities into resilient, scalable operational outcomes.



Technical Architecture & Work Stream Leadership

  • Lead the end-to-end technical design and delivery of dedicated work streams within the automotive domain, maximizing the capabilities of Salesforce Automotive Cloud and adjacent platform components.
  • Author and govern application and technical design documents (ADD/TDD) that strictly adhere to Salesforce architecture best practices while seamlessly aligning with the client's broader enterprise ecosystem—including legacy Dealer Management Systems (DMS), vehicle telemetry data pipelines, and connected vehicle cloud infrastructure, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases, with AI-generated insights validated through human judgment.
  • Establish and enforce robust technical standards across the full Salesforce stack, guiding project teams on optimal integration patterns (REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures), environment management frameworks, deployment pipelines, and automated testing strategies, including the effective use of AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to maintain delivery speed and code health.



Core Automotive Domain Implementation
Architect and deploy tailored, enterprise-grade capabilities across primary functional automotive work streams:

  • Vehicle Lifecycle Management: Implement end-to-end tracking of vehicle assets from manufacturing assembly through inventory pipeline, retail sale, warranty period, and secondary market disposition—integrating telematics data to create a living, single source of truth for every VIN.
  • Dealer Network Operations: Streamline OEM-to-dealer interactions by unifying lead distribution, co-op sales programs, inventory sharing, and warranty claim processing, ensuring consistent brand standards and transparent operational visibility across distributed retail networks.

We are building a small team of hands-on technology builders who can turn that opportunity into working software and compelling business stories. You will connect products, models, agents, and data into demonstrable solutions—and help customers and executives understand their value.

This is a senior individual-contributor role combining software engineering, applied AI, solution architecture, and storytelling. You will move comfortably from a customer problem to code, from an API integration to a live demonstration, and from technical detail to an executive conversation.

Your mission

Build and demonstrate how capabilities across the Salesforce AI Labs portfolio can work together to deliver measurable customer outcomes faster.

You will show what customers can achieve with current capabilities, explore what becomes possible through new combinations, and make the path between the two clear.

What you will do

  • Build connected solutions. Create working prototypes, API integrations, and agent workflows spanning multiple products and enterprise systems.
  • Start with the business problem. Work with customers, portfolio leaders, and go-to-market teams to identify use cases where combining capabilities produces meaningful additional value.
  • Create compelling demonstrations. Develop reliable, repeatable experiences that make complex technology understandable and show a clear connection between customer needs, system actions, and business results.
  • Tell the story at every level. Present to executives, customers, developers, and sales teams, adapting the depth while preserving technical credibility.
  • Explore the next opportunity. Use rapid experimentation to test new agentic experiences and architectures. Clearly distinguish available capabilities, working prototypes, and future concepts.
  • Make the work reusable. Package reference architectures, integration components, demo environments, and playbooks that other teams can adopt.
  • Measure value and speed. Establish baselines and evaluate outcomes such as implementation time, process cycle time, cost to serve, service resolution, and customer experience.
  • Connect learning to product decisions. Surface integration gaps, customer demand, and technical constraints to product and engineering leaders, with evidence from what you build.



What you bring

  • A track record of personally building customer-facing software, integrations, or technical prototypes that solve real business problems.
  • Strong coding skills in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or comparable languages, with the ability to build and debug across services and a usable demonstration interface.
  • Fluency in modern API architectures, including authentication, webhooks, event-driven integration, data contracts, and reliable execution across systems.
  • Practical experience building with models and tools from providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic, alongside relevant open-source agent frameworks and harnesses.
  • Understanding of tool calling, retrieval, orchestration, context management, evaluations, observability, and human approval within agent workflows.
  • Sound judgment about model limitations, reliability, latency, cost, data access, and the requirements for moving from prototype to customer deployment.
  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills, including the ability to deliver a live demonstration and explain its business significance.
  • The initiative to work through ambiguity, learn unfamiliar products quickly, and ship useful iterations with a small team.
  • The ability to turn a broad ambition into a testable use case with a credible path to customer value.



Experience that would be especially useful

  • Forward-deployed engineering, applied AI engineering, solutions engineering, or customer-facing solution architecture.
  • Building demonstrations or proofs of value involving multiple enterprise products.
  • Process intelligence, workflow automation, customer research, customer service, or digital experience platforms.
  • Creating reusable technical assets that support several customers or go-to-market teams.
  • Startup or founding-engineer experience with direct customer engagement.



What success could look like in the first 90 days

These are proposed initial outcomes, to be calibrated to product access and team capacity:

  • First 30 days: Understand the portfolio, map integration opportunities, and select two high-value customer scenarios with business sponsors and measurable outcomes.
  • By 60 days: Deliver one working demonstration across multiple products, with a clear story, documented dependencies, and an initial evaluation of reliability and value.

The Integrated Campaigns Creative team translates Salesforce’s products, technology, and customer moments into compelling cross-channel creative experiences and stories.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Designer on the Integrated Campaigns Creative team, you will support creative design and production for Salesforce's Missionforce marketing initiatives.


Missionforce is Salesforce's AI-powered platform for government, public sector, defense, and national security organizations. By bringing together trusted AI, data, and cloud technology, Missionforce helps agencies modernize operations, improve service delivery, and drive better outcomes for the communities and missions they serve.

What Experience You Have:

  • BA or BFA in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design, production design, or digital design within an in-house creative team, marketing organization, or advertising agency.
  • Experience with motion design, storyboarding, and animation is a plus, with the ability to bring creative concepts to life through motion. Proficiency in Adobe After Effects is a plus.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating hands-on design execution, production expertise, and the ability to adapt creative concepts across multiple channels and formats.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, with experience using Figma. Familiarity with Canva is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of digital and print production processes, including file preparation, resizing, layout adaptation, and production specifications.
  • Strong visual design fundamentals, including typography, composition, color, layout, and brand consistency.
  • Experience supporting integrated marketing campaigns, demand generation, social, digital advertising, and event-related creative.
  • Ability to work from established creative direction while applying independent judgment to solve design and production challenges.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, meeting deadlines, and incorporating feedback efficiently.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with proficiency in English.
  • Familiarity with generative AI and emerging creative tools to support design and production workflows is a plus.

  • You love the craft of design and take pride in delivering polished, pixel-perfect creative.
  • You enjoy taking strong creative concepts and bringing them to life across a variety of channels and formats.

About the Role

Salesforce Professional Services is evolving how we deliver world-class value to our customers. Our overall business strategy is anchored in rigorous market research, data-driven analysis, and high-impact executive communication.

We are seeking an analytical, insight-driven Sr Manager/Director of Strategy. In this role, you will lead deep-dive research, conduct quantitative and qualitative market analysis, and synthesize complex findings into compelling, executive-ready presentations that shape our global Professional Services strategy.

You will serve as a core strategic advisor, transforming raw market and operational data into clear strategic options and C-suite deliverables, partnering directly with senior leadership to guide critical investment and operational decisions across our business strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Strategic Research & Market Intelligence: Conduct comprehensive competitive analysis, industry benchmarking, and market research to identify growth opportunities and strategic risks across the Professional Services landscape.
  • Perform Advanced Quantitative Analysis: Partner with analytics teams to model business scenarios, evaluate financial metrics, and derive actionable insights from complex datasets to support core strategic initiatives.
  • Craft C-Suite Executive Presentations: Synthesize complex analytical findings, strategic choices, and trade-offs into polished, executive-level slide decks and narratives for senior leadership and executive offsites.
  • Evaluate AI Strategy & Innovation: Utilize advanced AI analytical tools to accelerate research frameworks, model AI delivery impacts, and evaluate the strategic positioning of AI-augmented professional services.
  • Align Cross-Functional Stakeholders: Facilitate strategic reviews with leaders across Sales, Operations, Pricing, and Regional Units (AMERS, EMEA, APAC) to build consensus around research-backed strategy recommendations.
  • Direct Strategic Analysts & Modeling: Guide and mentor a dedicated team of Strategic Analysts in running robust data models, tracking strategic metrics, and maintaining high standards for strategic storytelling assets.

Delivering everything from financial forecasting and customer health to adoption insights and curated data, Data Solutions serves as the unbiased partner to every data trailblazer across Salesforce.

As part of this organization, Product & Success Analytics operates as the strategic product analytics engine, partnering directly with CSG leadership to drive high-stakes decision-making through rigorous metrics and insights. Embedded directly within Success Analytics, this role serves as a strategic partner to product, engineering, and data leaders - co-building the foundational data architectures, key performance metrics, and AI-driven capabilities needed to propel product adoption.

The Senior Decision Scientist will serve as a lead technical authority on the team, leveraging advanced data science, statistical modeling, and quantitative analytics to power mission-critical operational systems. In this role, you will own the modeling, data architecture, and statistical rigor behind product Adoption telemetry - systems that directly govern performance metrics and compensation target-setting across the organization for Sales & CSG.

Working in tight partnership with Product Leadership, senior executive stakeholders, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will apply rigorous analytics to architect next-generation compensation and adoption metrics, drive automated data frameworks to scale M&A signal ingestion across incoming acquisitions, and enforce top-tier data trust and SLA reliability across underlying analytics pipelines.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Requirements & Data Discovery: Partner directly with business stakeholders to translate complex compensation strategies and operational goals into precise quantitative requirements and data definitions.
  • Impact Analysis & Historical Modeling: Perform deep-dive data exploration, scenario modeling, and historical backfills on underlying usage and telemetry tables to quantify the impact of proposed metric changes across Sales & CSG prior to rollout.
  • End-to-End Metric Build & Validation: Design, build, and statistically validate scoring logic and underlying data pipelines, ensuring calculations are robust, audit-ready, and resilient against edge cases.
  • M&A Signal Integration & Scalable Data Frameworks: Serve as the lead Decision Scientist for designing and executing M&A data integration frameworks, transitioning signal ingestion from a manual "pull" model to an automated "push" model to drop onboarding cycle times from weeks to days.
  • Strategic Advisory & Executive Alignment: Apply rigorous quantitative methods—including experimentation, causal inference, and tradeoff analysis—to inform product initiatives, advise senior leadership, and translate complex insights into clear business strategies.
  • Agentic Systems & AI Lifecycle: Architect, evaluate, and govern autonomous AI agents to automate complex data science tasks, incorporating AI solutions into daily analytical workflows to accelerate time-to-insight.
  • Data Integrity, Reliability & SLA Optimization: Own analytical health, automated anomaly detection, and root-cause data investigations for product adoption telemetry and underlying tables, dramatically reducing SLAs for bug resolution during critical compensation cycles.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Elevate the team's technical bar by establishing best practices for statistical rigor and feature engineering while mentoring peers across Success Analytics and Data Solutions.



You're Our Person If...

  • Proven Experience: 8+ years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Decision Science, Advanced Analytics, or Quantitative Product Analysis in enterprise SaaS environments, with a proven track record of deploying models that move business needles.
  • Agentic AI & Systems Engineering: Demonstrated experience architecting agentic workflows, orchestrating LLMs, or building automated, self-correcting data science systems. You don't just use AI; you build systems that leverage it.
  • Technical Mastery: High proficiency in statistical programming languages (Python or R) and modern data science stacks, along with exceptional SQL skills for complex feature engineering and database performance tuning.
  • Quantitative Foundation: Master's degree or MBA in a highly quantitative discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or Applied Mathematics).
  • Domain & Business Acumen: Proven track record applying data science to business metrics, health scoring algorithms, or incentive compensation structures across Sales and Customer Success organizations.
  • Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to build trust with C-suite executives, align technical teams, and tell a compelling story with data.
  • Entrepreneurial Execution: A "get-it-done" mindset with a strong bias for action, comfortable operating with high autonomy in a global, matrixed environment.

This is a quota-carrying role where you will act as the "CEO" of your territory, owning the strategy, engagement model, and execution plan across your assigned accounts. You will lead complex sales cycles in partnership with cross-functional teams and help government organisations address challenges related to data silos, data quality, fragmented reporting, and the need for trusted, unified data to drive better decisions and outcomes.

  • Forecasting and CRM Discipline: Maintain accurate account plans, opportunity updates, pipeline visibility, and forecast hygiene in Salesforce CRM.


You're Our Person If...

The Ajna team builds and operates Salesforce’s internal Kafka-as-a-Service platform — the distributed messaging backbone that powers real-time data pipelines, alerting, analytics, and event streaming across every major Salesforce product and cloud environment.
The platform serves a broad ecosystem of internal engineering teams across commercial, GovCloud, and sovereign cloud environments globally. This team pursues principled, high-impact architectural evolution with direct consequences at production scale.
The team operates with distributed coverage across Pacific and India Standard Time zones, maintains continuous on-call coverage, and is actively invested in intelligent automation — including AI-powered tooling built in-house to support triage and auto-remediation at scale.

What We Are Looking For
* Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including deep understanding of Kafka internals (leader election, ISR management, consumer groups, log compaction, partition rebalancing) and the ability to reason about consistency and availability trade-offs in multi-tenant environments
* Kubernetes engineering proficiency, including StatefulSets, Autoscaling, PersistentVolumeClaims, and Helm; demonstrated experience debugging production Kubernetes workloads
* Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform for cloud resources (IAM, object storage, messaging, block storage)
* Java engineering depth; the team’s core services are Java-based and require clean, performant, operationally sound implementation
* Operational ownership mindset: participation in on-call rotation, production incident investigation, and systematic root cause analysis
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to produce architectural designs that influence decisions across team and organizational boundaries

Your Impact:

  • Deliver cloud infrastructure automation tools, frameworks, workflows, and validation platforms on our public cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or Alibaba
  • Designing, developing, debugging, and operating resilient distributed systems that run across thousands of compute nodes in multiple data centers
  • Using and contributing to open source technology (Spinnaker, Zookeeper, etc.)
  • Developing Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform
  • Writing microservices on containerization frameworks such as Kubernetes, Docker, Mesos
  • Resolving complex technical issues and drive innovations that improve system availability, resilience, and performance
  • Eat, sleep, and breathe services. You have experience balancing live-site management, feature delivery, and retirement of technical debt
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation to address complex problems in real-time and keep services operational and highly available

Required Skills:

  • A related technical degree required
  • 4+ years backend software development experience
  • Deep knowledge of programming in Java, Golang, Python, or Ruby
  • Experience using and contributing to open source technology: Kafka, Spinnaker, Zookeeper
  • Experience owning and operating multiple instances of a critical service
  • Experience with Agile development methodology and Test Driven Development

Do you specialize in systems performance? Do you love working with data and automation? Want to be part of something big? Help build the distributed database technology that powers the growth of the Salesforce Platform worldwide.


SalesforceDB is the transactional database behind Salesforce CRM. It runs more than 1.1 trillion transactions per month on thousands of database instances.


The Salesforce Database team is fast-paced and collaborative. We work across all areas of our distributed transactional database technology stack. We are seeking performance engineers to deliver the tools, analysis, and optimizations that take SalesforceDB to new levels of performance and scalability with every release.


Our performance engineers partner closely with database and storage system developers, application performance engineers, infrastructure engineers, and our analytics team. • A related technical degree, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of performance engineering on systems software, ideally databases, storage, or distributed systems.

• Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and memory management.

• Strong coding skills in Java or C/C++.

• Practical experience with load, benchmark, and regression testing, ideally for multi-tenant workloads at scale.

• A track record of root cause analysis for performance and scalability problems in complex distributed systems.

• Strong SQL and performance data analysis skills (CPU, latency, throughput, per-tenant resource use).

• Experience with telemetry, dashboards, and monitoring against performance targets.

• Fluency with Linux, OS internals, and shell/Python scripting.

• Clear communication and collaboration skills across database, storage, infrastructure, application performance, and analytics teams.

• Integrity and a growth mindset: you report what the data shows, seek feedback, and keep learning.

• MS or PhD in databases or distributed systems.

• Deep knowledge of database internals: optimizer, query execution, storage, transactions, and concurrency control.

Emerging Technology finds high leverage opportunities within DET and supports 0 to 1 initiatives across the enterprise. The DET platform is the connective tissue underneath all of it, and right now it is missing the one thing that makes engineering effort compound: product vision and support.


We are hiring a Senior Director, Platform Product Management to build and lead a small, nimble product team for our platform. The vision is simple: a lean group that drives requirements, sets priorities, and evangelizes new platform capabilities across the org. Our Engineering, Development & Delivery (EDD) partners own all the engineering that brings those capabilities to life. Right now those capabilities exist as powerful but scattered building blocks. Your job is to shape them into a comprehensive platform. You will run continuous discovery with the teams who use the platform, translate their needs into a single sequenced roadmap, and work shoulder to shoulder with EDD engineers to ship.

This is a builder role. You need to be technical enough to earn trust with senior engineers (challenge scope, reason about architecture, cut through the noise) and strategic enough to rally the org around a clear plan without owning the engineers who execute it. Adoption is core to the job: advertising a service and waiting for uptake is not a strategy. You will own the “what’s in it for me” narrative and get partner teams to commit to real adoption.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Building the platform product function: Defining how the platform decides what to build, for whom, and in what order. Standing up the intake funnel and required functions to generate clarity and awareness of what is being delivered and when
  • Contributing to one platform roadmap: Consolidating initiatives spread across a dozen owners into a single, ruthlessly sequenced roadmap. You’ll contribute to making hard prioritization calls and defending them
  • Going deep with engineering: Sitting with senior engineers across hosting/compute, CI/CD and developer tooling, the AI control plane, data and telemetry, and real-time ML. Understanding the architecture well enough to challenge scope, unblock tradeoffs, and earn technical trust
  • Killing duplication: Maintaining the single view of who is building what. Merging overlapping efforts early
  • Driving adoption, not just availability: Owning the “what’s in it for me” narrative and pushing partner teams to commit to real adoption milestones
  • Running discovery: Interviewing platform use case owners continuously to keep the roadmap grounded in real demand, not assumptions
  • Communicating with clarity: Translating deep technical work into crisp narratives for executives and giving engineering a clear, honest read on priorities and progress
  • Mentoring PMs: Growing the platform product team as it scales; setting the bar for technical fluency and product craft

You're Our Person If...

  • You have 10+ years in product management, 4+ leading platform, infrastructure, or developer products. You have owned technical products where engineers are your primary customers
  • Experience in developer productivity or tooling: you’ve previously worked in environments where your primary mission was developer enablement
  • Hands-on technical depth across several of: cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), hosting and compute (containers and serverless), CI/CD and developer workflow tooling, data and telemetry pipelines / event buses, observability, real-time ML, and the emerging AI stack (MCP servers, MCP registries, agent tooling, knowledge graphs)
  • Intake and roadmap muscle: Proven track record building prioritization frameworks and driving one roadmap across many stakeholders and competing agendas
  • Adoption and go-to-market chops for internal or developer platforms: you have gotten teams to actually commit and migrate, not just express interest
  • Executive communication: You can hold a room with VPs and SVPs and make complex technical tradeoffs legible
  • Comfort with ambiguity and influence without authority: Engineering owners stay in their reporting lines; you drive through trust, clarity, and results

descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The Experience

Salesforce is hiring a Senior Manager of Software Engineering to lead DNS Engineering, the team that owns the DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) services infrastructure behind every Salesforce product. You'll lead a team of engineers responsible for authoritative and recursive DNS across Salesforce data centers and Hyperforce public cloud, self-service DNS and IPAM APIs, and DNS security, including DNSSEC and DDoS resilience. You'll set the multi-year strategy, own availability for this Tier-0 service, and lead the move to cloud-native, multi-provider DNS with automation and AI-assisted operations. The role suits a leader with 12+ years in software engineering, 5+ years leading teams, and deep experience with DNS and large-scale distributed systems.

Every customer request to Salesforce starts with a DNS lookup. The DNS Engineering team owns this layer for Salesforce: the authoritative and service-discovery DNS that sits in front of every Salesforce product, in our first-party data centers and across Hyperforce on the public cloud. We also own the DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) platform and the self-service APIs that engineers and automated pipelines use to manage records, zones, and IP space every day.

The team's work spans large, mission-critical systems:

  • Authoritative and recursive DNS on BIND and dnsdist, running on fleets across many data centers and serving very high query volumes with strict latency and availability targets (3 & 4 nines).
  • Public cloud DNS on AWS Route 53 and GCP Cloud DNS, plus Kubernetes-native DNS automation (external-dns) for Hyperforce workloads
  • DDI platform and APIs: services that wrap commercial DDI platforms (such as Infoblox) so record and IPAM changes are safe, validated, and auditable
  • Security and resilience: DNSSEC, DDoS protection, hardening against dangling records and subdomain takeover, and multi-provider failover
  • Infrastructure as Code and automation: Puppet, Terraform, Spinnaker, and CI/CD pipelines with staggered, datacenter-by-datacenter rollouts, plus observability through Splunk, Grafana, and Argus
  • Third-Party DNS vendor relations: Our DNS infrastructure uses third-party DNS vendors to manage DNS zones on misc commercial enterprise DNS platforms.



As Senior Manager of Software Engineering for DNS Engineering, you'll lead the organization that keeps this layer fast, secure, and always available. You'll set its technical direction toward a cloud-native, highly automated, AI-assisted future. You'll lead tech leads, POs and senior engineers. You'll be accountable for availability and live-site health. And you'll partner with the platform, networking, security, and product teams that depend on DNS.

  • Experience owning Tier-0 or Tier-1 services in a 24x7x365, multi-datacenter environment, including on-call, incident management, and SLO-driven operations
