You should have the ability to (if needed) dive deep into code and configuration — prototyping complex flows (e.g., registration and personalization workflows, AgentGraph-driven attendee assistance) and validating architectural decisions through hands-on reference implementations. You will serve as the architectural bridge between Product, Engineering, and event marketing, influencing the roadmap of the Salesforce products we consume by providing high-fidelity feedback based on our internal implementations at event scale.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Horizontal Architectural Strategy for Events Technology. Define and drive the software architecture vision across the events technology portfolio. You will be responsible for ensuring architectural integrity and integration across domains including, but not limited to:
  • Event Platforms: Registration, attendee management, agenda/session builders, badge & check-in, capacity and waitlist management for large-scale events (Dreamforce, TrailblazerDX, World Tours).
  • AI & Agents: Agentforce (Atlas/AgentGraph), conversational agents for attendee support, and digital labor applied to event operations.
  • Data & Identity: Data Cloud (Ingestion/Activation), Identity Resolution, Unified Attendee Profiles, and OAuth2/TBID for event authentication.
  • Marketing & Orchestration: Event Journey Orchestration, Messaging Services (email/SMS/push for event communications), and Transactional Services.
  • Core Platform: Web Application Development for event sites, Headless CMS for event content, Knowledge Graphs, Federated Graphs (GraphQL), and Streaming/ML integrations for real-time event analytics.
  • Strategic Prototyping & Hands-on Leadership. You will validate high-stakes architectural decisions through hands-on prototyping and code-level deep dives. You are expected to build “walking skeleton” implementations of new technologies (e.g., deterministic Agentforce workflows for attendee check-in or session recommendations) to educate leadership on technical choices and set clear patterns for engineering teams to follow, without becoming a bottleneck for critical path delivery — especially given the hard, immovable deadlines of live events.
  • Engineering Multiplier. Shift from individual “hero” delivery to enabling the broader engineering organization. You will empower event engineering teams by establishing architectural standards, conducting design reviews, and resolving cross-team technical blockers ahead of high-traffic event moments (registration launches, keynotes, on-site check-in surges). You will operate as a peer and consensus-builder to architects in adjacent verticals, driving alignment on standards without requiring direct managerial authority.
  • Cross-Pillar & Product Collaboration
  • Product Strategy: Partner with Product Leads across Events, Marketing, and DMT to align technical capabilities with 3-4 quarter event and roadmap calendars.
  • DET Alignment: Collaborate with architects in the broader Digital Enterprise Technology across pillars to drive DET-wide initiatives and common architecture patterns, ensuring event technology stays aligned with enterprise-wide standards.
  • Product Feedback Loop (Customer Zero). Maintain deep technical engagement with T&P teams (specifically Agentforce, Sales Cloud, Data Cloud, and Marketing Cloud). You will be the architecture voice of Events Technology, running the highest-scale, highest-visibility events on Salesforce’s own products, and providing feedback on APIs, limits, and capabilities to improve the products before they reach external customers.


You're Our Person If...

  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 5+ years in an architectural role, designing distributed systems at enterprise scale.
  • Broad Domain Expertise: Demonstrated experience architecting solutions that span multiple technical domains relevant to event technology. Must have specific exposure to or understanding of: Data Cloud, Agentforce/AI Agents, Marketing Journey Orchestration, Identity, Content Management, and event/registration platforms.
  • Event Technology Experience: Direct experience with event registration, attendee management, agenda/session tooling, or ticketing platforms — ideally at large scale (thousands to tens of thousands of concurrent attendees) and under fixed, non-negotiable event-date deadlines.
  • Hands-on Proficiency: Ability to read and write code/config when necessary to validate designs. Comfortable spinning up a POC to prove a point or debugging a complex integration issue to unblock a team, particularly under the time pressure of an upcoming event launch.
  • Strategic Influence: Proven ability to influence Product Leads and Engineering Leadership (Directors/VPs). Ability to articulate the trade-offs between “building right” (long-term health) and “building fast” (market and event-date demands).
  • Salesforce Ecosystem: Expert-level understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, specifically regarding Data Cloud ingestion patterns and Agentforce architectures.
  • Experience in building scalable applications based on micro-service architecture in public cloud infrastructure, able to withstand event-day traffic spikes: AWS components like API Gateway, Lambdas, SNS, SQS, ElastiCache, AppSync etc.
  • Experience in building Conversational agents, Co-Pilots, and Autonomous agents for attendee-facing use cases, familiarity with Large language models.
  • Experience in building integrations and pipelines to AWS SageMaker ML platform.
  • Experience with Data streams at high scale (Apache Kafka, Kinesis), especially for real-time event and check-in data.
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (DynamoDB) and Graph databases (Neo4j, Neptune).
  • Experience in working in teams with Agile software delivery and DevOps practices.
  • Well-versed with CI/CD principles, and experience in solving issues in a distributed services ecosystem, including load and scale testing ahead of a major event.
  • Experience mentoring lead engineers.
  • Ability to evaluate a problem space and make a technology decision based on what’s best for the event attendee and customer.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with both business (event marketing) and technical customers.
  • AI Proficiency & Fluency: Hands-on fluency with modern AI tooling — using LLMs/copilots for code generation, debugging, and design exploration as part of your own daily workflow — plus working knowledge of prompt engineering and agent orchestration patterns, going beyond simple assistance to designing and evaluating AI-driven workflows and systems.


Even Better If...

  • Experience transitioning legacy “service-provider” models into scalable “product-led” engineering organizations.
  • Experience with Federated GraphQL architectures.
  • Direct background in Event Technology, Digital Marketing, or AdTech domains — particularly large-scale conference or field-event platforms.
  • Experience with on-site event technology: badge printing/scanning, kiosk check-in, mobile event apps, and real-time capacity/session-fill monitoring.

The Experience
Salesforce AI Research is a global leader in Enterprise AI, driving innovations that advance the state of AI while powering enterprise products at worldwide scale.

Our research has helped shape multiple generations of modern AI: we helped pioneer prompt engineering through DecaNLP; introduced BLIP, a foundational breakthrough in multimodal AI; trained state-of-the-art large language models including CodeGen; and pioneered foundation models for time series with Moirai. Today, we continue to advance the frontier of enterprise AI through innovations in AI simulation environments like eVerse, our simulation and agent-training environment; the Atlas Reasoning Engine, which powers Agentforce reasoning capabilities; and other AI systems that are redefining how enterprises reason, plan, and act.

What makes our team unique is our ability to take ideas from research to real-world impact at scale. We work closely with product teams and enterprise customers to translate cutting-edge research into production AI capabilities used by millions of users. Our innovations continue to shape the future of Salesforce products and the broader enterprise AI ecosystem. We also continue to publish at the world's top AI conferences, open source influential research, and collaborate with leading academic institutions. Learn more at Salesforce AI Research.

We are looking for entrepreneurial Research Scientists who want to build, ship, and scale the next generation of Enterprise AI. This is not a traditional research role — you work like a founder within Salesforce, identifying high-impact research directions, prototyping cutting-edge AI capabilities, validating ideas directly with customers, and turning the strongest concepts into production-ready solutions. You have the freedom to propose and incubate new research ideas, access Salesforce's global customer and product ecosystem, and quickly validate new innovations with external and internal customers and stakeholders. We are looking for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, move with urgency, and care as much about customer adoption as technical innovation. If you want the pace and ownership of a startup, combined with the reach and resources of Salesforce, this role offers a unique opportunity to build Enterprise AI with global impact.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Identify research directions with the potential to transform Enterprise AI.
  • Turn promising ideas into zero-to-one AI product prototypes.
  • Work directly with customers to validate needs, test solutions, and refine product direction.
  • Build robust models, agents, and AI systems for real-world enterprise use.
  • Partner with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to bring solutions to market.


You're Our Person If...

  • You have a strong publication record at top AI venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CVPR, ICCV, ACL, EMNLP) and/or a proven track record of shipping AI research into real-world products.
  • You have experience with Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or DeepSpeed.
  • You are motivated by real-world impact — you care about seeing your research leave the lab and reach users at scale.
  • You bring demonstrated expertise in one or more core focus areas:
    • Agentic AI and Reasoning: LLM-powered agents, reinforcement learning (RL), reasoning and planning, autonomous workflows, computer use agents, deep research agents, and coding agents.
    • Multimodal and Computer Vision: Vision-language models, video understanding, and multimodal AI agents.
    • Speech Intelligence: Voice intelligence, text-to-speech/automatic speech recognition, and low-latency audio processing.
    • Core Modeling and Post-Training: Pre-training and post-training techniques including RLHF and direct preference optimization, model distillation, evaluation, and time series modeling.
  • You bring a demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and translate ideas into impactful systems.


Even Better If...

  • You have a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field — or equivalent full-time industry experience in deep learning research or product.
  • Experience building and scaling ML models for real-world business applications.
  • Experience mentoring and advising other researchers.
  • Strong programming skills (competitive programming, e.g. ACM-ICPC, or open source experience).
  • Thoughtful about responsible AI, trust, and the real-world impact of the systems you build.
  • Fantastic problem solver — ability to tackle challenges the world hasn't solved before.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills.
  • Demonstrated track record of cultivating strong working relationships and driving cross-functional collaboration.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce is hiring Senior Forward Deployed Engineers — the Technical Builders, responsible for deciding that leads who design, build, and deploy the most complex agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll lead technical delivery on your team, mentor the next wave of engineers, and set the engineering standards that define how agentic AI gets deployed at scale. Partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption), you’ll own outcomes end-to-end, from architecture decision to production. Your passion for well-crafted software that solves real problems will be supported by best-in-class AI tools and a team of talented builders around you.

The Senior Builder Experience

  • Technical Ownership: Partner with a Deployment Strategist to own customer outcomes end-to-end. You’re the senior technical authority in the room, ensuring deliverables meet the highest engineering standards, whether it was generated by an AI tool by a colleague or written by you directly.
  • AI-Supported Engineering: Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes are embedded in your daily workflow. The conventions and patterns you develop tend to propagate through the team because other Builders look to your work as reference.
  • Roadmap Influence: Your field experience routes directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps you hit and the edge cases you encounter in real life customer environments become the features they ship. Senior Forward Deployed Engineers are the most credible voice in agentic AI product evolution.
  • Continuous Innovation: You’re expected to stay at the forefront — piloting emerging AI tools, experimenting with new models and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Own end-to-end build and deployment of agentic AI solutions for Salesforce’s most strategic customers — from architecture decisions through production handoff.
  • Design and ship agentic systems on the Agentforce platform: agent logic, tool calls, multi-agent orchestration, deterministic guardrails, and the integration patterns that hold up in enterprise environments. Your reference implementations become the basis for how other Builders approach similar problems.
  • Own the data lifecycle: model design, processing pipelines, and data readiness for AI applications across Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer-specific platforms.
  • Resolve the technical blockers that other engineers can’t — data integration failures, model deployment issues, orchestration breakdowns, performance regressions. These problems are routed to you because of your track record of solving them.

  • Develop proofs-of-concept and MVPs quickly, with the judgment to know which decisions can be deferred and which need to be right the first time.
  • Codify what you learn. The patterns, reusable assets, and internal frameworks that come out of your real customer work become the playbooks the rest of the org draws from.
  • Mentor other Engineers through code reviews, pair sessions, and shared work. Most of your influence on developing engineers happens inside the same codebases you’re building in.
  • Provide technical depth on at-risk or strategically critical deployments when senior engineering judgment is needed.
  • Surface field insights directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps and edge cases you encounter in real customer environments are some of the most valuable inputs to the Agentforce roadmap.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist on your team to translate complex customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 6+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with proven end-to-end ownership of scalable production systems in enterprise AI, cloud, or SaaS environments.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • You’re an expert in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex, and conversant in the others.
  • You’ve integrated LLMs into production, used frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and applied prompt engineering and responsible AI practices in real customer contexts.
  • You have deep experience in data modeling, processing, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency across platforms like Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, or Databricks.
  • You bring deep Salesforce platform expertise: Agentforce, Apex, LWC, Flows, and Salesforce APIs.
  • You have an entrepreneurial, get-things-done mindset focused on fast, impactful delivery — and the judgment to know when “fast” is the wrong call.
  • You’ve mentored technical talent and created reusable assets — frameworks, playbooks, internal tooling.
  • You communicate clearly and credibly with engineering peers, customer architects, and executive stakeholders.
  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
  • You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, embedded with customer engineers.



Even Better If...

  • Familiarity with DevOps/CI-CD practices, observability tooling, or data governance frameworks
  • Experience architecting multi-cloud, multi-system enterprise AI solutions for Global 500 customers
  • Track record of influencing enterprise software product roadmaps through field engineering insight

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Success Managerは、ビジネス、業界、製品に関する深い知見を活かしてお客様とパートナーシップを築き、お客様がSalesforceへの投資から得るビジネス価値とリターンを加速できるよう導きます。この役割では、Success Managerは1つ以上の事業部門(LoB)、特定のクラウド、または業界を専門とし、お客様の言葉で語り、お客様の価値実現を確実にします。主要なステークホルダーレベルで連携し、強い信頼関係を築き育むことで、お客様のデジタルジャーニーの推進を支援します。Success Managerは、お客様のニーズに応じて、市場セグメント、規模、ソリューションの複雑さ、ライフサイクルが異なるお客様と直接協働します。理想的なSuccess Managerは、お客様の言葉で語ることができるクラウドの専門性と業界スキルの両方を備えています。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Customer Success Methodologyを活用し、お客様のステークホルダーと連携して、目標の理解とケイパビリティの評価を行い、ビジネス目標とテクノロジー目標の達成を加速するための提案を行う

  • 現状、タイムラインを伴う目標とする将来像、およびその基盤となるイネーブルメント計画を示した、包括的な活用推進パスを作成し、実行する

  • 適切な場合、成功を推進するために必要な追加のSalesforceサービスやアドバイザリーの専門家を提案する
  • 製品の技術的な変更、性能低下、障害、サポート終了、その他の関連する最新情報を積極的に伝える

株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。

The Experience

The DevOps Architect — Migration Hub is the strategic owner of the CI/CD, environment management and release governance framework that powers all migration wave delivery across the Hub. Sitting at the intersection of platform engineering and delivery operations, this role designs and governs the DevOps infrastructure that enables concurrent migration teams — across Marketing Cloud Next, Agentforce Revenue Management, ITSM and Tableau Next tracks — to deploy, test, validate and release Salesforce configuration, code and data changes at Hub velocity.

Unlike the hands-on DevOps Engineer (who operates day-to-day pipelines within a single track), the DevOps Architect operates at the Hub level — defining branching strategy, environment topology, pipeline standards, test automation frameworks, deployment governance and cross-wave dependency management that apply consistently to every track team.

This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck — that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window.

The DevOps Architect is also responsible for the platform development tooling contribution model — governing how Apex, LWC, Flow and integration code built by track teams is developed, reviewed, tested and promoted through Hub environments to production.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • CI/CD Pipeline Architecture — Hub Standard: Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado — defining the standard pipeline stages (develop → validate → test → UAT → staging → production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release.
  • Environment Topology Design: Design and manage the Hub environment topology — defining the number, purpose and refresh cadence of Developer, CI, SIT, UAT, Staging and Production environments across all active migration waves, balancing environment costs with delivery velocity requirements.
  • Branching Strategy & Version Control Governance: Define and enforce the Hub-wide Git branching strategy — including branch naming conventions, merge policies, pull request standards, conflict resolution protocols and release tagging — ensuring all Salesforce DX source code, metadata and configuration is correctly version-controlled.
  • Scratch Org Strategy: Design the Hub’s Salesforce DX scratch org usage model — defining scratch org definitions, feature flags, shape parameters and lifecycle policies that enable track teams to develop and test in isolated, reproducible environments at scale.
  • Deployment Governance & Release Management: Own the release management process for all migration wave deployments — defining change freeze windows, deployment sequencing, dependency maps, rollback procedures, approval gates and production deployment runbooks used across all concurrent waves.
  • Test Automation Framework: Design and implement the Hub-wide automated test suite — including Apex test class standards, code coverage requirements, UI automation (LWC Jest, Selenium), data validation scripts and post-deployment smoke tests — integrated into every CI/CD pipeline stage.
  • Static Code Analysis & Quality Gates: Implement and maintain static code analysis tooling (PMD, Salesforce Code Analyser, ESLint) as mandatory quality gates within the Hub pipeline — enforcing Apex best practices, Governor Limit awareness, LWC standards and security vulnerability detection before any code progresses to UAT.
  • Multi-Org & Multi-Track Pipeline Management: Manage the complexity of concurrent multi-org pipelines across 4–5 active migration tracks — designing dependency management, cross-track metadata conflict resolution and coordinated deployment sequencing for shared Salesforce org components.
  • Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Integrate data migration pipeline execution (ETL job scheduling, bulk load sequencing, reconciliation validation) into the Hub CI/CD framework — ensuring data migration jobs are tracked, versioned, automated and auditable alongside metadata deployments.
  • Secrets & Credential Management: Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments — including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Design the Hub’s deployment monitoring and observability framework — including pipeline run dashboards, deployment success/failure metrics, apex test trend monitoring, environment health checks and post-deployment alert routing for track teams and programme leadership.
  • DevOps Engineer Mentoring & Standards: Act as the technical lead and mentor for DevOps Engineers embedded in each migration track — setting development standards, reviewing pipeline configurations, conducting DevOps design reviews and ensuring consistent tooling adoption across all track teams.
  • Platform Development Contribution: Design and build reusable Salesforce platform components for Hub DevOps tooling — including LWC-based deployment dashboards, Apex utilities for automated org health checks, custom metadata-driven pipeline configuration frameworks and Salesforce Flow automations for release approval workflows.
  • Continuous Improvement — Hub Feedback: Capture DevOps lessons learned after every migration wave — pipeline failures, deployment blockers, environment contention, test coverage gaps
  • Tooling Evaluation & Adoption: Evaluate and recommend new DevOps tooling, Salesforce release management platforms and automation frameworks — maintaining the Hub’s DevOps toolkit at the leading edge of Salesforce delivery practice.



You're Our Person If...

  • Salesforce DX & Source-Driven Development: Expert knowledge of Salesforce DX — scratch org management, SFDX project structure, package development model (unlocked packages, managed packages), metadata API formats and CLI operations for automated deployments.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Hands-on expertise building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce deployments — using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or CircleCI combined with Gearset, Copado or custom SFDX scripting for automated validate-test-deploy workflows.
  • Gearset or Copado: Deep practical experience with at least one enterprise Salesforce release management platform — Gearset or Copado — including pipeline configuration, org comparison, deployment validation, rollback management and test execution integration.
  • Git & Branching Strategy: Expert-level Git proficiency — branching model design (GitFlow, trunk-based, environment-branching), merge policy enforcement, PR review standards, release tagging and conflict resolution for Salesforce metadata and Apex code repositories.
  • Salesforce Environment Management: Proven ability to design and manage multi-org environment topologies for large programme delivery — including sandbox refresh automation, org dependency mapping, data masking for lower environments and environment capacity planning.
  • Apex & Platform Development: Strong Apex development skills — Triggers, Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, test class authoring, Governor Limit management — required for building Hub DevOps tooling, automated health check utilities and deployment validation components.
  • Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC-based deployment dashboards, pipeline status monitors, release approval UIs and org health dashboards as internal Hub tooling deployed on the Salesforce platform.
  • Test Automation: Experience designing and implementing automated test frameworks for Salesforce — Apex test class architecture, code coverage reporting, LWC Jest unit tests, Selenium/Playwright UI tests and data validation scripts integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Static Code Analysis & Security Scanning: Hands-on experience with Salesforce Code Analyser, PMD for Apex, ESLint for LWC and SAST tooling integrated into pipeline quality gates — defining and enforcing code quality and security standards across Hub teams.
  • Secrets & Credential Management: Experience with vault-based secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, GitHub Secrets, Azure Key Vault) for securely managing Salesforce connected app credentials, API tokens and ETL integration credentials across Hub environments.
  • Data Migration Pipeline Integration: Understanding of ETL tool scheduling and orchestration — capable of integrating data migration job execution (Informatica, Talend, ADF, MuleSoft) into the Hub CI/CD framework alongside metadata deployments.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Experience building deployment health dashboards and alerting — using Salesforce native monitoring, GitHub Actions workflow summaries, Grafana, Datadog or similar — for real-time pipeline visibility across concurrent wave deployments.
  • Platform Security: Knowledge of Salesforce connected app security, named credentials, OAuth flows, IP restrictions and certificate-based authentication as they apply to CI/CD automation and Hub environment access control.
  • 10–16 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps engineering and Salesforce platform delivery
  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce DevOps experience — owning CI/CD pipelines, environment management and release governance for large-scale Salesforce programmes
  • 3+ years of experience designing DevOps frameworks for multi-track, multi-org Salesforce delivery programmes — managing 4+ concurrent release streams
  • Demonstrated experience implementing Hub or programme-level DevOps standards adopted by multiple delivery teams across a shared Salesforce environment
  • Proven track record mentoring and setting standards for DevOps Engineers embedded in track delivery teams
  • Experience integrating data migration pipeline execution into Salesforce CI/CD workflows — ETL scheduling, bulk load automation and reconciliation validation within deployment pipelines



Even Better If...

  • Experience with Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or Provar for end-to-end Salesforce UI test automation integrated into release pipelines
  • Knowledge of Salesforce unlocked package development and dependency management for componentised Hub metadata deployment
  • Experience with container-based CI/CD execution (Docker, GitHub Actions runners, self-hosted runners) for Salesforce pipeline scalability
  • Familiarity with Salesforce Shield — Event Monitoring, Platform Encryption and Field Audit Trail — as part of production environment governance
  • Understanding of Marketing Cloud deployment tooling — SFMC deployment manager, Marketing Cloud package framework
  • Experience with Tableau Server REST API and TSM CLI automation for Tableau Next content deployment pipelines
  • Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) for managing non-Salesforce Hub infrastructure components
  • Familiarity with DataOps practices — data pipeline versioning, data contract enforcement and automated data quality gate integration
  • Experience with Agentforce / AI feature deployment governance — managing prompt template versioning, agent topic configuration and guardrail policy changes through CI/CD pipelines

Join an agile team with deep startup roots. We operate as a high-velocity ‘startup-within-Salesforce,’ following our recent acquisition. You’ll be managed by the same founders and engineers who built the original company, offering the autonomy of a small team backed by the global scale and trust of Salesforce.

We have successfully moved past the "0 to 1" phase. We have a product that works, customers who love it, and the backing of Salesforce. Now, we are entering the "1 to 100" phase: scaling our architecture to handle global demand, hardening our systems for enterprise-grade resilience, and integrating deeply with the Agentforce ecosystem. This is your chance to help lead that transition.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

As a Production Support Engineer (SMTS), you will be a senior technical member of staff within our embedded reliability team. You aren’t building the foundation alone—you’ll work alongside a group of engineers and product owners to ensure the Agentforce Operations platform is the most reliable AI-powered engine in the industry.


This is a role for an engineer who loves the "scaling" problem. You will focus on production excellence, performance tuning, and infrastructure automation. Because you are embedded in the product organization, you’ll have a seat at the table during design reviews, ensuring that as we add new agentic capabilities, they are built to scale from day one.


  • Scaling & Reliability: Own the reliability roadmap for major product areas, working to transition our systems from startup-speed architectures to highly-available, global-scale enterprise solutions.
  • Collaborative Leadership: Partner with PMTS-level engineers to refine our infrastructure strategy, contributing senior-level perspectives on system design, capacity planning, and bottleneck identification.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Maintain and evolve our automated environments, focusing on making our "infrastructure-as-plugins" model more robust and developer-friendly.
  • AI Operations (AIOps): Support the scaling of our AI/ML infrastructure, ensuring our models have the GPU resources and data pipelines required to deliver real-time supply chain insights.
  • Production Excellence: Lead the "1 to 100" hardening of our observability stack. You won’t just respond to incidents; you’ll build the tooling that prevents them and the telemetry that explains them.
  • Performance Engineering: Deep-dive into SQL optimization, API latency, and cross-service communication to ensure our data-intensive supply chain platform remains performant under heavy load.
  • AI-First Workflow: Lean into the future of engineering by using AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to automate routine operational tasks and accelerate infrastructure delivery.

You're Our Person If...

  • 5+ years of experience in SRE, Production Engineering, or Backend Engineering with a heavy focus on operations and scale.
  • Proven Scaling Experience: You have previously helped take a product through a high-growth phase (the "1 to 100" journey), dealing with the technical debt and architectural shifts that come with it.
  • Coding Mastery: Ability to write and review production-level code in Golang, TypeScript, or Python—you view automation as a software engineering problem.
  • Technical Breadth: Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Terraform/OpenTofu, and AWS/GCP/Azure.
  • Observability Expert: Demonstrated experience with properly instrumenting applications and platforms with SLO-based monitoring and alerting. 
  • Systems Expert: Deep understanding of distributed systems, including how to debug complex interactions between microservices, databases, and AI agents.
  • Low-Ego Collaboration: Experience working within a senior team of Principal engineers, capable of both leading specific initiatives and supporting the broader group’s technical vision.
  • AI Fluency: A demonstrated ability to use modern AI development tools to move faster and build more reliable systems.
  • Ownership Mentality. We are a senior team who operate with a high degree of autonomy. As a result, we’re looking for someone who can independently identify issues and own the solution all the way through final implementation.  

Even Better If...

Our goal is for you to apply once and be considered for the opportunity that best aligns with your background.

The Experience

The Migration Delivery Lead is an individual contributor who leads complex customer migration engagements from kickoff through successful go-live. You serve as the primary technical and strategic point of contact for your migration pod — building trust with customers, coordinating with our Global Delivery Center (GDC) engineering partners, and ensuring every engagement drives real, measurable value as customers move to modern cloud architectures.

This role sits at the intersection of customer relationship management and hands-on technical execution. You'll act as a trusted advisor who bridges a customer's legacy environment with their future-state platform — accelerating timelines through automated playbooks and AI-assisted tooling, while serving as a direct feedback channel to Product and Engineering on what's working (and what isn't) in the field.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Lead end-to-end customer migration engagements — owning technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.
  • Partner with Account Teams and Sales leadership to align migration goals with customers' broader business strategy, renewal, and expansion objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with both business and technical stakeholders, translating complex migration challenges into clear, actionable decisions.
  • Develop and execute focused delivery plans that prioritize high-impact milestones and hold pod-level timelines to account.
  • Facilitate enablement and alignment sessions to ensure customer teams are prepared and confident for platform transitions.
  • Drive adoption of AI agents and automation toolkits to accelerate discovery, data mapping, and code conversion — reducing manual effort and compressing delivery timelines.
  • Collaborate closely with GDC partners, delegating repeatable technical tasks while maintaining full accountability for output quality.
  • Work in close alignment with Outbound Product Managers to stay current on product roadmaps and translate field insights into product improvements.
  • Identify underutilized platform capabilities and incorporate them into migration roadmaps to increase customer throughput and adoption.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one key domain: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
  • Apply AI literacy and prompt engineering skills to guide AI agents in data retrieval, migration health reporting, and task automation.



You're Our Person If...

  • 8+ years of experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or Technical Consulting, with a strong focus on large-scale platform migrations.
  • Deep, hands-on domain expertise in one or more of the following: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate technical discussions, and navigate complex stakeholder conversations.
  • Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business-friendly language and guide customers through data transformations.
  • Proven experience working with global or offshore delivery models (such as GDC) to accelerate project delivery.
  • Advanced knowledge of Salesforce core (Sales/Service Cloud) or specialized clouds (Marketing, Data, Revenue, or Tableau).
  • Familiarity with AI agents or automation tools applied to data mapping, sentiment analysis, or task automation.
  • Understanding of how target cloud platforms integrate with telephony systems, third-party data sources, and self-service portals.



Even Better If...

  • Certifications in relevant domains (e.g., Marketing Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Tableau Desktop Specialist).
  • Prior experience as an individual contributor leading multi-million dollar transformation engagements.
  • Salesforce AI Associate or Agentblazer certifications.

You'll join a team that is shaping how Salesforce customers adopt the next generation of cloud technology — with access to cutting-edge AI tools, a collaborative global delivery model, and a direct line to the Product teams building the platforms you work with. We’re looking for passionate individuals who want to shape the future of our products and deliver exceptional experiences to our customers. Equally important is advanced prompt engineering — the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready. Come be a part of our innovative and collaborative environment, where your skills will thrive and your ideas will be valued. Apply now and let’s build something extraordinary together!

We embrace the hybrid model and celebrate the individual strengths of each team member while encouraging everyone on the team to grow into the best version of themselves. We believe that autonomous teams with the freedom to make decisions will empower individuals, products, companies, and customers to thrive.

About the Team:

Authentication Core decides how every user, admin, and integration signs in to Salesforce. We own login flows, session management, MFA, and the OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect and SAML endpoints that issue and validate credentials at global scale. We also own the defenses around them: binding sessions to devices (DBSC and Web Crypto) to prevent session hijacking, rolling out mTLS, enforcing PKCE and refresh-token rotation for connected apps, and retiring legacy login protocols. A mistake here is a security incident or a global outage, so we hold a high bar for correctness, security, and operations.

Your Impact:

Your work protects every Salesforce customer’s front door. You’ll ship security improvements to hundreds of millions of users without breaking the integrations enterprises depend on.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Architect, design, implement, test, and deliver highly scalable authentication and session services on Salesforce Core (Java), with strict availability and latency requirements
  • Build and evolve standards-based identity protocols, including OAuth 2.0/2.1, OpenID Connect, SAML 2.0, and newer ones such as PKCE, DPoP, mTLS-bound tokens (RFC 8705), token exchange, and Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC)
  • Harden sessions and credentials against hijacking, replay, phishing, and credential stuffing, using token binding, refresh-token rotation, secure cookie design (SameSite, CHIPS), and step-up authentication
  • Threat-model new features, work with Product Security, and fix findings from penetration tests, bug bounty, and incident reviews
  • Roll out security enforcement safely for customers using feature flags, phased cohorts, telemetry-driven decisions, backward compatibility, and clear deprecation plans for legacy endpoints
  • Master our development process, culture, and code base, then improve it
  • Operate optimally in the hybrid engineering model where engineers are encouraged to be able to craft and complete the vital work to ensure quality in their own code as well as other engineers
  • Mentor others in development technologies, tools, processes, and secure-coding practices
  • Present your own designs to internal/external groups and review designs of others
  • Develop test strategies, design automation frameworks, and write unit/functional tests, including negative and abuse-case tests for authentication paths
  • Participate in the team’s on-call rotation to address sophisticated problems in real time, including authentication outages and security incidents, and keep services operational and highly available
  • Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code
  • Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale
  • Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably
  • Critically evaluate code (human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance, especially authentication, authorization, and cryptographic logic, where subtle mistakes become vulnerabilities



You're Our Person If...

  • A related technical degree required
  • 3+ years of professional software development experience (Senior Level: 5+ years, including ownership of production services)
  • Strong Java and object-oriented design skills; experience with large, multi-tenant codebases is a plus
  • Solid grasp of authentication and authorization basics: identity vs. access, session lifecycle, and token types (access, refresh, ID), with hands-on experience with at least one of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, or SAML
  • Working knowledge of applied cryptography: symmetric vs. asymmetric encryption, hashing, HMAC, password hashing (bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2, PBKDF2), digital signatures, PKI and X.509 certificates, TLS and mTLS, JWT/JWS/JWE, and key management and rotation, plus the judgment to use vetted libraries rather than writing your own
  • Secure-coding fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, CSRF, XSS, session fixation, open redirects, injection, timing side channels, and safe handling of secrets and PII
  • Understanding of the browser security model: cookies and their attributes, same-origin policy, CORS, CSP, and security headers
  • Proven understanding of web technologies, such as JavaScript, HTML5, JSON, and HTTP
  • Validated understanding of database technologies such as SQL and relational database schema design
  • Experience in automated testing including unit and functional testing using Java, JUnit, and Selenium
  • A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering: using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty, while using it responsibly with security-sensitive code (checking AI-generated cryptographic and authentication logic against specs, and never exposing secrets or customer data in prompts)
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor) in development workflows
  • Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready
  • Excellent interpersonal skills
  • Office-Flex: Work in-person three days per week; or 10 days per quarter for some engineering teams



Even Better If...

  • Experience with MFA and passwordless authentication (WebAuthn/FIDO2, passkeys, TOTP)
  • Familiarity with identity RFCs and specifications (RFC 6749, 6750, 7519, 7636, 8705, 9449; OpenID Connect Core), or participation in the IETF OAuth Working Group or the OpenID Foundation

Drive a unified partnership with Finance, Strategy, Recruiting, and Workforce Planning.
  • Org Health Management: Utilise Org Health metrics and analytics to diagnose skill gaps, team health issues, and organisational structure challenges, providing data-driven recommendations to the lead ESBP and business leaders. Conduct proactive quarterly org inspections that go beyond static metrics to address role sprawl, micro-teams, and organisational gaps to drive speed and productivity.
  • AI Fluency & Agentic Enablement: Act as a thought partner in leading the responsible adoption of AI in ES and the business. Support business leaders in building AI strategies, performing task analysis for the 4Rs (Redesign, Reskill, Redeploy, Rebalance), and driving employee proficiency in core AI fluency skills. Identify opportunities to automate or augment manual processes using AI tools and ES Agents.

  • Talent Program Management: Manage and drive the successful execution of core talent lifecycle processes — including performance reviews, compensation planning, promotions, and succession planning — within the business unit. Proactively identify, engage, and retain high performers and critical roles.
  • Leadership Coaching: Provide coaching and consultation to managers on employee relations, team development, retention strategies, and effective utilisation of HR programs and tools. Meet people where they are and help them grow, modelling a curiosity and growth mindset in all interactions.

Break down silos and serve as connective tissue across ES, Finance, Recruiting, and Workforce Planning.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Influence and manage stakeholder expectations by communicating HR strategy and program objectives effectively — leading with "why," assuming positive intent, and bringing warmth and directness to every interaction.
  • Values Integration: Ensure all people practices and leader actions reinforce the company's core values and team commitments: People First, Collaboration, Integrity, and Continuous Learning. Champion equality through active participation in Equality Group initiatives and voluntary time off programs, possess a team player and curious mindset.

  • Strong business acumen with the ability to understand organisational dynamics and industry context.
  • Proven success building executive-level relationships and influencing decisions at all levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and implement large-scale people initiatives across complex, matrixed organisations.
  • Proactive approach with the ability to anticipate issues and propose strategic solutions.
  • Deep experience diagnosing and addressing organisational development challenges.

Salesforce menawarkan peluang menarik bagi para Profesional Penjualan yang telah terbukti mampu melampaui target penjualan di bidang teknologi. Anda harus mampu memperkirakan aktivitas penjualan dan pencapaian pendapatan sambil menciptakan pelanggan yang puas dan dapat dijadikan referensi.

  • Melampaui target penjualan bulanan dan triwulanan dengan menjual solusi Salesforce ke akun-akun perusahaan di wilayah yang ditugaskan, sekaligus mendorong perolehan bisnis baru dan memperluas akun yang sudah ada.

  • Menjaga data pipeline yang akurat dan terkini serta menyajikan perkiraan bulanan yang dapat diandalkan.

  • Anda memiliki rekam jejak keberhasilan dalam menjual ke akun perusahaan besar, idealnya di segmen Industri Jasa Keuangan.
  • Anda memiliki pengalaman yang signifikan dalam penjualan solusi perusahaan, dengan konsisten melampaui target kuota dan pendapatan.

  • Pengalaman akan dievaluasi berdasarkan kesesuaian dengan kompetensi inti untuk peran ini (misalnya, peran kepemimpinan di luar kurikulum, pengalaman militer, kegiatan sukarela, dll.).

  • Memiliki pengalaman dalam perencanaan dan pelaksanaan akun strategis.
  • Rekam jejak penjualan kepada eksekutif tingkat C di unit TI dan bisnis di Indonesia dan Malaysia.

Our AMER & EMEA Email Marketing team is looking for an experienced Email Marketing Senior Lead to own AMER Strategic Events audience generation.

You'll balance business needs with channel health, driving registration targets for strategic events and sustaining engagement (e.g., click-through rate, unsubscribe rate, unsubscribe-to-click rate).

You'll partner closely with Strategic Event teams across AMER. This is an end-to-end role — from planning and audience strategy through AI-assisted email production, send execution, reporting, and business reviews.

Core Responsibilities & Scope

  • Strategy & Planning:
    • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders and collaborate on intake, audience generation strategies, and performance.
    • Set each stakeholder's audience generation plan and KPI targets, using judgment on what's realistic given their business context, and adjust that plan in cadenced reviews.
    • Lead reviews with stakeholders — reading the room, negotiating priorities, and making the call on what to prioritize.
    • Decide which cross-regional process or standardization initiatives are worth pursuing each half, and build the buy-in to land them across AMER/EMEA.
    • Bring forward-looking recommendations to business reviews — synthesizing signals into a point of view.
  • Audience Generation:
    • Execute audience generation campaigns end-to-end — deciding when to refresh, escalate, or retire a campaign, and advising stakeholders on the right channel and approach based on program context beyond dashboards.
    • Align send calendar, suppressions, and sequencing directly with stakeholders — weighing whose priority wins this week across competing demands, and executing the resulting plan under time pressure.
    • Turn post-send data into actionable observations stakeholders will actually act on, beyond a summary of numbers.
    • Own escalation decisions on support eligibility disputes and flag process divergence between AMER and EMEA before it becomes a bigger problem.
  • Email Production:
    • Direct AI tools to accelerate email production — drafting, QA, and build support — but own final execution: what ships, what gets held, and what needs a human fix before send.
    • Assess whether a new email project request clears the eligibility bar, then execute the build against a live send calendar.
    • Understand platform and technology releases and flag which ones matter for owned programs, and push the right issues to business partners.
  • Reporting & Compliance:
    • Determine whether channel health signals reflect a real problem or an expected side effect, and decide what's worth escalating vs. monitoring.
    • Deliver monthly stakeholder insights with root-cause commentary — the analysis behind the number, not the number itself.
    • Own reporting accuracy where attribution is ambiguous, and shape the narrative behind business review numbers.


Minimum Requirements

  • You have 10+ years of experience in Email Marketing.
  • Strong judgment on stakeholder relationship management: intake conversations, FY planning, and quarterly business reviews where negotiation and prioritization matter more than process-following.
  • In-depth experience with email marketing solutions/ESPs, preferably Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Hands-on comfort directing AI tools for email production work — able to evaluate AI-generated output and know when to override it.
  • Strong skills in SQL, HTML/CSS, and AMPscript — enough to judge whether AI-generated output is correct, with the ability to hand-code if needed.
  • Ability to read business metrics (e.g., responses, leads, attributed pipeline and maturation) and email metrics (UOR - open rate, UCTR - click-through rate, U:CR - unsubscribe-to-click rate) and turn them into a narrative and a decision, not just a report.
  • Comfortable making prioritization calls under pressure across events, always-on, and demand gen channels.
  • Working knowledge of CAN-SPAM, and consent requirements, with the judgment to spot edge cases automated checks miss.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience negotiating channel strategy with senior stakeholders on conflicting priorities
  • Prior direct support of event programs, where competing priorities need real-time tradeoff decisions.
  • You have experience with Salesforce products, Marketing Cloud, or Agentforce.
  • You have built AI-powered marketing workflows, experimentation frameworks, or predictive segmentation models.
  • You have an in-depth understanding of how LLMs and Agents work and how APIs compare to MCP, combined with insight into how these technologies can support the email channel.

Our team operates as a small startup within Salesforce AI Labs, separate from the main engineering and product organizations. You’ll work directly with the team’s leader and engineers, alongside customers, with the autonomy to shape an early product and the resources of Salesforce to back you up.

As a Value Acceleration Engineer, you’ll write code, build alongside customers, and get real workflows into production. This is forward-deployed engineering on an emerging product: what you learn in deployments will help determine what we build next.

Build Directly With Customers

Job Details

About Salesforce

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the team


Assurance at Salesforce is being rebuilt as an engineering discipline. Legacy GRC runs on spreadsheets, screenshots, and an annual scramble to prove controls worked months ago. We're replacing it with a model that is continuous, automated, and built into how Salesforce ships. Controls are code. Evidence comes from pipelines, not people chasing tickets.

  • Risk-informed, control managed. We monitor, validate, and improve the controls that stand against threats and failures.
  • Visibility and invention. We give Salesforce a clear, current view of its security posture, and we invest in the people who build it.
  • Always in front. Nothing waits for the next audit to surface.

You'll have real ownership, a real roadmap, and the chance to define what modern assurance looks like for the industry.

What you'll be doing:


As a Sr. Security Governance Engineer, you'll translate enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and risk expectations into measurable, technically actionable controls. You'll help build a governance framework where policies and standards are version-controlled, validated, and integrated into engineering workflows. Over time, you'll grow into a Security Control Family Owner for domains such as IAM, Cloud, Application Security, Cryptography, Data Protection, or Infrastructure Security. The focus is governance, control design, and policy ownership. It is not hands-on software development.

  • Policy and standards: Develop and maintain security policies, technical standards, and control requirements. Manage the policy lifecycle: versioning, approvals, exceptions, reviews, and change management. Keep them aligned with architecture, risk appetite, and regulatory obligations.
  • Governance-as-Code / Policy-as-Code: Define structured, machine-readable policy and control requirements. Work with engineering to turn them into guardrails and validation criteria, using tools like OPA/Rego or cloud-native policy frameworks. You won't necessarily own the implementation. Review implementations for alignment with policy intent.
  • Control framework: Maintain a common control framework with clear objectives, ownership, and validation criteria. Establish traceability from regulation to policy to control to implementation. Set expectations for preventive, detective, and compensating controls, and support continuous evaluation of control effectiveness.
  • Control family ownership: Act as the SME and point of contact for your assigned domains. Interpret regulations, assess gaps, exceptions, and emerging risks, and recommend improvements.
  • Collaboration: Work with Security Engineering, Product Security, Cloud Security, IAM, Compliance, Risk, Audit, Legal, and business teams. Bring a governance perspective to architecture and design discussions.

Expected Outcomes

  • Decision speed: Rules are obvious, decisions are fast, and outputs are predictable, with governance built into the engineering workflow.
  • Scalable governance: Policies and control requirements are clear, consistent, and technically actionable.
  • Governance-as-Code adoption: Requirements are version-controlled, traceable, and integrated into security practices.
  • Alignment and visibility: Written policies, technical guardrails, and implemented controls match. Regulations, risks, controls, and evidence are clearly linked.
  • Control family SMEs: Dedicated owners set policy direction and technical standards for each domain.

What you should have:

  • U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency required — we're unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.
  • 7+ years in information security governance, security engineering, technology risk, or related functions
  • Strong grasp of security policies, standards, control frameworks, and governance processes
  • Familiarity with NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or PCI DSS
  • Ability to turn regulatory and security requirements into measurable control objectives
  • Working knowledge of cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP), IAM, application, infrastructure, and data security
  • Understanding of control design (preventive and detective), risk assessment, and exception management
  • Familiarity with modern development practices, cloud environments, and CI/CD
  • Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Governance-as-Code or Policy-as-Code, and policy engines such as OPA/Rego or HashiCorp Sentinel
  • Familiarity with YAML, JSON, Git, infrastructure-as-code, and DevSecOps
  • Experience with GRC platforms, Common Controls Frameworks (CCF), and OSCAL
  • Exposure to security posture management, compliance validation, architecture reviews, or AI governance

How We Work:

  • Engineering-first. We use version control, code review, CI/CD, and backlogs. Assurance work ships like software.
  • Automate first. If it's done manually twice, it's a candidate for a build.
  • Signals, not surprises. Gaps become alerts and workflows, and control failures resolve through defined escalation paths.
  • Embedded partners. We work alongside T&P teams as peers, not gatekeepers, and solve problems with them, not at them.
  • Outcomes over activity. We measure risk reduced, effort saved, and audit friction removed.
  • Room to grow. Learn the engineering side if you come from GRC, or the risk side if you come from engineering. We support both paths.

Developer Workspaces runs the computers Slack engineers write code on - and more and more, the ones AI agents write code on. Every week, hundreds of engineers build and test Slack in the remote development environments we run on AWS and Kubernetes. Now we're building the next layer: fast, isolated sandboxes where coding agents can run a dev toolchain, open pull requests, and shut down when they're done.


If most of Slack's code is going to be written by agents, it'll be written on infrastructure this team owns.


We're a small team with a lot of surface area. We're strong on backend engineering, and we need more depth in infrastructure and operations. That's this role. You'll own production systems early, carry the pager, and help decide how agents run safely at Slack.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Scale our AI sandbox fleet into something the whole company depends on - capacity planning, safe rollouts, image builds, and the alerts that tell us when it's breaking.
  • Harden the isolation between agents, sandboxes and the rest of Slack: network separation, egress controls, secrets handling, and patching.
  • Run and improve the remote dev environments our engineers use every day, from Terraform and machine images to the automation that pauses idle environments so they don't burn money.
  • Build observability we can make decisions with - SLOs, dashboards, and logs that land where we can find them.
  • Join our weekly on-call rotation once you've ramped up. Most pages are low urgency. When something does break, we fix it and then automate the fix.
  • Use AI agents heavily in your own work. You're building the platform they run on, so you should know what they need.

You're Our Person If...

  • You have 3+ years of experience building and operating production systems.
  • You come from infrastructure, SRE, DevOps or platform engineering, and you've been on call for something that mattered.
  • You know AWS well - EC2, networking, IAM - and you manage infrastructure as code with Terraform or something like it.
  • You write solid code in Go or Python. Everything we do ships as code, and your infrastructure instincts shape how you write it.
  • You use AI coding tools every day and have opinions about where they fall short.
  • You take ownership. When something breaks, you don't wait for someone to assign it to you.

This role sits on a new, first-of-its-kind team focused on automation, transformation, and scaled engagment — building the systems, workflows, and reporting infrastructure that will transform partner account management to scale efficiently.

As an ISV Digital Launch Partner Account Manager, you will be responsible for defining the future of our Digital Launch territory management—overseeing a large portfolio of (~50) ISV partners through a modern, hybrid model that blends programmatic 1:many campaigns with targeted 1:1 strategic interventions.

Partner 1:1 engagement will be reserved for strategic initiatives across tech adoption, high-potential assessment, and unblocking roadblocks as needed.

  • Pricing Acumen: Familiarity with consumption-based pricing and skill in simplifying complex pricing into customer-centric value narratives.

  • Project Management: Organized and effective at managing multiple priorities and timelines.
  • Influence: Collaborative, with the ability to drive alignment across global and cross-functional teams.

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

The FDE SWAT is a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer role focused on troubleshooting, fixing, and resolving complex issues in live customer deployments. As part of a team of specialists, you will be engaged by FDE Pods or directly by customers when critical problems arise, working quickly to diagnose root causes, implement fixes, and restore stable performance across Agentforce and the wider Salesforce platform. You will own issues end-to-end, from triage and investigation to resolution, validation, and handover, and you will be responsible for clear communication with stakeholders throughout, especially in high-pressure and time-sensitive situations. You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a direct escalation path: reproducing and documenting defects, providing detailed technical evidence, collaborating on fixes and workarounds, and tracking resolutions through to release.   • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, and validate the output.

Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and key-management expertise are strong advantages, but deep distributed-systems and security judgment matter most.

  • You have security domain experience in identity and authorization, applied cryptography, or infrastructure security.
  • You have working knowledge of PKI, X.509 certificates, mutual Transport Layer Security (mTLS), and key management.

descriptionHtml:

Job Details

About Salesforce

The Experience

The Authentication Platform team owns the core identity services for Salesforce's production infrastructure — the Production IAM stack. The portfolio spans Kerberos-based authentication, TOTP, and FIDO2/WebAuthn, bridging legacy infrastructure protocols and modern cloud-native identity standards. Because the platform is a tier-0 dependency for the entire company, we run at massive throughput with a 4+ nines availability target across Public Cloud (AWS/GCP) and hybrid deployments on Kubernetes, with modern CI/CD. Our security posture is Zero Trust and least-privilege by default, and we partner closely with security architects on identity verification and credential-handling design.

You'll work on services in the Production IAM stack as an individual contributor — implementing features across the Kerberos, TOTP, and FIDO2/WebAuthn service portfolio, contributing to designs that senior engineers lead, and taking on-call for a tier-0 platform. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on strong execution, growing technical depth in identity protocols, and shipping high-quality, well-tested code in a security-critical environment.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Deliver features across the Authentication Platform's service portfolio - Kerberos, TOTP, FIDO2/WebAuthn - writing clean, well-tested backend code in Java, Go, or C#.
  • Contribute to design specs and research spikes for features in your area, alongside more senior engineers who lead the design.
  • Implement identity and federation protocols used by the platform, including Kerberos, LDAP, WebAuthn/FIDO2, and TOTP. Familiarity with SAML/OIDC is useful for interop conversations with adjacent teams.
  • Partner with the Product Owner and tech lead on story-level scope, sequencing, and dependencies for your own work, and help refine and clarify work items before they land in a sprint.
  • Reliably deliver as a developer, reviewer, and tester — high test coverage, clean code, and reviews that catch issues before they land, with a security-first mindset appropriate for tier-0 services.
  • Apply Salesforce engineering best practices to code, tests, and CI/CD pipelines. Leave code in better shape than you found it.
  • Use AI development tools (e.g.Claude Code) in your day-to-day workflow, and critically evaluate both human and AI-generated code for correctness, performance, and security compliance.
  • Analyze and fix bugs in your area, working with more senior engineers on the complex ones. Debug production issues and drive them to a fix.
  • Exhibit ownership beyond just coding your features — an active role in testing, review, and monitoring is part of the job, especially given the tier-0 nature of the platform.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for the Authentication Platform and handle common alerts confidently. On-call is a real, high-visibility part of this role because of the platform's tier-0 status.
  • Understand the platform's telemetry — metrics, logs, traces, SLIs — and extend it for the features you own. The availability target is 4+ nines.
  • Contribute to Root Cause Analyses for incidents in your area, and follow through on assigned action items.
  • Work with internal stakeholders — service teams and infrastructure owners who depend on the Authentication Platform — to answer integration questions about the features you own.
  • Author and maintain technical documentation and runbooks for your work.



You're Our Person If...

  • Strong programming ability in Java, Go, or C#, with production experience building backend services.
  • Working knowledge of at least one identity or federation protocol from this set: Kerberos, LDAP, WebAuthn/FIDO2, TOTP, SAML, OIDC. Deeper experience in one or more is a plus.
  • Experience building, deploying, and debugging distributed services in a Public Cloud environment (AWS or GCP) or a hybrid deployment, using Kubernetes and modern CI/CD.
  • Solid grasp of software fundamentals: data structures, testing, code review, source control, CI/CD, and Agile execution as a team member.
  • A security-first mindset — writing code with least-privilege defaults, threat-aware reviews, and thorough automated testing appropriate for identity-critical systems.
  • Ability to debug production issues in a distributed system using logs, metrics, and traces.
  • Comfortable executing an agreed-upon plan largely independently, escalating design-level and cross-cutting decisions to senior engineers.



Even Better If...

  • IAM specialist depth — familiarity with the internals of one or more of Kerberos, LDAP, WebAuthn/FIDO2, TOTP, and the interop story with SAML/OIDC.
  • Security hardening — familiarity with HSMs, PKI, and secure credential storage patterns.
  • Compliance and auditing — exposure to controls and evidence requirements under PCI, SOC 2, or HIPAA.
  • Operational grit — experience on-call for a high-visibility production service, and comfort debugging live incidents under pressure.
  • Experience integrating AI development tools into engineering workflows, including prompt design and reviewing AI-generated code for security-critical systems.



Education

  • Master's degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or a related field. A Bachelor's degree (or foreign equivalent) is acceptable with additional years of experience.



Minimum years of experience

  • 5 years of software engineering experience

The Experience

We are seeking a lead full stack engineer with enterprise software engineering experience to drive the architecture, technical roadmap, and execution for our next-generation Security Assurance Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform. In this role, you will hold end-to-end technical ownership over the platform’s core engines—including policy as code, compliance as code, automated evidence collection, telemetry and alerting, and risk evaluation modules.

Beyond hands-on development in Python, Java, and modern front-end frameworks, you will act as a primary technical leader: defining system architecture, scoping and planning multi-quarter technical initiatives, and guiding distributed feature teams from concept through deployment. You will also pioneer the team’s operational strategy around AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) to accelerate output and elevate code quality across the engineering organization.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • End-to-End Ownership: Take technical ownership of complex, multi-system initiatives, driving architectural decisions, technical specifications, phase planning, and execution across the delivery lifecycle.
  • Architecture & System Design: Architect resilient, cloud-native microservice architectures that process large-scale compliance telemetry, support automated evidence ingestion, and execute low-latency risk evaluation engines.
  • Roadmap & Project Planning: Partner with Product Management, Security Architects, and GRC leaders to translate broad business and regulatory strategies into detailed technical roadmaps, milestones, and sprint backlogs.
  • Technical Governance: Establish engineering standards, perform high-impact code and architecture reviews, enforce secure coding guidelines, and institute rigorous CI/CD and testing benchmarks across the engineering org.
  • Policy & Governance as Code: Design and implement extensible Policy as Code and Compliance as Code engines (e.g., leveraging Open Policy Agent/OPA or custom evaluation frameworks) and runtime platforms (e.g. CSPM, EDR, etc) that dynamically audit infrastructure and enterprise controls. Constrain the outputs of AI coding assistants with declarative machine-readable rules.
  • Automated Evidence Collection: Lead the design of automated evidence collection pipelines integrating with multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers, enterprise security tools, CI/CD pipelines, ticketing systems, and productivity / corporate applications (Workday, Netsuite, etc).
  • Risk & Regulatory Modeling: Build dynamic risk analysis engines and auditing interfaces capable of mapping continuous technical evidence against major regulatory standards (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Lead the adoption and integration of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI APIs) across the engineering lifecycle to optimize team productivity, automate test generation, and streamline refactoring.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers across time zones, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Lead cross-functional alignment and technical discussions across a geographically dispersed team operating in an asynchronous-first culture.


You're Our Person If...

  • Experience: 6–13 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience, including 3+ years at the Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) or Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) level leading technical projects and distributed engineering teams.
  • Project Ownership Track Record: Proven experience taking complex SaaS platforms or enterprise software projects from architectural inception to production delivery.
  • Strategic Execution: Demonstrated ability to break down ambiguous business requirements into high-level architecture designs, concrete technical epics, and actionable execution plans.
  • Systems Engineering: Deep mastery of both Python and Java, including enterprise frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Django, Flask, Spring Boot) and microservices design patterns.
  • Front-End Architecture: Advanced proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (React, Vue, or Angular), with experience designing scalable component libraries and complex data visualization dashboards.
  • AI Tooling & Innovation: Advanced proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery, paired with a strategic vision for integrating AI into technical workflows.
  • Data & Cloud Systems: Strong expertise in relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL/graph databases, distributed data processing, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Regulatory Frameworks: Working knowledge of regulatory standards including NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria).
  • Compliance Engineering: Direct experience building or architecting systems around continuous control monitoring, automated audit trails, or policy engine evaluation (e.g., OPA/Rego).


Even Better If...
